tags.name: highres
tags.summary: An image at least 1600 pixels wide or 1200 pixels tall. Approximately equivalent to {{mpixels:>=1.9}}. This tag is [[help:autotags|automatically]] added to images. See also [[lowres]] (500×500 or smaller) [[highres]] (at least 1600×1200) [[absurdres]] (at least 3200×2400) [[incredibly absurdres]] (a
tags.wiki_zh: 宽度至少1600像素或高度至少1200像素的图片。大致相当于{{mpixels:>=1.9}}。 该标签会被 [[help:autotags|automatically]] 添加到图片上。 另请参见 [[lowres]] （500×500或更小） [[highres]] （至少1600×1200） [[absurdres]] （至少3200×2400） [[incredibly absurdres]] （任一边超过10000） [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: commentary_request
tags.summary: A post with an artist [[commentary]] that has not been fully translated into English. To translate the commentary, click the Add commentary link and place the translated title and commentary inside their respective fields. When the translation is complete, remove this tag and replace it with
tags.wiki_zh: 带有尚未完全翻译成英文的作者 [[commentary]] 的帖子。 要翻译附文，点击 Add commentary 链接，并将翻译后的标题和附文分别放入相应的字段中。翻译完成后，移除此标签并替换为 [[commentary]] 。如果翻译不完整或需要审核，保留 [[commentary request]] 标签并添加 [[partial commentary]] 或 [[check commentary]] 标签。 当附文未翻译时，不要将图片标记为 [[translation request]] 。 [[Translation request]] 用于图片内部的文字。 另请参见 [[commentary]] [[check commentary]] [[missing commentary]] [[english commentary]] [[translation request]] [[help:artist_commentary]] [[howto:translate]]

tags.name: commentary
tags.summary: A post where the artist commentary is understandable by the average English speaker. This can be because it was translated by a Danbooru user into English from another language, the original commentary was already in [[English commentary|English]] , or the commentary consists of
tags.wiki_zh: 指普通英语使用者能够理解的作者评论。这可能是因为 Danbooru 用户将其从其他语言翻译成了英语，或原评论本身就是用 [[English commentary|English]] 写成的，或评论由 [[untranslatable commentary|symbols]] 或类似内容构成。 除非其中出现的所有非英语语言都已被翻译，否则不要将此标签与 [[mixed-language commentary]] 同时使用。例外情况是 [[bilingual commentary]] 和 [[multilingual commentary]] ，其中一种语言为英语，且所有非英语部分均由画师本人正确翻译。 对于未翻译的作者评论，请改用 [[commentary request]] ，如果不是日语，还请加上相应的“[language]_commentary”:/wiki_pages?search%5Btitle_normalize%5D=*_commentary&redirect=true标签。 如果评论中唯一未翻译的部分是元数据，例如话题标签或提及（@），则将其标记为 [[commentary]] ，而不是 [[partial commentary]] 或 [[commentary request]] 。 相关标签 语言 “Japanese commentary”在 Danbooru 上不是标签，因为它被视为默认语言。其他语言的标签如下： [[Arabic commentary]] [[Chinese commentary]] [[Traditional Chinese commentary]] [[Cuneiform commentary]] [[Danish commentary]] [[Dzongkha commentary]] [[English commentary]]

tags.name: absurdres
tags.summary: An image at least 3200 pixels wide or 2400 pixels tall. Approximately equivalent to {{mpixels:>=7.7}}. This tag is [[help:autotags|automatically]] added to images. See also [[lowres]] (500×500 or smaller) [[highres]] (at least 1600×1200) [[absurdres]] (at least 3200×2400) [[incredibly absurdres]] (a
tags.wiki_zh: 宽度至少3200像素或高度至少2400像素的图片。大致相当于{{mpixels:>=7.7}}。 此标签由 [[help:autotags|automatically]] 添加到图片上。 另请参见 [[lowres]] （500×500或更小） [[highres]] （至少1600×1200） [[absurdres]] （至少3200×2400） [[incredibly absurdres]] （任一边超过10000） [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: bad_id
tags.summary: A post that is no longer available from the source link. Usually this is because the work was deleted by the artist. Compare with [[bad source]] , where the link does not point to the original image, and [[bad link]] , where the source is correct but it leads to a direct image instead of a proper po
tags.wiki_zh: 源链接已无法访问的投稿。通常是因为作品被画师删除了。 与 [[bad source]] （链接并未指向原图）以及 [[bad link]] （来源正确，但指向的是图片直链而非正式投稿页面）作比较。 指南 如果找到了该图片的另一个来源，请遵循以下说明： 如果文件大小和MD5哈希值相同，则将来源字段更改为新来源，并移除 [[bad id]] 标签。MD5哈希值可以通过http://onlinemd5.com/、https://md5file.com/calculator或https://duplicatebooru.zipfiled.info/进行比较。注意：只有由原作者本人发布的来源才是合法来源。 如果文件大小不同且图片质量更差，则直接忽略，不要上传。 如果文件大小不同且图片质量更好，若你认为该图片值得收录则上传，然后将原图作为子投稿关联到新上传（在子投稿上点击编辑，将父投稿ID粘贴到父投稿栏位中），再给原上传打上 [[duplicate]] 标签。 坏ID列表 [[Bad Arca.Live ID]] [[Bad ArtStation ID]] [[Bad ARTstreet ID]] [[Bad Baidu ID]] [[Bad Baraag ID]] [[Bad Behance ID]] [[Bad Bilibili ID]] [[Bad Blogspot ID]] [[Bad Bluesky ID]] [[Bad Booth ID]] [[Bad Cara ID]] [[Bad CGSociety ID]] [[Bad Ci-en ID]] [[Bad Commishes ID]] [[Bad Daum ID]] [[Bad DeviantArt ID]] [[Bad Dropbox ID]] [[Bad E-Hentai ID]]

tags.name: english_commentary
tags.summary: Artist [[commentary]] that is originally written in [[english text|English]] . This tag is not to be used for commentary that is translated into English by a Danbooru user. This tag should not be used when the commentary contains no actual English - such as commentaries consisting solely of the name
tags.wiki_zh: 画师 [[commentary]] ，其原本是以 [[english text|English]] 写成的。此标签不得用于由 Danbooru 用户翻译成英文的评论。 当评论中不含实际英文时不应使用此标签——例如评论仅由一个或多个人物、版权、画师等的名称构成时。 此标签不会蕴含 [[commentary]] ，因为它涵盖了仅部分评论为英文的情况，例如 [[mixed-language commentary]] （topic #15162）。 另见 [[Engrish commentary]]

tags.name: bad_pixiv_id
tags.summary: A Pixiv post that is no longer publicly available, because the work was either deleted or made private. See also [[bad id]] [[pixiv sample]] [[md5 mismatch]]
tags.wiki_zh: 不再公开的Pixiv投稿，因为该作品已被删除或设为非公开。 另请参见 [[bad id]] [[pixiv sample]] [[md5 mismatch]]

tags.name: translation_request
tags.summary: Any non-English text (usually Japanese, Chinese, or Korean) within an image that needs a translation into English. [[Audible speech]] that is not in English and does not have hardcoded English subtitles in the video may use this tag. Do not use this tag for untranslated
tags.wiki_zh: 图片中任何需要翻译成英文的非英文文本（通常是日语、中文或韩语）。 [[Audible speech]] 中没有英文且视频中没有硬编码英文字幕的非英文内容可以使用此标签。未翻译的 [[help:artist commentary|artist commentaries]] 请勿使用此标签，改用 [[commentary request]] 。 请阅读 [[howto:translate]] 以了解翻译指南。当帖子已完全翻译后，移除 [[translation request]] 标签并添加 [[translated]] 。如果翻译不完整或需要审核，请保留 [[translation request]] 标签并添加 [[partially translated]] 或 [[check translation]] 标签。 如果唯一未翻译的文本是音效，请改用 [[sound effect request]] 。 对于因视觉或语言困难而非常难以翻译的文本，也可以考虑将其加入pool #11363: Translation Request - LUNATIC Mode。 当未翻译的文本不是日语时，请额外为其加上相应语言的标签。 语言（ [[tag group:text]] ） [[Chinese text]] — {{chinese_text translation_request}} [[Korean text]] — {{korean_text translation_request}} [[Finnish text]] — {{finnish_text translation_request}} [[French text]] — {{french_text translation_request}} [[German text]] —

tags.name: photoshop_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or compiled with Adobe Photoshop. For when the software itself is depicted in the image, use [[Adobe Photoshop]] instead. Not to be confused with [[third-party edit]] (aka "Photoshopped"), which refers to an image that were edited by someone else that's not the artist. See also
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 Adobe Photoshop 创作或合成的图片。 当图片中描绘的是该软件本身时，请改用 [[Adobe Photoshop]] 。 不要与 [[third-party edit]] （又称“Photoshopped”）混淆，后者指由作者以外的人编辑过的图片。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：Adobe Photoshop

tags.name: translated
tags.summary: A post that has been fully translated into English. See [[translation request]] for untranslated posts. This tag only applies to fully translated posts. If the translation is incomplete or needs review, use [[partially translated]] or [[check translation]] instead. When the post is fully translated,
tags.wiki_zh: 指已被完整翻译成英文的帖子。未翻译的帖子见 [[translation request]] 。 本标签仅适用于已完整翻译的帖子。如果翻译不完整或需要校对，请改用 [[partially translated]] 或 [[check translation]] 。当帖子已完整翻译时，移除 [[translation request]] 标签并添加 [[translated]] 。 此外，对于注释内容非常少且不重要的帖子，可以省略 [[translated]] 标签，例如单个拟声词即使不翻译也可以（这类情况可改用 [[sound effect request]] ）。比这更实质的内容都应标注 [[translated]] 。 如果对话已完整翻译但仍有音效未翻译，该帖子可以同时标注 [[translated]] 和 [[sound effect request]] 。 关于如何翻译的指南见 [[howto:translate]] 。 相关标签 [[alternate language]] [[check translation]] [[hard-translated]] [[hard-translated (non-english)]] [[partially translated]] [[poorly translated]] [[fake translation]] [[reverse translation]] [[sound effect request]] [[translation note]] [[translation request]] 另见 [[help:note formatting]] [[help:notes]] [[howto:translate]]

tags.name: official_art
tags.summary: Artwork that is made by the official company/artist of a series or character. May have the [[copyright name|copyright]] , [[company name|company]] , or [[artist name|artist]] names emblazoned somewhere on the picture, as well as a [[copyright notice]] . Not to be confused with [[official style]] , w
tags.wiki_zh: 由某个系列或角色的官方公司／画师所创作的插画。图片上的某个位置可能印有 [[copyright name|copyright]] 、 [[company name|company]] 或 [[artist name|artist]] 名称，以及 [[copyright notice]] 。 不要与 [[official style]] 混淆，后者是指同人图模仿官方画风；也不要与 [[official artist extra]] 混淆，后者是指由官方画师绘制的非官方同人图。 示例 [[Key visual]] [[Novel illustration]] [[Official wallpaper]] 另见 [[concept art]] [[guest art]] [[key visual]] [[novel illustration]] [[official artist extra]] [[official wallpaper]] [[production art]]

tags.name: commission
tags.summary: An image that was drawn as a paid commission, i.e. when someone hires an artist to draw for them. Make sure the word 'commission' is visible in the image, or is mentioned in artist commentary, if you have no other proof. Commissions can sometimes be abbreviated as "comm", "com", "cm" and other possi
tags.wiki_zh: 作为付费委托而绘制的图片，即某人雇佣画师为其作画。 如果没有其他证据，请确保图片中可见“commission”字样，或在画师的附言中提及。委托有时会缩写为“comm”、“com”、“cm”以及其他可能的缩写。有时委托也可能被称为“request”，尤其是在日本画师的翻译中。 如果该投稿是在特定网站上委托的，请添加该网站对应的标签。如果你自己委托了该投稿，请添加 [[commissioner upload]] 。 此标签用于个人委托；对于面向公司的委托、商业作品或其他已有版权的情况，请改用 [[official art]] 。 委托网站 [[ko-fi commission]] [[pixiv commission]] [[skeb commission]] [[vgen commission]] [[fiverr commission]] [[skima commission]] [[mihuashi commission]] [[crepe commission]] 另见 [[art trade]] [[commissioner insert]] [[commissioner name]] [[commissioner upload]] [[gift art]] [[guest art]] [[request inset]] [[second-party source]] [[third-party source]] [[fan request]]

tags.name: untranslatable_commentary
tags.summary: A [[commentary]] that has no translatable text or that cannot be translated. This includes commentaries that contain only symbols, [[emoji]] s, [[emoticon]] s, numbers, dates, URLs, [[ASCII art]] , hashtags, or other things that need no translation, as well as commentaries where the only text is mea
tags.wiki_zh: 没有可翻译文本或无法翻译的 [[commentary]] 。 这包括仅包含符号、 [[emoji]] 、 [[emoticon]] 、数字、日期、URL、 [[ASCII art]] 、话题标签或其他无需翻译内容的解说，也包括其中唯一的文字是无法翻译的无意义 [[gibberish commentary|gibberish]] 的解说。 另见 [[Dated commentary]] [[Hashtag-only commentary]] [[Gibberish commentary]] [[ASCII art commentary]] [[Help:Artist commentary]]

tags.name: chinese_commentary
tags.summary: Artist [[commentary]] that include [[Chinese text]] . Note that simply containing kanji (Chinese characters) does not qualify, as it could still be Japanese text.
tags.wiki_zh: 艺术家 [[commentary]] ，其中包含 [[Chinese text]] 。 请注意，仅仅包含汉字（中文字符）并不符合条件，因为它仍有可能是日文文本。

tags.name: bad_twitter_id
tags.summary: A Twitter post or picture that is no longer publicly available. See also [[Bad ID]] [[MD5 mismatch]] [[Twitter sample]] [[Corrupted Twitter file]]
tags.wiki_zh: 不再公开可见的推特帖子或图片。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[MD5 mismatch]] [[Twitter sample]] [[Corrupted Twitter file]]

tags.name: variant_set
tags.summary: A set of images consisting of a base image and one or more alternate versions. If the set contains 6 or more images, use [[large variant set]] . The alternate versions should be variations of the base image, with the character's basic pose and position staying mostly the same. Common examples of var
tags.wiki_zh: 由一张基础图和一张或多张替代版本组成的一组图片。如果该套图包含6张或更多图片，请使用 [[large variant set]] 。 替代版本应为基础图的变体，角色的基本姿势和位置大体保持不变。差分套图的常见例子包括： 不同的服装、 outfits，或不同阶段的脱衣状态 不同的面部表情 性行为的不同阶段 文字和 [[textless version]] 为连续对话而更换 [[speech bubble]] 姿势的轻微变化（通常只是四肢） 差分套图必须包含画师有意的、显著的改动。 [[Revision]] 、 [[duplicate]] 以及压缩/未压缩版本不算在内。 不要与 [[variations]] 混淆，后者是指在同一张图片内的多种变体。 示例 另见 [[large variant set]] [[variant set available]] [[textless version]] [[clothes on and off]] [[fixed-point camera]] [[tachi-e]]

tags.name: korean_commentary
tags.summary: Artist [[commentary]] that is written in [[korean_text|Korean]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 用 [[commentary]] 书写的画师 [[korean_text|Korean]] 。

tags.name: non-web_source
tags.summary: A post whose source is plain text, rather than a link to the website where it originally came from. This includes file uploads, where the source is simply the filename used by the uploader, and posts where the source is a written description of where the image came from. Written descriptions are oft
tags.wiki_zh: 来源为纯文本，而非指向其原始出处网站链接的帖子。 这包括文件上传（此时来源仅仅是上传者使用的文件名），以及来源为对图片出处的文字描述的帖子。文字描述常用于 [[self-scan]] 、 [[self-upload]] 、 [[commissioner upload]] 和 [[self-datamine]] 的游戏素材。这些东西没有来源链接，因为它们来自线下来源而非其他网站。 应尽可能避免使用非网络来源。如果你是从某个网站获取的图片，应附上你获取该图片的网站链接。对于从其他网站获取的任何内容，包括 [[scan]] 和游戏素材，不要使用文字描述或文件名。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着在上传页面你应粘贴你找到该文件的链接，而不是从你的电脑上传文件。Danbooru支持从大多数网站上传，因此在大多数情况下，无需先将文件下载到电脑再上传到Danbooru。如果你不记得它来自哪里，请先进行以图搜图以尝试找到来源。详情见 [[help:upload]] 。 你可以通过搜索{{non-web_source source:file://*}}来查找文件上传，或通过{{non-web_source -source:file://*}}来查找带有文字描述的帖子。 此标签为自动添加。完全{{source:none|no source}}的帖子不包含在此标签下。 另见 [[imageboard desourced]] [[source request]] [[scan]] [[self-scan]] [[self-upload]] [[self-datamine]] [[commissioner upload]] [[help:image source]]

tags.name: game_asset
tags.summary: An illustration or [[animated]] asset extracted from a video game. They are most commonly from eroge or visual novels, but other type of games CGs are included in the tag as well. Do not use this tag if an image is from an artists' social media rather than extracted from a game, even if the artwork
tags.wiki_zh: 从电子游戏中提取的插图或 [[animated]] 素材。它们最常见于工口游戏或视觉小说，但其他类型的游戏CG也包含在此标签中。 如果图片来自画师的社交媒体而非从游戏中提取，即使该作画能在游戏中找到，也不要使用此标签。 另见 [[visual novel cg]] [[game screenshot]] [[loading screen]] [[self-datamine]] [[variant set]] [[tachi-e]] [[Tag group:Metatags]]

tags.name: partial_commentary
tags.summary: An artist [[commentary]] that has been partially translated (usually the artwork's title). Partially translated commentaries should be tagged [[commentary request]] , not [[commentary]] . See also [[partially translated]]
tags.wiki_zh: 已被部分翻译（通常是作品标题）的画师 [[commentary]] 。 部分翻译的评论应打上 [[commentary request]] 标签，而不是 [[commentary]] 。 另见 [[partially translated]]

tags.name: artist_request
tags.summary: A request for the artist of a post. Do not use this tag if there is a source available, such as the artist's homepage, blog, Pixiv, etc. Read [[Help:Artists]] and create a new artist tag yourself, or ask for help in topic #8199: Artist tagging help. It might be possible to find the artist with the h
tags.wiki_zh: 对帖子画师的求助请求。 如果有可用的来源，例如画师的主页、博客、Pixiv 等，请勿使用此标签。请阅读 [[Help:Artists]] 并自行创建新的画师标签，或在 topic #8199：Artist tagging help 中寻求帮助。 可以借助以图搜图引擎的帮助找到画师（见 [[Help:Image source]] ）。 对于图版之外的匿名画师，也请使用此标签。 另见 [[source request]] [[tagme]]

tags.name: animated
tags.summary: An animated sequence, whether an [[animated gif]] , [[animated png]] , [[flash]] , [[ugoira]] , or [[video]] file. This tag is automatically added by Danbooru. Related tags Formats [[animated gif]] [[animated png]] [[flash]] [[ugoira]] [[video]] Types [[60+fps]] [[looping animation]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一段动态序列，无论是 [[animated gif]] 、 [[animated png]] 、 [[flash]] 、 [[ugoira]] 还是 [[video]] 文件。 此标签由Danbooru自动添加。 相关标签 格式 [[animated gif]] [[animated png]] [[flash]] [[ugoira]] [[video]] 类型 [[60+fps]] [[looping animation]] [[non-repeating animation]] [[roulette animation]] [[slideshow animation]] 另见 [[sound]] [[Tag Group:Drawing Software]] [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: paid_reward_available
tags.summary: Indicates that the artist has an alternate version of the post, or materials relating to the post, available as a [[paid reward]] . It may also be used when a [[cropped|free preview]] or variant is uploaded, mentioning that the full unobstructed version or set can be obtained on a subscription platf
tags.wiki_zh: 表示画师有该帖子的差分版本，或与该帖子相关的素材，可作为 [[paid reward]] 获取。当上传的是 [[cropped|free preview]] 或变体版本，并注明完整无遮挡版本或套图可在订阅平台上获取时，也可以使用本标签。 一般来说，画师会在帖子的 [[commentary]] 中给出特典链接。 对于销售实体周边的作品，参见 [[promotional art]] 和 [[figure available]] 。 另见 [[Paywall cliffhanger]]

tags.name: traditional_media
tags.summary: An illustration created with traditional tools without using a computer, such as pencil, markers, or paint. This is in contrast with "digital media", which dominate Danbooru. Use this tag only if you're sure that the image is actually made by hand. Beware that some artists will tag their work as tra
tags.wiki_zh: 指不使用电脑，仅用铅笔、马克笔或颜料等传统工具创作的插画。这与在Danbooru上占主导地位的“数字媒介”形成对比。 只有在确定图像确实为手工制作时，才使用此标签。请注意，有些作者会将其作品标注为传统媒介，但按我们的标签标准并不符合。对于模仿手绘/非CG风格的数字图像，请使用 [[faux traditional media]] 。 请使用 [[mixed media]] 来标记部分为传统制作、但同时还包含一些数字元素（例如数字 [[spot color]] ）的图像。为修正作品扫描件或照片中的问题而进行的轻微数字编辑或色彩校正，而非作为作品的创作性元素，不会使图像成为 [[mixed media]] 。 如果图像是作品的照片，而非作品的扫描件，则适用 [[photo (medium)]] 标签。 对于非绘画类的实体艺术品，参见 [[unconventional media]] 。 示例 [[Oil painting (medium)|]] [[Marker (medium)|]] [[Graphite (medium)|]] 相关标签 [[acrylic paint (medium)]] [[airbrush (medium)]] [[ballpoint pen (medium)]] [[brush (medium)]] [[chalk (medium)]] [[calligraphy brush (medium)]] [[painting (medium)|]] [[charcoal (medium)]] [[colored pencil (medium)]] [[color ink (medium)]] [[coupy pencil (medium)]] [[crayon (medium)]] [[gouache (medium)]]

tags.name: copyright_request
tags.summary: A request to identify the copyright tag of a post. Do not use for posts that are most likely [[original]] and don't have a copyright. Only use when you are reasonably sure the post is from a known copyright, but you don't know what it is. Use [[check copyright]] if you are not sure about the copyrig
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨识帖子版权标签的请求。 对于很可能是 [[original]] 且没有版权的帖子请勿使用。仅在你相当确定该帖子出自某个已知版权，但不知道具体是什么时使用。 如果你不确定帖子的版权，请使用 [[check copyright]] 。 另请参见 [[artist request]] [[character request]] [[source request]]

tags.name: md5_mismatch
tags.summary: A post that doesn't exactly match the post at the source. A post can be a MD5 mismatch for several possible reasons: The file was modified by the uploader, for example, by editing it or resaving it. Uploaders shouldn't modify files. The file was [[revision|revised]] by the artist. The revised versio
tags.wiki_zh: 与来源处的投稿并不完全一致的投稿。 投稿出现MD5不匹配可能有以下几种原因： 文件被投稿者修改过，例如，经过了编辑或重新保存。投稿者不应该修改文件。 文件被画师 [[revision|revised]] 了。修改后的版本可能会作为新的投稿上传。 文件是 [[image sample]] 。请在topic #16765中请求用完整版本替换该文件。 文件被来源网站修改过，例如，被重新压缩成了更低的质量。对此无能为力。 来源并非该文件最初的出处。投稿者是从其他来源获取的文件。应将来源更改为指向原始出处。 MD5哈希是一种用于判断两个文件是否相同的签名。MD5哈希相同 的两个文件是完全相同的。MD5哈希不同的两个文件则是不同的文件，即使它们看起来一样。它们可能存在肉眼无法察觉的差异，例如不同的图像压缩或质量水平，或不同的图像元数据。 此标签由机器人自动添加。 另请参见 [[bad id]] [[image sample]] [[resized]] [[resolution mismatch]] [[revision]] [[source mismatch]] [[has bad revision]]

tags.name: skeb_commission
tags.summary: A work [[commission]] ed on [[Skeb (site)|]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 一件 [[commission]] 于 [[Skeb (site)|]] 的作品。

tags.name: lowres
tags.summary: An image less than 500 pixels wide or tall. Approximately equivalent to {{mpixels:<=0.25}}. This tag is [[help:autotags|automatically]] added to images. See also [[lowres]] (500×500 or smaller) [[highres]] (at least 1600×1200) [[absurdres]] (at least 3200×2400) [[incredibly absurdres]] (any dimensio
tags.wiki_zh: 宽或高小于500像素的图片。大致相当于{{mpixels:<=0.25}}。 该标签会被 [[help:autotags|automatically]] 添加到图片上。 另见 [[lowres]] （500×500或更小） [[highres]] （至少1600×1200） [[absurdres]] （至少3200×2400） [[incredibly absurdres]] （任一边超过10,000） [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: large_variant_set
tags.summary: A post that is part of a [[variant set]] containing 6 or more images. Large variant sets have the same rules and requirements as regular variant sets. See [[variant set]] for correct usage. For excessively large variant sets and/or ones that require a specific viewing order, consider creating a
tags.wiki_zh: 属于包含6张或以上图片的 [[variant set]] 的一张投稿。 大型差分套装与普通差分套装遵循相同的规则和要求。正确用法参见 [[variant set]] 。 对于过大型的差分套装和/或需要特定浏览顺序的差分套装，建议同时创建一个 [[help:pools|pool]] 。

tags.name: third-party_source
tags.summary: A post sourced from any site other than the original artist or (official) source provider. This includes instances of [[official art]] and [[game asset]] s that are reuploaded elsewhere online. Typically, this is a post sourced to another imageboard, booru, or wiki, rather than to the original artis
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源为原始作者或（官方）来源提供方之外的任何网站的帖子。这包括在网上其他地方被重新上传的 [[official art]] 和 [[game asset]] 实例。 通常，这是指来源指向另一个图像板、booru或wiki，而非指向原始作者的帖子。 如果帖子来源于盗取并转载其他画师作品的账号，无论是有意还是无意，也可以打上此标签。从疑似盗图者账号上传帖子时请谨慎。 另见 [[non-web source]] [[second-party source]] [[imageboard first-party source]]

tags.name: second-party_source
tags.summary: A post that, rather than sourced directly from the artist, is sourced to someone who posted it on the artist's behalf. Examples include: [[Official art]] s posted by a company in which the original artist is affliated with or by a copyright's official social media. [[Commission]] s posted to the com
tags.wiki_zh: 指并非由画师本人直接发布，而是由代画师发布的人所发布的投稿。 示例包括： 由原画师所属公司或版权方官方社交媒体发布的 [[Official art]] 。 发布在约稿人自己的账号上，而不是画师账号上的 [[Commission]] 。 如果 [[commission]] 是由约稿人本人上传到 Danbooru 的，请改用 [[commissioner upload]] 。 画师之间在对方账号上互相发布的 [[Artist collaboration]] 。 由收礼方发布的 [[Gift art]] 。 在自己账号上发布他人作品的 [[Virtual Youtuber]] 。 在画师知情的情况下，由画师的导师或老师代画师发布的作品。 该标签的目的是指出，发布作品的人并非创作者，但其发布是经过创作者许可的。 另见 [[self-upload]] （即 [[first-party source]] ） [[third-party source]]

tags.name: scan
tags.summary: An image that was scanned from a physical medium such as a [[poster (medium)|]] , [[artbook]] , or [[magazine scan|magazine]] . When uploading a scan you didn't make yourself, the source should be left as the site where you obtained the scan from, not the title of the magazine or book. When uploadin
tags.wiki_zh: 从 [[poster (medium)|]] 、 [[artbook]] 或 [[magazine scan|magazine]] 等实体媒介上扫描而来的图片。 上传非自己制作的扫描图时，来源应填写你获得该扫描图的网站，而不是杂志或书籍的标题。上传自己制作的扫描图时，请打上 [[self-scan]] 标签。 如果是拍摄而非扫描的图片，参见 [[photo (medium)]] 。这种情况常见于使用 [[traditional media]] 的画师发布自己作品的照片时。 如果图片只是通过绘画技法做成像扫描图的样子，参见 [[fake scan]] 。 示例 相关标签 伪影 [[binding discoloration]] [[bleed through]] [[color halftone]] [[color issue]] [[crease]] [[cropped]] [[scan artifacts]] [[scan dust]] 修改 [[cleaned]] [[detexted]] [[fixed]] [[stitched]] [[third-party edit]] [[magazine request]] 来源 [[artbook]] [[magazine scan]] [[novel illustration]] [[official art]] [[poster (medium)]] [[production art]] [[cover]] ，包括 [[album cover]] [[cd (source)]] [[video game cover]] [[dvd cover]] [[blu-ray cover]] [[magazine cover]] 另见 [[fake scan]] [[self-scan]] [[photo (medium)]]

tags.name: mixed-language_commentary
tags.summary: Artist's commentary using multiple languages. For example, when translating / quoting in the original comment. Don't forget to add all the corresponding language tags if possible, see [[commentary]] for all the language tags available.
tags.wiki_zh: 使用多种语言的作者评论。 例如，在翻译/引用原始评论时。 如果可能的话，别忘了添加所有相应的语言标签，所有可用的语言标签请参见 [[commentary]] 。

tags.name: video
tags.summary: A post that is a video. Supported formats Danbooru only supports the following file formats and codecs: [th]Container[/th][th]Video[/th][th]Audio[/th] WebMVP8, VP9, AV1Vorbis, Opus MP4AVC (H.264), HEVC (H.265), VP9, AV1MP3, AAC, Opus Additionally, 10-bit color (HDR) and 4:4:4 chroma subsampling are
tags.wiki_zh: 作为视频的投稿。 支持的格式 Danbooru 仅支持以下文件格式和编码： [th]容器[/th][th]视频[/th][th]音频[/th] WebMVP8、VP9、AV1Vorbis、Opus MP4AVC (H.264)、HEVC (H.265)、VP9、AV1MP3、AAC、Opus 此外，不支持 10-bit 色深（HDR）和 4:4:4 色度抽样。 视频的时长限制为 2:20。你可以在“这个帖子。”:/forum_topics/14647 中请求上传长视频 另见 [[animated]] [[longer video available]] [[sound]] [[transcoded]] {{filetype:webm}} {{filetype:mp4}}

tags.name: revision
tags.summary: An image that has been altered by the artist to make corrections to it. The changes may be minor, such as fixing [[artistic error]] s or [[bad proportions]] , or they may be major, such as adding [[censored|censorship]] or [[watermark]] s. This tag should only be used when there is a difference betw
tags.wiki_zh: 一张经画师修改以进行修正的图片。改动可能是小幅的，例如修正 [[artistic error]] 或 [[bad proportions]] ，也可能是大幅的，例如添加 [[censored|censorship]] 或 [[watermark]] 。 只有当图片内容之间存在差异时，才能使用该标签。仅在分辨率或压缩程度上有差异的图片是 [[duplicate]] ，而不是修正版。属于有意制作的一组差分图的图片是 [[variant set]] 。 如果未经修正的原始图片在Danbooru上不存在，也不应使用该标签。 如果一幅投稿被完全重画，请改用 [[redrawn]] 。 示例 修正版（改变了角色身高） 未经修正的原图 另请参见 [[md5 mismatch]] [[duplicate]] [[has bad revision]] （当有修正版可用，但其质量不如Danbooru上已有的图片时） [[has censored revision]] （当有修正版可用，但其被和谐了，很可能是因为画师不小心发布了未和谐版本） [[variant set]] [[unfinished]] [[redrawn]]

tags.name: character_request
tags.summary: A request to identify a character in the post. Do not use for [[original]] characters that probably don't have a name or character tag. Only use when you are reasonably sure the character is a known character from a known copyright, but you don't know who the character is. Use [[check character]] to
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨认帖子中的角色。 对于可能没有名字或角色标签的 [[original]] 角色，请勿使用此标签。仅在你相当确定该角色是来自已知版权的已知角色，但你不知道该角色是谁时使用。 如果你对角色标签不确定，请使用 [[check character]] 来请求核实。 另见 [[copyright request]] [[cosplay request]]

tags.name: bad_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to the image, rather than the page containing the image. For example, a Twitter image link instead of the Twitter post. The Twitter post is preferred because it's not possible to get to the Twitter post from the Twitter image. If you see this warning on the uploa
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源是图片的直链，而非包含该图片的页面的投稿。例如，推特图片链接而不是推特帖子。推荐使用推特帖子，因为无法从推特图片跳转到推特帖子。 如果你在上传页面看到此警告，意味着你应该上传包含该图片的页面，而不是图片本身。 与 [[bad id]] （来源已被删除）和 [[bad source]] （链接并非指向原图）作对比。 可以直接转换为包含图片的页面的图片链接，例如Pixiv图片链接，不计入此标签。 坏链列表 [[Bad 4chan link]] [[Bad About.me link]] [[Bad Adobe Portfolio link]] [[Bad Ameba link]] [[Bad Arca.live link]] [[Bad ArtStation link]] [[Bad Baidu link]] [[Bad Baraag link]] [[Bad Bilibili link]] [[Bad Blogspot link]] [[Bad BlueSky link]] [[Bad Booth link]] [[Bad Carrd link]] [[Bad Ci-en link]] [[Bad DC Inside link]] [[Bad DeviantArt link]] [[Bad Discord link]] [[Bad DLSite link]] [[Bad Dotpict link]] [[Bad E-Hentai link]] [[Bad Facebook link]] [[Bad Fanbox link]] [[Bad Fandom link]] [[Bad Fantia link]] [[Bad Flickr link]] [[Bad FurAffinity link]] [[Bad Galleria link]]

tags.name: self-datamine
tags.summary: A [[game asset]] that was extracted from the game by the uploader. These assets will have a [[non-web source]] because they come from an offline source instead of a website. See also [[self-upload]] [[self-scan]]
tags.wiki_zh: 由上传者从游戏中提取的 [[game asset]] 。 这些素材会带有 [[non-web source]] ，因为它们来自线下来源而非网站。 另见 [[self-upload]] [[self-scan]]

tags.name: spoilers
tags.summary: Information that spoils the plot or ending of a work of fiction. As a tag, denotes that the picture contains spoilers. Please keep gratuitous spoilers out of wiki pages, and mark spoilers in comments or forum posts with spoiler goes here tags. See also [[canon event]] [[fake spoilers]] External link
tags.wiki_zh: 会剧透虚构作品剧情或结局的信息。作为标签，表示该图片包含剧透内容。 请不要在Wiki页面中加入无谓的剧透，并在评论或论坛帖子中的剧透部分使用spoiler标签进行标记。 另请参见 [[canon event]] [[fake spoilers]] 外部链接 维基百科：Spoiler 日文维基百科：Spoiler

tags.name: visual_novel_cg
tags.summary: Art used as a background for the dialogue in visual novels. Traditionally visual novels were made of fixed art with barely moving sprites, and the only changing part of the software was the dialog. This tag is for those backgrounds, which may or may not contain sprites. For individual sprites, see [
tags.wiki_zh: 用作视觉小说中对话背景的美术。 传统视觉小说由几乎不动的固定立绘构成，软件中唯一变化的部分就是对话。此标签用于指代那些背景，其中可能包含立绘，也可能不包含。 单独的立绘，参见 [[tachi-e]] 。 示例

tags.name: pixiv_commission
tags.summary: A work [[commission]] ed via pixiv Requests.
tags.wiki_zh: 通过pixiv Requests获得的 [[commission]] 作品。

tags.name: check_translation
tags.summary: The post has been either fully [[translated]] or [[partially translated]] into English, but a second opinion is needed. This is to ensure the translation is most correct. Any mistakes seen can be corrected. Do not use this tag as an excuse for substandard translations. Translators are expected to be
tags.wiki_zh: 该帖子已被完整 [[translated]] 或 [[partially translated]] 成英文，但需要第二人复核。这是为了确保翻译尽可能准确。发现的任何错误都可以修正。 不要以此标签作为低质量翻译的借口。译者应对自己所翻译的语言有把握，新手译者不应尝试翻译超出自己能力范围的内容。根据 [[howto:translate]] ，糟糕的翻译比没有翻译更糟。 相关标签 [[hard-translated]] [[partially translated]] [[poorly translated]] [[translated]] [[translation request]] 另见 [[check commentary]] [[howto:translate]]

tags.name: duplicate
tags.summary: A post that is the same or inferior to an already existing post. This tag only applies to inferior posts that were uploaded after an already existing identical post. Duplicates should not be confused for the following: [[image sample]] , a compressed or downscaled image typically used by sites to lo
tags.wiki_zh: 与已存在的稿件相同或质量更低的稿件。该标签仅适用于在已存在相同稿件之后上传的、低质量的稿件。 不应将重复图片与以下情况混淆： [[image sample]] ，一种经过压缩或缩小尺寸的图片，通常被网站用来加快图片加载速度。 [[md5 mismatch]] ，其 md5 与源站文件不同的稿件。 [[revision]] ，作者在先前版本基础上修改过的稿件。 [[variant set]] ，基础相似但存在非细微差异的稿件。 [[scan]] ，从其他来源扫描得到的稿件。 [[cropped]] ，另一张可能已公开或为 [[paid reward available|through payment]] 的图片中的较小局部。 适用该标签的几种情况： 视觉上完全相同但元数据不同的 [[Pixel-perfect duplicate]] 。 [[Downscaled]] 或 [[resized]] 稿件。注意，重复的缩放稿件不应打上 [[md5 mismatch]] 标签。 总体质量较低的图片；通常是 [[jpeg artifacts]] 导致的结果。 [[Has bad revision|Bad revisions]] 。 在上传之前，请使用 IQDB 以图搜图或“Find similar”按钮检查是否已经有人上传过。 重复图片必须手动打标签。目前没有能准确自动标记重复图片的系统，因为很容易将其与上述情况混淆（已上传原图的 [[image sample]] 除外）。 [[Pixel-perfect duplicate]] 可能会被无条件自动添加到新稿件上；关于如何检查或如何对自动添加该标签提出异议，请参阅其 wiki。 准则 如果唯一的理由是该稿件为重复图片，请不要将其标记为删除。应将其父稿件设为质量更高的图片。 存在视觉差异（ [[variant_set|variants]]

tags.name: sound
tags.summary: A [[video]] or [[Flash]] file with audible sound. For written onomatopoeia use [[sound effects]] instead. This tag is automatically added by Danbooru to [[video]] s with audible sound. See also [[audible music]] [[audible speech]] [[music video]] [[vocal synthesizer audio]] [[volume warning]]
tags.wiki_zh: 带有可听见声音的 [[video]] 或 [[Flash]] 文件。书写形式的拟声词请改用 [[sound effects]] 。 此标签由Danbooru自动添加到带有可听见声音的 [[video]] 上。 另见 [[audible music]] [[audible speech]] [[music video]] [[vocal synthesizer audio]] [[volume warning]]

tags.name: protected_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is only visible to certain users. This includes posts that are followers-only, login-only, password-protected, region-locked, or other forms of limiting access by the artist. This can include limiting the picture to certain sizes only, to flat-out denying access to the picture at
tags.wiki_zh: 来源仅对特定用户可见的帖子。包括仅粉丝可见、仅限登录、密码保护、地区锁定，或画师采取的其他限制访问形式。 这可以包括仅将图片限制为特定尺寸，到完全拒绝访问该图片。 这不包括被画师删除的帖子（ [[bad id]] ）或 [[paid reward]] 。 另请参阅 [[bad id]] [[inactive account]] [[paid reward]]

tags.name: source_request
tags.summary: No source for the image is known, but is desired by one or more members. See [[help:image source]] for more information on how to source an image. See Also [[help:image source]] [[artist request]] [[character request]] [[copyright request]] [[bad id]] [[bad source]]
tags.wiki_zh: 图像的来源未知，但有一名或多名成员希望得知。 关于如何为图像寻找来源的更多信息，请参见 [[help:image source]] 。 另请参阅 [[help:image source]] [[artist request]] [[character request]] [[copyright request]] [[bad id]] [[bad source]]

tags.name: resolution_mismatch
tags.summary: When the image resolution on Danbooru differs from the image resolution at the source. The following two tags can be used with this tag. [[source_smaller]] : One or both dimensions must be larger than the source. height_source <= height_danbooru and width_source <= width_danbooru [[source_larger]] :
tags.wiki_zh: 当 Danbooru 上的图片分辨率与来源处的图片分辨率不同时使用。以下两个标签可与本标签配合使用。 [[source_smaller]] ： 一维或两维尺寸都必须大于来源。 height_source <= height_danbooru and width_source <= width_danbooru [[source_larger]] ： 一维或两维尺寸都必须小于来源。 height_source >= height_danbooru and width_source >= width_danbooru 两者皆非： 一维尺寸大于来源，而另一维尺寸小于来源。 (height_source > height_danbooru and width_source < width_danbooru) or (height_source < height_danbooru and width_source > width_danbooru) 另请参见 [[image sample]] [[md5 mismatch]]

tags.name: painting_(medium)
tags.summary: A painting made with [[acrylic paint (medium)|]] , [[gouache (medium)|]] , [[oil painting (medium)|oils]] , [[watercolor (medium)|watercolors]] , or any other kind of [[traditional media|traditional]] painting medium.
tags.wiki_zh: 用 [[acrylic paint (medium)|]] 、 [[gouache (medium)|]] 、 [[oil painting (medium)|oils]] 、 [[watercolor (medium)|watercolors]] 或任何其他种类的 [[traditional media|traditional]] 绘画媒介制作的绘画。

tags.name: self-upload
tags.summary: An image that was posted on Danbooru by its own creator. If the image was posted directly to Danbooru without being posted anywhere else first, it will also have a [[non-web source]] . Self-uploads are allowed on Danbooru, but be aware that Danbooru is a moderated site and uploads may be deleted if
tags.wiki_zh: 由创作者本人发布到 Danbooru 上的图片。 如果该图片是直接发布到 Danbooru，而没有先发布到其他地方，那么它还会有 [[non-web source]] 。 Danbooru 允许自传，但请注意 Danbooru 是有审核的网站，如果上传内容 [[off-topic]] 或质量不够高，可能会被删除。详情请见 [[help:upload]] 和 [[help:mod queue]] 。对比 {{自传 is:active}} 与 {{自传 is:deleted}} 可以大致了解预期的质量水平。 另见 [[commissioner upload]] [[self-scan]] [[self-datamine]] [[artist-provided artwork]]

tags.name: inactive_account
tags.summary: A post whose source is unavailable because the artist's account is suspended, deactivated or deleted. Not to be confused with [[bad id]] - although the two tags largely overlap, some platforms may keep posts accessible. [[Bad ID]] is about deleted sources while [[inactive account]] is about deleted
tags.wiki_zh: 来源不可用的投稿，因为画师的账号已被冻结、停用或删除。不要与 [[bad id]] 混淆——尽管这两个标签在很大程度上重叠，但某些平台可能会保留投稿的可访问性。 [[Bad ID]] 是关于已删除的来源，而 [[inactive account]] 是关于已删除的账号。 对于 [[bad twitter id|Twitter]] ，如果帖子链接显示信息：“This Post is from a suspended account”，即可判断为这种情况。 对于 [[bad tumblr id|Tumblr]] ，可以从博客的URL中看出，因为URL末尾会附加-deactivated，后跟停用的日期。 另请参见 [[bad id]] [[protected link]]

tags.name: third-party_edit
tags.summary: An image that has been edited by someone other than the artist (a third party). Third-party edits are generally against the [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] and should not be uploaded. This includes: [[nude filter]] s [[headshop]] s [[fake translation]] s [[third-party watermark]] s Fanmade meme o
tags.wiki_zh: 指由画师本人之外的他人（第三方）进行过编辑的图片。 第三方修改一般违反 [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] ，不应上传。这包括： [[nude filter]] [[headshop]] [[fake translation]] [[third-party watermark]] 同人制作的梗图或搞笑修改 去除画师签名或水印 其他大幅改变图片内容的行为 在特定情况下，不大幅改变图片内容的轻微编辑可能是允许的。这包括经过 [[stitched]] 、 [[colorized]] 、 [[cleaned]] 、 [[detexted]] 的投稿，或者如果被 [[scan]] ，仅轻微 [[cropped]] 过的投稿。如果是为了遵守 Danbooru 服务条款而进行的第三方修改，也可能被允许（参见 [[ToS compliance edit]] ）。 另见 [[Second-party edit]] - 有第二方（如 [[commission]] 或任何获得画师许可的人）参与图片编辑的情况。 [[Photoshop (medium)]] - 当 Adobe Photoshop 确实被画师用于创作图片时，使用此标签 [[help:upload rules]]

tags.name: textless_version
tags.summary: An alternate version of an image without text. Generally applies to explicit images that remove the dialogue after the illustration is complete, or to [[cover|covers]] that don't have the title or any [[content rating]] information. This tag is for text-free alternate versions released by the origin
tags.wiki_zh: 图片的无文字替代版本。一般适用于在插画完成后去掉对话的色情图片，或适用于 [[cover|covers]] ，其没有标题，也没有任何 [[content rating]] 信息。 本标签用于原作者发布的无文字替代版本。请使用 [[detexted]] 来标记文字被 [[third-party edit]] 去掉的图片。 另见 [[textless cover page]] [[detexted]] [[variant set]] [[large variant set]]

tags.name: jpeg_artifacts
tags.summary: A kind of compression artifact. These can be visible as blockiness and noise (mosquito noise and are usually seen in areas with high contrast, such as near lines. This tag should be used for images where these artifacts are noticeable when viewed normally, without zooming in or enhancing the contras
tags.wiki_zh: 一种压缩失真。可以表现为块状和噪点（蚊式噪声），通常出现在高对比度区域，例如线条附近。 此标签应用于在正常查看时（无需放大或增强对比度）就能注意到这些失真的图片。 示例 故意夸大的失真 左：无失真 右：有失真 (post #10154238) 另见 [[aliasing]] [[dithering]] [[duplicate]] [[intentional JPEG artifacts]] [[lossy-lossless]] [[scan artifacts]] [[Tag group:Image composition]] 外部链接 维基百科：Compression artifact

tags.name: photo_(medium)
tags.summary: An image taken by a camera. Don't use this tag when a drawing of a "photo" appears in an image. Use [[photo (object)]] instead. Most types of photographs are [[off-topic]] for Danbooru. The most common exceptions are photos of [[traditional media|traditional artwork]] , photos of anime art (often wi
tags.wiki_zh: 由相机拍摄的图像。 当图片中出现的是画出来的“照片”时，不要使用此标签。请改用 [[photo (object)]] 。 大多数类型的照片在Danbooru上都是 [[off-topic]] 。最常见的例外是 [[traditional media|traditional artwork]] 的照片、动漫美术作品的照片（通常带有 [[art tools in frame]] ），或 [[cosplay photo]] 。详情请见 [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] 。 示例 [[Traditional media]] [[Figure (medium)]] [[Cosplay photo]] 另见 [[cosplay photo]] [[traditional media]] [[photo inset]] [[photo background]] [[reference photo]] [[photo-referenced]]

tags.name: pixel-perfect_duplicate
tags.summary: A post that is completely identical to its parent down to the pixel and was either posted after another post with the same Pixel Hash or has no source while their parent does, and thus is inferior for Danbooru purposes. If a PNG is a pixel-perfect duplicate of a JPEG, [[lossy-lossless]] may also app
tags.wiki_zh: 与父帖子在像素层面完全相同，且要么发布于另一个具有相同Pixel Hash的帖子之后，要么自身没有来源而其父帖子有来源，因此对于Danbooru而言质量较差的帖子。 如果一张PNG与一张JPEG互为像素级重复， [[lossy-lossless]] 也可能适用。 有三种方法可以判断相似图片是否为像素级重复： 在上传页面，标签框下方会显示带有指向已存在帖子链接的红色警告，底部也会显示红色的像素级重复标签。 在图片的资源页面，点击Pixel Hash会显示具有相同Pixel Hash的其他帖子和资源。这些就是像素级重复。 点击上传信息中图片下方显示文件大小、文件类型和分辨率的文字，或点击帖子页面分辨率旁边的两个箭头，即可打开图片的资源页面。 使用https://duplicatebooru.zipfiled.info。 2019年Twitter不再像以前那样进行强力压缩，2020年末Pixiv开始对其JPG进行无损重新压缩以去除元数据，导致许多情况下文件大小不同，但图片实际上是像素级重复。 对于已经发布的上传，最低ID的帖子应作为父帖子，其余帖子应打上像素级重复标签并将其父帖子设为它。唯一的例外是最低ID的帖子没有来源，此时ID次低且有有效来源的帖子应作为父帖子。 一般来说，上传者应避免发布重复内容。对于已经发布的重复内容，上传者有责任为自己的重复帖子正确打标签并将其父帖子设为已存在的帖子。 如果帖子仅仅是因为带有此标签，且它们来自第一方来源，请不要举报这些帖子。

tags.name: animated_gif
tags.summary: A GIF image that is [[animated]] . See {{is:gif -animated_gif}} for GIFs that aren't animated. This tag is automatically added by Danbooru. Related tags [[fast animated gif]] [[animated png]] [[easytoon (medium)|]] [[hybrid animation]] [[non-repeating animation]] See also [[pixel art]] [[blinking]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一张具有 [[animated]] 的GIF图片。非动态的GIF请见{{is:gif -animated_gif}}。 此标签由Danbooru自动添加。 相关标签 [[fast animated gif]] [[animated png]] [[easytoon (medium)|]] [[hybrid animation]] [[non-repeating animation]] 另见 [[pixel art]] [[blinking]] [[epilepsy warning]]

tags.name: bad_fc2_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a FC2 image, rather than to the FC2 post containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's no way to find the original FC2 post from the image link. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the link to the FC2
tags.wiki_zh: 来源为 FC2 图片直链，而非包含该图片的 FC2 文章链接的帖子。这些被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为无法从图片链接找到原始的 FC2 文章。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着你应该在上传页面粘贴 FC2 文章的链接，而不是图片本身。 由于 FC2 灵活多变的特性，有时有效的 FC2 文章来源或同等替代来源也会被标记为 [[bad source]] 。例如，非常规/非标准的 FC2 文章 URL 会被标记为来源无效，而直接引用 FC2 画廊、FC2 博客首页上不断变化的头图或类似来源的帖子，则被迫在错误链接和错误来源之间二选一。引用头图的帖子无论选择哪种来源，也都会被强制附带 [[source mismatch]] 。 另请参见 [[bad link]]

tags.name: bad_source
tags.summary: A post whose source doesn't directly link to the image or page where the image is from. This includes redirect links and links to an artist's gallery or profile page. Examples include: Artist profile pages [nodtext]https://otherguy.deviantart.com[/nodtext] [nodtext]https://www.pixiv.net/users/1234[/
tags.wiki_zh: 来源没有直接链接到图片出处页面或图片本身的投稿。包括重定向链接以及链接到画师画廊或个人主页的链接。 例如包括： 画师个人主页 [nodtext]https://otherguy.deviantart.com[/nodtext] [nodtext]https://www.pixiv.net/users/1234[/nodtext] [nodtext]https://twitter.com/noguy[/nodtext] [nodtext]https://gumroad.com/noguy[/nodtext] [nodtext]https://www.patreon.com/noguy[/nodtext] 画廊页面 [nodtext]https://otherguy.deviantart.com/gallery[/nodtext] [nodtext]https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/1234/artworks[/nodtext] [nodtext]https://twitter.com/noguy/media[/nodtext] 重定向链接 [nodtext]https://www.google.com/imgres?imgurl=longurl[/nodtext] 对于 Danbooru 能识别的站点，该标签会被自动添加到投稿上，且无法从这些投稿中移除。对于 Danbooru 无法识别的站点，可以自由添加或移除该标签。 另见 [[bad link]] ，来源正确但指向的是图片直链而非投稿页 [[bad id]] ，来源过去正确但之后被删除（404） [[source mismatch]] ，来源过去正确但现在指向了不同的图片/合集

tags.name: bad_tumblr_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Tumblr post or picture are no longer publicly available. Do not use this tag if a reblog is used as a source for the post. When this tag is on a post, it implies the source listed on the post is Bad ID. If a reblog is used, use [[third-party source]] instead. Other Tumblr errors
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Tumblr 帖子或图片已不再公开可用的情况。 如果帖子的来源使用的是转发的转发链，请不要使用此标签。当帖子带有此标签时，即表示该帖子上列出的来源是坏 ID。如果使用的是转发，请改用 [[third-party source]] 。 其他 Tumblr 错误 [[tumblr sample]] [[md5 mismatch]] [[Bad Link]] 另见 [[Bad ID]]

tags.name: derivative_work
tags.summary: An image whose main body is derived in part or in whole from a reference work. This includes [[photo-referenced]] images, redraws, images with poses copied from another work, and images that are traced or outright plagiarized. Examples [[Han-0v0]] 's [[camera hold pose (han-0v0)|]] Plagiarism of pos
tags.wiki_zh: 主体部分或全部从参考作品衍生而来的图像。这包括 [[photo-referenced]] 图像、重绘、姿势复制自其他作品的图像，以及描图或 outright 抄袭的图像。 示例 [[Han-0v0]] 的 [[camera hold pose (han-0v0)|]] 对post #747880的抄袭 [[Photo-referenced]] [[Album cover redraw]] [[Comic panel redraw]] [[Screenshot redraw]] [[Sprite redraw]] 另见 [[colorized]] [[rotoscoping]] [[photo-referenced]] [[parody]] [[scene reference]]

tags.name: dated_commentary
tags.summary: Use this tag when the date a picture was created is written somewhere in the [[commentary]] . Use [[dated]] when the date is in the picture itself instead.
tags.wiki_zh: 当图片的创作日期写在 [[commentary]] 中的某处时使用此标签。 当日期是直接写在图片本身中时，请改用 [[dated]] 。

tags.name: unfinished
tags.summary: An incomplete work, including cases such as [[sketch]] es, [[lineart]] , or [[flat color]] illustrations posted before the final image, or scrapped works that the artist decided not to complete. Posts that show various steps in the creation process should be tagged with [[making-of]] instead. Images
tags.wiki_zh: 未完成的作品，包括诸如 [[sketch]] 、 [[lineart]] ，或在最终图之前发布的 [[flat color]] 插画等情况，或是画师决定不再完成的废弃作品。展示创作过程各个步骤的图片应改用 [[making-of]] 标签。 即使图片看起来已完成，若画师的说明/标签表明其为未完成，仍可适用此标签。 另请参见 [[making-of]] [[making-of available]] [[production art]]

tags.name: partially_translated
tags.summary: A post that has been partially translated with notes. Mutually exclusive with [[translated]] . If all of the dialog is translated but there are untranslated sound effects remaining, tag with both [[translated]] and [[sound effect request]] instead. Related tags [[check translation]]
tags.wiki_zh: 带有注释、仅被部分翻译的帖子。与 [[translated]] 互斥。 如果所有对话都已翻译，但仍有未翻译的拟声词残留，请改用 [[translated]] 和 [[sound effect request]] 两个标签。 相关标签 [[check translation]] [[hard-translated]] [[partial commentary]] [[poorly translated]] [[sound effect request]] [[translated]] [[translation request]] 另见 [[howto:translate]]

tags.name: looping_animation
tags.summary: An [[animated|animation]] that loops seamlessly, with the start and end blending together to create the illusion of a never-ending animation. Note that an obvious fade between the start and end, or a fade to black/white are not seamless transitions. Examples A seamless loop Not a seamless loop
tags.wiki_zh: 一种能够无缝循环的 [[animated|animation]] ，开头与结尾自然衔接，从而营造出永不结束的动画错觉。 请注意，开头与结尾之间明显的淡入淡出过渡，或淡入至黑场／白场，都不属于无缝过渡。 示例 无缝循环示例 非无缝循环示例

tags.name: check_commentary
tags.summary: The artist [[commentary]] has been either fully or partially translated, but a second opinion is needed. This is to ensure the translation provided is most correct. Any mistakes seen can be corrected. Do not use this tag as an excuse for substandard translations. Translators are expected to be confi
tags.wiki_zh: 艺术家的 [[commentary]] 已经全部或部分被翻译，但还需要第二个人的意见。这是为了确保所提供的翻译最为准确。发现的任何错误都可以予以修正。 不要将此标签当作低质量翻译的借口。译者应当对自己所翻译的语言有信心，新手译者不应尝试翻译超出自己能力范围的内容。根据 [[howto:translate]] ，糟糕的翻译比没有翻译更糟。 相关标签 [[commentary request]] 另见 [[hard-translated]] [[partially translated]] [[poorly translated]] [[translated]] [[translation request]] [[help:artist commentary]]

tags.name: ugoira
tags.summary: Ugoira is a custom [[animated|animation]] format used by [[Pixiv]] . A Ugoira is a Zip file of images, played back using a custom Javascript player. To upload a Ugoira to Danbooru, paste the Pixiv URL into the source field on the "upload page":[/uploads/new], or upload using the "bookmarklet":[/stat
tags.wiki_zh: Ugoira 是一种自定义 [[animated|animation]] 格式，由 [[Pixiv]] 使用。一个 Ugoira 是由多张图片组成的 Zip 文件，使用专用的 Javascript 播放器进行播放。 要将 Ugoira 上传到 Danbooru，请将 Pixiv 链接粘贴到“上传页面”:[/uploads/new]的来源栏中，或使用“书签工具”:[/static/bookmarklet]上传。 要从 Pixiv 下载 Ugoira，可以使用 Pixiv Toolkit 或 gallery-dl。通过这种方式下载的 Ugoira 也可以上传到 Danbooru。 从技术上讲，一个 Ugoira 由一个包含每一帧（JPEG、GIF 或 PNG 格式）的 Zip 文件和一个记录每帧间隔延迟时间的独立 JSON 文件组成。由于每一帧都有各自独立的延迟时间，Ugoira 可以实现可变帧率。由于 Ugoira 是仅由 Pixiv 使用的自定义格式，在浏览器之外保存和查看 Ugoira 可能比较困难。BandiView 是一款支持 Ugoira 的图片查看器。 由于 Pixiv 对上传 GIF 或 MP4 视频的限制，Ugoira 常常被认为不如其他网站上的动画。因此，画师在上传前可能会先将动画转换为 GIF，从而引入 [[GIF artifacts]] 和/或 [[color banding]] ，而 Pixiv 的重新压缩过程还可能引入额外的 [[JPEG artifacts]] ，影响 Ugoira 动画的整体质量。 示例 post #7953819 另见 [[emofuri]] [[ugoira conversion]] 外部链接 BandiView（Ugoira 查看器）

tags.name: watercolor_(medium)
tags.summary: [[Traditional media|Traditional]] art created using watercolor paints. Watercolors are paints made of pigments suspended in a water soluble vehicle, typically referring to the traditional style of "transparent" watercolors (as opposed to "opaque" [[gouache (medium)|gouache]] . See also
tags.wiki_zh: 使用水彩颜料创作的 [[Traditional media|Traditional]] 艺术。 水彩是由悬浮于水溶性媒介中的颜料制成的颜料，通常指传统风格的“透明”水彩（区别于“不透明”的 [[gouache (medium)|gouache]] ）。 另请参见 [[painting (medium)]] [[watercolor pencil (medium)]] [[watercolor background]] [[watercolor effect]] [[calligraphy brush (medium)]]

tags.name: marker_(medium)
tags.summary: Art done using markers, also known as felt-tip pens, most popularly Copic markers「コピック」, but also the more generic "magic markers"「マジック」. Examples External links Wikipedia: Marker pen Copic Official Website
tags.wiki_zh: 使用记号笔完成的画作，也被称为毡尖笔，最流行的是 Copic 麦克笔「コピック」，但也包括更通用的“魔术马克笔”「マジック」。 示例 外部链接 维基百科：记号笔 Copic 官方网站

tags.name: ai-generated
tags.summary: An image or video that, rather than being fully drawn or animated by a human artist, was fully generated by an artificial intelligence model. This tag applies to fully AI-generated images or fully AI-generated animation. That is, images or videos which underwent no edits or extremely minor retouches

links.t: AI Drawing Anime Characters Eating Ramen (Meme)

tags.wiki_zh: 指并非由人类画师完全绘制或制作动画，而是完全由人工智能模型生成的图片或视频。 本标签适用于完全AI生成的图片或完全AI生成的动画。即未经任何编辑或仅经过极其轻微修改的图片或视频。经过编辑的图片和视频请参见 [[AI-assisted]] 。 完全AI生成的作品违反 [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] ，不应上传。 [[AI-assisted]] 作品只要符合质量标准且有充分的人为参与，则是被允许的。 示例 [[Stable Diffusion]] (2022) [[Stable Diffusion]] (2022) [[nai diffusion|NovelAIv1]] (2022) [[Midjourney]] (2023) [[Midjourney|nijijourney]] (2023) [[dall-e|DALL·E 3]] (2023) [[nai diffusion|NovelAIv3]] (2023) [[Stable Diffusion|NoobAI-XL]] (2024) [[nai diffusion|NovelAIv4]] (2025) [[chatgpt (medium)|GPT4o]] (2025) [[PixVerse]] (2025) [[nai diffusion|NovelAIv5]] (2026) 辨别方法 以下是一些常见的可能是AI生成的迹象。如果你不确定某张投稿是否为AI生成，请在 topic #22285 中询问。 通用画风 许多模型都有一种独特的“千篇一律”的画风。你可以浏览{{ai-generated status:deleted}}来感受一下。 请注意，画风看起来通用并不一定是AI的证据。有些画师可能天生就是这样画，或者其画风被AI模仿了。 AI分辨率 某些图片分辨率是AI模型常用的，而人类较

tags.name: tall_image
tags.summary: An image that is at least 1024px tall and that has aspect ratio of less than 1:4 (that is, at least four times taller than it is wide). This is equivalent to the tag search {{height:>=1024 ratio:<=1:4}}. Note: This tag is automatically added to all posts that meet these criteria. See also
tags.wiki_zh: 高度至少为1024px且宽高比小于1:4（即高度至少是宽度的四倍）的图片。这相当于标签搜索{{height:>=1024 ratio:<=1:4}}。 注意：该标签会自动添加到所有符合这些条件的帖子中。 另见 [[wide image]] [[Help:Autotags]] [[Tag group:Image composition]]

tags.name: paid_reward
tags.summary: Uploading paid rewards is not allowed. A paid reward is a paywalled image from Patreon, Gumroad, Fantia, Fanbox, or any other similar site. Sites like these require that the user subscribe or pledge some amount of money every month to view and download these works. Uploading paid rewards is against
tags.wiki_zh: 禁止上传付费特典。 付费特典是指来自 Patreon、Gumroad、Fantia、Fanbox 或其他类似网站的付费墙图片。像这类网站要求用户每月订阅或赞助一定金额才能查看和下载这些作品。 上传付费特典违反规则。关于付费特典的规定如下： 即使打上此标签，故意上传付费特典也会先被警告，然后被封禁。 付费特典应举报至 topic #32324，以便将其删除。 公开或可免费获取的作品不被视为付费特典，可以上传。 在上传时为免费、或之后转为免费发布的作品也是允许的。 在 2020-07-06（该规则生效时）之前上传的付费特典是允许的，不应举报。 从 Yande.re、E-Hentai、Kemono.cr 或其他托管未标记付费特典的网站上传作品时请小心。在上传可能由盗图者托管的未标记付费特典时也要小心。 另请参见 [[Patreon reward]] [[Enty reward]] [[Fantia reward]] [[Fanbox reward]] [[Gumroad reward]] [[Subscribestar reward]] [[paid reward available]] topic #32324 - 付费特典封禁请求主题帖 [[help:upload rules]]

tags.name: source_smaller
tags.summary: When the image at the source is smaller (lower resolution) than the image on Danbooru. This may be because the artist [[revision|revised]] the original image and replaced it with a smaller version after it was uploaded to Danbooru, or because the uploader uploaded an [[upscaled]] version of the imag
tags.wiki_zh: 当来源处的图片比 Danbooru 上的图片更小（分辨率更低）时使用。 这可能是因为画师 [[revision|revised]] 了原图，并在上传到 Danbooru 后将其替换成了更小的版本，也可能是因为上传者上传了图片的 [[upscaled]] 版本，或者是因为他们上传的更大版本图片实际上来自不同的来源。 另请参见 [[has downscaled revision]] [[source larger]] - 相反的情况 [[resolution mismatch]]

tags.name: promotional_art
tags.summary: Art used in the advertisement of a work such as an anime, manga, doujin, or fan event. Examples [[Key visual]] See also [[official art]] [[production art]] [[key visual]] [[poster (medium)]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于宣传动漫、漫画、同人志或粉丝活动等作品的插画。 示例 [[Key visual]] 另见 [[official art]] [[production art]] [[key visual]] [[poster (medium)]]

tags.name: anime_screenshot
tags.summary: A still image or an [[animated]] sequence (usually [[animated GIF]] or [[video]] ), extracted from an anime or cartoon. When used as an [[inset]] , please use [[anime screenshot inset]] instead. For non-anime equivalents, such as stills or [[game asset]] s from eroge, see [[screenshot]] instead. Ran
tags.wiki_zh: 从动画或卡通中截取的静态图像或 [[animated]] 序列（通常是 [[animated GIF]] 或 [[video]] ）。 当用作 [[inset]] 时，请改用 [[anime screenshot inset]] 。 对于非动画的同类情况，例如来自工口游戏的静帧或 [[game asset]] ，请改用 [[screenshot]] 。 随意的动画截图通常违反 [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] ，不应上传。 示例 另见 [[anime screenshot inset]] [[eyecatch]] [[end card]] [[fake screenshot]] [[screenshot redraw]] [[game screenshot]] [[game screenshot inset]] [[game screenshot background]]

tags.name: alt_text
tags.summary: A post that has additional commentary in the "alt" text of the image. The alt text is an additional written description of the image, supported by some sites. It's usually seen by clicking an "ALT" button in the lower left corner of the image. It's intended to provide a written description of the im
tags.wiki_zh: 在图片的“alt”文本中带有额外说明的帖子。 alt 文本是对图片的额外文字描述，受部分网站支持。通常可以通过点击图片左下角的“ALT”按钮看到。它本意是为盲人用户提供图片的文字描述，但通常也被画师用作额外的附言。 之所以叫“alt 文本”，是因为在 HTML 中，该文本存储在 元素的 alt 属性中，例如： alt 文本目前受 [[Twitter]] 、 [[Tumblr]] 和 [[Bluesky]] 支持。如果无法从来源自动获取，应将 alt 文本放入画师评论中。 如果文本需要翻译，请务必添加 [[commentary request]] 。如果来源有多张带 alt 文本的图片，只收录与当前图片相关的 alt 文本。 示例 https://twitter.com/satsukinosora/status/1777652767097606186 https://grumpygryphon.tumblr.com/post/735684444950790144 Danbooru 评论格式 Image Description Text here 外部链接 Wikipedia: Alt attribute

tags.name: cropped
tags.summary: An image that is a cropped portion of a larger picture. It's not uncommon for artists on Twitter to post both the full-size picture and a crop, in order to play around Twitter's cropping mechanism. Sometimes the cropped version is of higher resolution than the equivalent portion of the full picture,
tags.wiki_zh: 指从一张更大的图片中裁剪出一部分而成的图片。 Twitter上的画师经常会同时发布完整尺寸的图片和裁剪后的版本，以配合Twitter的裁剪显示机制进行展示。有时裁剪版本的分辨率会比完整图片中对应部分的分辨率更高，在这种情况下同时上传这两张图片是合理的。 一般来说，即使裁剪后的帖子分辨率高于未裁剪的帖子，也应将裁剪后的帖子设为子帖子。 也有可能完整尺寸的图片仅 [[paid reward available|available]] 为 [[paid reward]] 。 例子 Cropped Uncropped original 另见 [[duplicate]] [[paid reward available]] [[third-party edit]] [[thumbnail collage]] [[social media composition]] [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: hashtag-only_commentary
tags.summary: Deprecated tag. Use one of the tags below instead: [[Untranslatable commentary]] , for hashtags that cannot be translated. [[Commentary request]] , for hashtags that need to be translated. [[Commentary]] , for translated or English hashtags.
tags.wiki_zh: 已弃用标签。请改用以下标签之一： [[Untranslatable commentary]] ，用于无法翻译的标签。 [[Commentary request]] ，用于需要翻译的标签。 [[Commentary]] ，用于已翻译或英文的标签。

tags.name: making-of_available
zh: 绘画过程在帖子中发布
aliases: 绘画过程在帖子中发布
tags.summary: A post that has a [[making-of]] video or image available, either on Danbooru or off-site. Often, a link to the making-of video is present in the artist [[commentary]] , or is otherwise posted somewhere else off-site. These making-of videos should be posted to Danbooru when possible, to avoid them be
tags.wiki_zh: 拥有 [[making-of]] 视频或图片可供查看的帖子，无论是在 Danbooru 站内还是站外。 通常，制作过程视频的链接会放在画师的 [[commentary]] 中，或发布在站外的其他地方。如果可能，这些制作过程视频应发布到 Danbooru 上，以免源头被删除后丢失。 如果图片本身就展示了“制作过程”，请改用 [[making-of]] 或 [[how to]] 标签。 示例 附带 [[making-of]] 的帖子 [[making-of]] 本身 另请参见 [[how to]] [[making-of]]

tags.name: painttool_sai_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or edited with PaintTool SAI. For when the software itself is depicted in the image, use [[PaintTool SAI]] instead. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Wikipedia: PaintTool SAI
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 PaintTool SAI 创建或编辑的图片。 如果图片中描绘的是该软件本身，请改用 [[PaintTool SAI]] 。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：PaintTool SAI

tags.name: commissioner_upload
tags.summary: A work that was uploaded to [[Danbooru (site)|Danbooru]] by the person who [[commission]] ed it. If the work was received privately from the artist rather than being publicly posted, or that it is different from version publicly posted by the artist (such as having higher resolution, lack of censors
tags.wiki_zh: 上传至 [[Danbooru (site)|Danbooru]] 、由进行了 [[commission]] 的人所上传的作品。 如果该作品是私下从画师处获得而非公开发布的，或与画师公开发布的版本有所不同（如分辨率更高、没有审查、没有水印等），则来源可以留空、填写为文件名，或填写收到约稿时的交付途径描述。 [[Non-web source]] 标签可能适用，如果画师未曾在网上发布过该版本的作品。 如果该作品是由约稿人发布到其他网站的，请改用 [[second-party source]] 。 如果画师向上传者提供了文件，但该作品并非约稿，请改用 [[artist-provided artwork]] 。

tags.name: source_larger
tags.summary: When the image at the source is larger (higher resolution) than the image on Danbooru. This may be because the artist [[revision|revised]] the original image and replaced it with a larger version after it was uploaded to Danbooru, or because the uploader uploaded an [[image sample]] or
tags.wiki_zh: 当来源处的图片比 Danbooru 上的图片更大（分辨率更高）时使用。 这可能是因为画师 [[revision|revised]] 了原图，并在上传到 Danbooru 后用更大的版本替换了它，也可能是因为上传者上传了 [[image sample]] 或 [[downscaled]] 版本的图片，又或者他们上传的较小版本的图片实际上来自不同的来源。 另请参见 [[source smaller]] - 相反的情况 [[resolution mismatch]]

tags.name: audible_music
tags.summary: A [[video]] or [[Flash]] file that has audible music. If speech can be heard alongside the music, such as [[singing]] , use [[audible speech]] as well. See also [[audible speech]] [[AI-synthesized speech]] [[sound]] [[music video]]
tags.wiki_zh: 带有可听音乐的 [[video]] 或 [[Flash]] 文件。 如果在音乐之外还能听到语音，例如 [[singing]] ，请同时使用 [[audible speech]] 。 另见 [[audible speech]] [[AI-synthesized speech]] [[sound]] [[music video]]

tags.name: graphite_(medium)
tags.summary: [[Traditional media|Traditional art]] created using a traditional or [[mechanical pencil]] . Examples See also [[colored pencil (medium)]] [[pen (medium)]]
tags.wiki_zh: 使用传统 [[Traditional media|Traditional art]] 或 [[mechanical pencil]] 创作的作品。 示例 另见 [[colored pencil (medium)]] [[pen (medium)]]

tags.name: clip_studio_paint_(medium)
aliases: クリップスタジオペイント
tags.summary: An image created or edited with Clip Studio Paint (CSP). Also formerly known as Illust Studio, Manga Studio EX and Comic Studio EX. For when the software itself is depicted in the image, use [[clip studio paint]] instead. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Wikipe
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 Clip Studio Paint（CSP）创作或编辑的图片。 也曾被称为 Illust Studio、Manga Studio EX 和 Comic Studio EX。 当图片中描绘的是该软件本身时，请改用 [[clip studio paint]] 。 另请参见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：Clip Studio Paint

tags.name: photo-referenced
tags.summary: An image that was inspired from a [[photo (medium)|]] , or otherwise based on photographic source material, including video. Artists will sometimes indicate that they are replicating a photograph (写真模写) or even outright tracing one (写真トレス) in their description or tags. The referenced photo is someti
tags.wiki_zh: 指受 [[photo (medium)|]] 启发，或以照片素材（包括视频）为基础创作的图片。 画师有时会在简介或标签中注明自己是在临摹照片（写真模写），甚至是直接描图（写真トレス）。 被参考的照片有时会以 [[photo inset]] 的形式一同展示。 示例 [[Photo inset]] [[Photo-referenced]] [[Reference photo]] 另见 [[photo background]] [[photo inset]] [[derivative work]] [[reference inset]] [[reference photo]] [[rotoscoping]]

tags.name: audible_speech
tags.summary: A [[video]] or [[Flash]] file that has audible speech. Don't use this tag if there's only mouth noise with no recognizable language (this includes simple [[moaning]] ). See also [[animalese]] [[arabic audio]] [[chinese audio]] [[english audio]] [[engrish audio]] [[finnish audio]] [[french audio]]
tags.wiki_zh: 带有可听见的语音的 [[video]] 或 [[Flash]] 文件。 如果只有无法辨认出语言的嘴部杂音则不要使用此标签（这包括单纯的 [[moaning]] ）。 另请参见 [[animalese]] [[arabic audio]] [[chinese audio]] [[english audio]] [[engrish audio]] [[finnish audio]] [[french audio]] [[german audio]] [[indonesian audio]] [[italian audio]] [[japanese audio]] [[korean audio]] [[latin audio]] [[polish audio]] [[portuguese audio]] [[romanian audio]] [[russian audio]] [[spanish audio]] [[swedish audio]] [[tagalog audio]] [[thai audio]] [[ukrainian audio]] [[vietnamese audio]] [[mixed-language audio]] [[sound]] [[audible music]] [[AI-synthesized speech]]

tags.name: corrupted_twitter_file
tags.summary: A Twitter image that has been partially corrupted by Twitter itself. This usually manifests as a row of pixels at the bottom of the image, 8 pixels high, copied from a row of pixels 128 pixels above. Often the result of resizing the original image to 2048 or 4096 pixels tall. Since the original imag
tags.wiki_zh: 一张被推特本身部分损坏的推特图片。这通常表现为图片底部出现一行 8 像素高的像素条，复制自其上方 128 像素处的一行像素。通常是由于将原图缩放至 2048 或 4096 像素高所导致。 由于原图是被推特本身损坏的，因此不太可能被修复。 示例 另见 [[corrupted file]] topic #25101

tags.name: image_sample
tags.summary: A [[jpeg artifacts|compressed]] or [[downscaled]] version of an image, created by a website to reduce load times or save bandwidth. Samples should not be uploaded to Danbooru. To avoid uploading a sample, paste a link to the image on the upload page, rather than downloading the image to your compute
tags.wiki_zh: 由网站创建的图像的 [[jpeg artifacts|compressed]] 或 [[downscaled]] 版本，用于减少加载时间或节省带宽。 样本不应上传到 Danbooru。为了避免上传样本，请在上传页面粘贴图像的链接，而不是先将图像下载到电脑上再上传。只要给出图像的链接，Danbooru 就会自动找到可用的最佳质量版本的图像。 Danbooru 的政策是用完整尺寸版本替换样本，或者如果完整尺寸版本已在 Danbooru 上，则将其删除。你可以在 topic #16765 中请求替换样本，或者如果完整尺寸版本已经上传，则将其标记为删除。 在某些情况下，图像样本可能是因为原始帖子 [[bad id|was deleted before uploading]] ，而唯一存档的版本是样本。 不要与带有“SAMPLE”水印的宣传图像 [[sample watermark]] 混淆。也不要与 [[revision]] 或由画师制作的同一图像的不同分辨率版本混淆。 示例 样本 850x1200, 175 KB .jpg 原图 2508x3541, 1.09 MB .jpg 相关标签 样本类型 [[pixiv sample]] [[twitter sample]] [[nicoseiga sample]] [[tinami sample]] [[tumblr sample]] [[deviantart sample]] [[artstation sample]] [[drawcrowd sample]] [[yandere sample]] [[hentai foundry sample]] [[e-hentai sample]] [[weibo sample]] [[lofter sample]] [[zerochan sample]] [[konachan sample]]

tags.name: adversarial_noise
tags.summary: An image altered using Glaze, Nightshade, Mist, or other similar programs designed to prevent images from being used as valid training data for [[ai-generated|AI art generation]] models. The noise is typically subtle and only obvious when viewing at full resolution in good display conditions. Exampl
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 Glaze、Nightshade、Mist 或其他类似程序改动过的图片，此类程序旨在防止图片被用作 [[ai-generated|AI art generation]] 模型的有效训练数据。 这种噪声通常很细微，只有在良好的显示条件下以全分辨率查看时才明显。 示例 与第一张图相同，但非常淡 注意顶部面板中的亮度图案 Nightshade 以龙形曲线形状施加噪声 另见 [[Has adversarial noise revision]] [[Heavy adversarial noise]] [[Grid-noise-animator_hinders_ai_learning_(trend)|Grid-noise-animator hinders ai learning]] 外部链接 Glaze 官网 Nightshade 官网 Mist 官网

tags.name: imageboard_desourced
tags.summary: From February of 2008 up to Late November of 2016, Danbooru rewrote select imageboard sources to "Image board" on upload, such as those from 4chan, Cynthia and Yande.re. Due to the nature of things, it is unlikely for those automatic changes to be reversed. (forum #122820) As a result, post with suc
tags.wiki_zh: 从2008年2月到2016年11月下旬，Danbooru在上传时将部分图板来源改写为“Image board”，例如来自4chan、Cynthia和Yande.re的来源。由于事物的性质，这些自动更改不太可能被撤销。(forum #122820) 因此，具有此类来源的帖子，由于其现在变成了文本性质，已被自动添加了 [[non-web source]] 标签。 此标签用于此类帖子（以及那些由上传用户手动从原始来源去除来源的帖子）。如果可能，应将来源标准化以便于访问(forum #152518)，如果有任何可能的话则应恢复。对于来源已被更改为其原始第一手来源、不同的文本来源或被清空的帖子，则无法合理统计。 指南 [[Bad ID]] 的关于何时可以更改来源字段的指南同样适用于此处。 如果来源被更改为图片的原始第一手来源（重新添加来源），假设相关来源仍然有效，且md5/EXIF数据可能不匹配，请使用topic #16765来请求替换帖子。 对于已经不再可用的第一手来源（ [[bad ID]] ），请检查SauceNAO和ascii2d等工具，以查看是否仍能获得指向它们的链接（不过在这种情况下，可以说相关帖子可以保留此标签，因为图板可能会更改该数据；或者如果不保留，则在适当情况下替换为 [[MD5 mismatch]] ）。 在考虑可能用于重新添加来源的来源时，务必比较Danbooru帖子的上传时间与该来源的时间： 诸如yande.re、Zerochan等来源，即使具有相同的MD5且未链接到Danbooru，其发布时间也常常比Danbooru帖子晚几分钟甚至几个月（这表明它们并非来源，而只是从与Danbooru相同的来源获取了图片，无论是同一个图板还是同一个用户）； 某些来源计算时间的方式可能与Danbooru不同：Danbooru会本地化为你的本地时间，而例如yande.re使用

tags.name: artist_collaboration
tags.summary: When multiple artists have contributed to a single image. Note: On Pixiv, these katakana tags, 'コラボ' (Collabo) and 'コラボレーション' (Collaboration) may be used to mean ' [[crossover]] '. See also [[guest art]] [[derivative work]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当多位画师共同参与创作了同一张图片时使用。 注意：在 Pixiv 上，这些片假名标签“コラボ”（Collabo）与“コラボレーション”（Collaboration）可能表示的是“ [[crossover]] ”的意思。 另见 [[guest art]] [[derivative work]]

tags.name: bilingual_commentary
tags.summary: Artist's [[commentary]] with the same text in two different languages. May or may not be correctly translated. See also [[multilingual commentary]] [[mixed-language commentary]] [[bilingual text]] [[multilingual text]]
tags.wiki_zh: 画师的 [[commentary]] 以两种不同语言写有相同的文本。翻译可能准确，也可能不准确。 另见 [[multilingual commentary]] [[mixed-language commentary]] [[bilingual text]] [[multilingual text]]

tags.name: official_wallpaper
tags.summary: A wallpaper supplied by official means. It was customary for them to be found in the 'Downloads' section of the official website. Examples Source Source
tags.wiki_zh: 由官方途径提供的壁纸。 通常可以在官方网站的“Downloads”栏目中找到。 示例 来源 来源

tags.name: colorized
aliases: 塗らせていただきました
tags.summary: Originally [[monochrome|monochromatic]] pictures that were colored, often by someone else, a [[third-party edit]] . See also [[Artist Collaboration]] [[Derivative Work]] [[Nurimas]] [[Colorfag]] [[Tag Group:Colors]]
tags.wiki_zh: 原本是 [[monochrome|monochromatic]] 的图片，后来被上色，通常是由他人，即 [[third-party edit]] 完成的。 另见 [[Artist Collaboration]] [[Derivative Work]] [[Nurimas]] [[Colorfag]] [[Tag Group:Colors]]

tags.name: official_artist_extra
tags.summary: Artwork that is created unofficially by the official artist of a character. That is, an official artist creating fanart of their own character. This includes anything produced in an unofficial capacity, such as art posted on personal accounts or in unofficial artbooks, noncanonical fanart, deleted s
tags.wiki_zh: 由角色的官方画师非官方创作的作品。即官方画师为自己笔下的角色创作的同人作品。 这包括以非官方身份创作的任何作品，例如发布在个人账号上或非官方画集中的画作、非正史的同人图、已删除场景、 featuring 非官方替换服装的画作等。 另见 [[official art]] [[omake]]

tags.name: novel_illustration
tags.summary: [[Official art|Official]] illustrations that are contained within a novel. Examples See also [[novel cover]] - illustrations on the novel's cover page.
tags.wiki_zh: 包含在小说正文中的 [[Official art|Official]] 插图。 示例 另见 [[novel cover]] - 小说封面页上的插图。

tags.name: bad_deviantart_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Deviantart post or picture are no longer publicly available. Other Deviantart errors [[Deviantart sample]] : for when a size other than the full size is used [[MD5 mismatch]] : for when none of the sizes match Deviantart See also [[Bad ID]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 DeviantArt 投稿或图片已不再公开可见的情况。 其它 DeviantArt 错误 [[Deviantart sample]] ：用于使用了非完整尺寸的情况 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：用于所有尺寸都与 DeviantArt 对不上的情况 另请参见 [[Bad ID]]

tags.name: patreon_reward
tags.summary: A [[paid reward]] from [[Patreon]] . Uploading paid rewards is no longer allowed. Paid rewards uploaded after 2020-07-06 should be reported in topic #32324. See forum #168930 for details. See also [[paid reward]] topic #11399 External links Patreon
tags.wiki_zh: 一个 [[paid reward]] ，出自 [[Patreon]] 。 不再允许上传付费奖励。2020-07-06之后上传的付费奖励应在 topic #32324 中举报。详情见 forum #168930。 另见 [[paid reward]] topic #11399 外部链接 Patreon

tags.name: off-topic
tags.summary: A post that is outside of the scope of Danbooru and in general is against the rules. This tag should only be used for posts that are indisputably off-topic. Such posts should have nothing to do with anime, manga, games, or any other potential "on-topic" subject matter. See
tags.wiki_zh: 超出Danbooru收录范围的投稿，通常也违反站规。 此标签仅应用于无可争议的离题投稿。此类投稿应与动画、漫画、游戏或任何其他可能属于“收录范围内”的题材毫无关系。 关于被视为离题的内容示例，请见{{离题 状态：已删除}}。 另请参见 [[Help:Upload rules]]

tags.name: has_bad_revision
tags.summary: A post with a [[revision]] at the source that is bad, and should not be uploaded. There's a number of more specific tags that can also be used: [[has artifacted revision]] [[has cropped revision]] [[has censored revision]] [[has downscaled revision]] [[has lossy revision]]
tags.wiki_zh: 在来源处有 [[revision]] 很差、不应上传的投稿。 还有一些更具体的标签也可以使用： [[has artifacted revision]] [[has cropped revision]] [[has censored revision]] [[has downscaled revision]] [[has lossy revision]] [[has watermarked revision]] [[has adversarial noise revision]] 注意，此标签应当用于已经打上 [[md5 mismatch]] 的图像，而不是用于实际已经上传的修正版。使用此标签的图像与来源处的修正版应当具有一定程度的视觉一致性或相同性，即使是分辨率更小（post #2561932、post #2749109）或在其他方面有缺陷的、确实存在修正的图像也不应打此标签。换句话说，Danbooru上的图像与来源处修正版之间的唯一差别应当就是该缺陷。 关于上传修正版的更多信息请参见 [[md5 mismatch]] 。 另请参见 [[image sample]]

tags.name: ai-assisted
tags.summary: An image that was initially [[AI-generated]] but then painted over or retouched by an artist. This also includes posts where an artist used an [[AI-generated background]] or reference for a drawing. AI-assisted artwork is allowed to be uploaded as long as it meets quality standards and it was made w
tags.wiki_zh: 最初由 [[AI-generated]] 生成，但之后经由画师进行加笔或修改的图片。也包括画师将 [[AI-generated background]] 或参考资料用于绘画的投稿。 只要符合质量标准，且有人类充分参与制作，AI辅助作品允许上传。“充分”与否取决于判断，但人力的比重应大于AI。 示例 另见 [[AI-generated]] [[AI-generated background]]

tags.name: concept_art
tags.summary: A form of art intended to convey the design, idea, or mood of a character or creative work before it is put into production. Examples [[Hatsune Miku]] concept art See also [[character profile]] [[reference sheet]] [[prototype design]] [[official art]] [[production art]] External links Wikipedia: Con
tags.wiki_zh: 一种旨在在角色或创意作品投入制作之前，传达其设计、创意或氛围的艺术形式。 示例 [[Hatsune Miku]] 概念艺术 另见 [[character profile]] [[reference sheet]] [[prototype design]] [[official art]] [[production art]] 外部链接 维基百科：概念艺术

tags.name: procreate_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or edited with the iPad drawing app Procreate. For when the software itself is depicted in the image, use [[Procreate (software)]] instead. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Wikipedia: Procreate (software)
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 iPad 绘画应用 Procreate 创作或编辑的图片。 若图片中描绘的是软件本身，请改用 [[Procreate (software)]] 。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：Procreate（软件）

tags.name: colored_pencil_(medium)
tags.summary: [[Traditional media|Traditional]] art created using colored pencils. Colored pencils are characterized by their pigmented, usually wax-based, core. Also known as "pencil crayons", these come in several different qualities; from the poor and uneven Crayola offering to the popular Prismacolour and the
tags.wiki_zh: [[Traditional media|Traditional]] 使用彩色铅笔创作的艺术作品。 彩色铅笔的特点是其含有颜料的、通常为蜡基的笔芯。也被称为“铅笔蜡笔”，有多种不同的品质；从质量较差、涂色不均的 Crayola 产品，到受欢迎的 Prismacolour，再到价格高昂的 Pablos。

tags.name: clothing_request
tags.summary: Use this tag when the appropriate tag for clothing is unknown. See also [[Tag group:Attire]] [[artist request]] [[character request]] [[source request]] [[headwear request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当不知道服装对应的恰当标签时使用此标签。 另见 [[Tag group:Attire]] [[artist request]] [[character request]] [[source request]] [[headwear request]]

tags.name: magazine_scan
tags.summary: A [[scan]] from the inside pages of a [[magazine (object)|]] , rather than the [[magazine cover]] . See also [[Fake magazine scan]] [[Magazine cover]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一张 [[scan]] ，取自 [[magazine (object)|]] 的内页，而非 [[magazine cover]] 。 另见 [[Fake magazine scan]] [[Magazine cover]]

tags.name: hard-translated
tags.summary: An image that has been [[third-party edit|edited]] by a third party to replace the original text (Japanese or otherwise) with a translation into English (or [[hard-translated (non-english)|another language]] ). This regularly occurs in [[comic]] s and doujinshi, [[scan|scanlated]] or otherwise. Uplo
tags.wiki_zh: 指由第三方对图片进行 [[third-party edit|edited]] ，将原文本（日文或其他语言）替换为英文（或 [[hard-translated (non-english)|another language]] ）译文的图片。 这种情况经常出现在 [[comic]] 和同人志中，无论 [[scan|scanlated]] 与否。 由于存在画质问题、排版问题，以及难以确认译文正确性（相关讨论见 topic #2590），不鼓励上传硬翻译图片。应上传原图，并通过 [[help:notes|notes]] 来添加译文。当能够找到原图时，非原图的硬翻译版本 [[help:post relationships|should be made children]] 。 由画师本人进行硬翻译的投稿应改标 [[alternate language]] 。 另见 [[alternate language]] [[check translation]] [[partially translated]] [[poorly translated]] [[translated]] [[translation request]] [[fake translation]] [[hard-translated (non-English)]] [[howto:translate]]

tags.name: mihuashi_commission
tags.summary: A work [[commission]] ed on Mihuashi a Chinese website similar to [[Skeb (site)|]] . Because Mihuashi is focused on commissions, most posts sourced from it will be commissions - but non-commissions can also be posted to the site.
tags.wiki_zh: 在米画师上 [[commission]] 的作品，米画师是一个类似于 [[Skeb (site)|]] 的中国网站。由于米画师专注于委托，因此来自该网站的大多数帖子都是委托作品 - 但该网站也可以发布非委托作品。

tags.name: resized
tags.summary: An image that has been changed from its original size. When using this tag, use one of the following tags in tandem: [[downscaled]] [[upscaled]] Do not confuse with [[cropped]] , where only a cropped portion of the image is used. See also [[aliasing]] [[waifu2x]]
tags.wiki_zh: 从原始尺寸更改过大小的图片。使用此标签时，请同时使用以下标签之一： [[downscaled]] [[upscaled]] 不要与 [[cropped]] 混淆，后者仅使用了图片的裁剪部分。 另请参见 [[aliasing]] [[waifu2x]]

tags.name: incredibly_absurdres
tags.summary: An image at least 10,000 pixels wide or tall. Approximately equivalent to {{mpixels:>=100}}. This tag is [[help:autotags|automatically]] added to images. See also [[lowres]] (500×500 or smaller) [[highres]] (at least 1600×1200) [[absurdres]] (at least 3200×2400) [[incredibly absurdres]] (any dimensi
tags.wiki_zh: 宽或高至少为10000像素的图片。大致相当于{{mpixels:>=100}}。 此标签由 [[help:autotags|automatically]] 添加到图片上。 另见 [[lowres]] （500×500或更小） [[highres]] （至少1600×1200） [[absurdres]] （至少3200×2400） [[incredibly absurdres]] （任意一边超过10000） [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: pen_(medium)
tags.summary: Art created with a [[pen]] , which deposits [[ink (medium)|ink]] onto a surface, typically paper. Resulting lines are thin, with sharp edges. Most pens make lines of constant width, with multiple pens being used to create different line widths. [[nib pen (medium)|Nib pens]] , however, can create lin
tags.wiki_zh: 用 [[pen]] 创作的艺术作品，它将 [[ink (medium)|ink]] 涂抹到表面上，通常是纸上。生成的线条纤细，边缘锐利。大多数笔只能画出宽度一致的线条，需要使用多支笔来表现不同的线宽。然而， [[nib pen (medium)|Nib pens]] 可以画出粗细变化的线条，以增强表现力。钢笔可以与 [[marker (medium)|markers]] 、 [[calligraphy brush_(medium)|brushes]] 、 [[graphite (medium)|graphite]] 、 [[colored pencil (medium)]] 或 [[watercolor (medium)|watercolors]] 搭配使用，以在作品中创作出填充部分，其中钢笔常用作 [[lineart]] 。 链接 维基百科条目

tags.name: bad_twitter_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Twitter image, rather than to the Twitter post containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's no way to find the original Twitter post from the image link. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the link
tags.wiki_zh: 来源是推特图片的直接链接，而非包含该图片的推特帖子链接的投稿。这些被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为无法从图片链接找到原始的推特帖子。 如果在上传时看到此警告，意味着你应该在上传页面粘贴推特帖子的链接，而不是图片本身。 可以使用此搜索找到缺少此标签的投稿：{{source:*twimg* -source:*o.twimg* -source:*profile_banner* -bad_twitter_link}} 示例 https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HDBlAl1boAIr_Oe.jpg:orig（错误的链接） https://x.com/EsGarden_1202/status/2031324185121702204（正确的链接） 另见 [[bad link]] [[bad Twitter id]] （已删除的推特帖子）

tags.name: spanish_commentary
tags.summary: Artist [[commentary]] that is written in [[spanish_text|Spanish]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 画师 [[commentary]] ，其以 [[spanish_text|Spanish]] 书写。

tags.name: bad_nicoseiga_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Nicoseiga post or picture are no longer publicly available. Starting October 30th 2024, Nicoseiga has blocked all access from outside of Japan. Some links of the type "{{source:*lohas.nicoseiga*}}" also return 404 even though the file might still be available somewhere - see an exp
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Nicoseiga 投稿或图片不再公开可用的情况。自 2024 年 10 月 30 日起，Nicoseiga 已屏蔽了所有来自日本境外的访问。 部分 "{{source:*lohas.nicoseiga*}}" 类型的链接也会返回 404，即使文件可能仍然存在于某处——详见 github 上 issue #4496 中“存储正确的来源（Store the right source）”部分的说明。 其他 Nicoseiga 错误 [[Nicoseiga sample]] ：用于使用了完整尺寸以外的尺寸的情况 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：用于所有尺寸都与 Danbooru 不匹配的情况 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Nicovideo ID]]

tags.name: making-of
tags.summary: A post that shows how an image was made, either with multiple images showing different stages of the drawing process, or through an [[animated]] timelapse of the drawing process. A single incomplete image should be tagged as [[unfinished]] instead. See [[making-of available]] for a post that has a m
tags.wiki_zh: 展示一张图片是如何制作的帖子，要么用多张图片展示绘画过程的不同阶段，要么通过绘画过程的 [[animated]] 延时摄影来展示。 单张未完成的图应改标为 [[unfinished]] 。 带有绘画过程的帖子见 [[making-of available]] 。 示例 另见 [[art study]] [[making-of available]] [[unfinished]] [[sketch]] [[how to]]

tags.name: voice_drama_available
tags.summary: Art that was made for a voice drama, usually an ASMR work. See also [[asmr]]
tags.wiki_zh: 为配音剧创作的画作，通常是ASMR作品。 另见 [[asmr]]

tags.name: screenshot
tags.summary: A screenshot taken from something other than an anime or a game. If the screenshot is from an anime, use [[anime screenshot]] . If the screenshot is from a game, use [[game screenshot]] . If it is only the background of an image, use [[game screenshot background]] . If it's inset in the image, use [
tags.wiki_zh: 取自动画或游戏以外的事物的截图。 如果是取自动画的截图，请使用 [[anime screenshot]] 。如果是取自游戏的截图，请使用 [[game screenshot]] 。如果它只是图片的背景，请使用 [[game screenshot background]] 。如果是内嵌在图片中的，请使用 [[game screenshot inset]] 。 另请参见 [[art program in frame]] [[fake screenshot]] [[fake phone screenshot]] [[reference inset]] [[screenshot inset]] [[screenshot redraw]] [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: screenshot_redraw
tags.summary: When an artist redraws a real [[screenshot]] . Examples Related tags [[How to draw manga redraw challenge (meme)|]] [[Buttercup redraw challenge (meme)|]] [[Ghibli redraw challenge (meme)|]] [[Sailor Moon redraw challenge (meme)|]] [[Ryuko redraw (meme)|]] See also [[comic panel redraw]]

links.t: How to draw manga redraw challenge (meme)

tags.wiki_zh: 当画师重绘一张真实的 [[screenshot]] 。 示例 相关标签 [[How to draw manga redraw challenge (meme)|]] [[Buttercup redraw challenge (meme)|]] [[Ghibli redraw challenge (meme)|]] [[Sailor Moon redraw challenge (meme)|]] [[Ryuko redraw (meme)|]] 另见 [[comic panel redraw]] [[album cover redraw]] [[thumbnail redraw]] [[screenshot inset]]

tags.name: artbook
tags.summary: Artwork [[scan]] ned from an artbook. This may be [[official art]] or an [[original]] work. See also [[official art]]
tags.wiki_zh: 从画集中 [[scan]] 的插画。这可能是 [[official art]] 或 [[original]] 作品。 另见 [[official art]]

tags.name: pixiv_sample
tags.summary: A image from Pixiv that is an [[image sample]] , rather than the original image. This tag is automatically added by a bot to any Pixiv post that is detected to be a sample. Do not add this tag unless you can confirm a difference, or remove it unless the hashes match. To avoid uploading a sample, pas
tags.wiki_zh: 来自Pixiv的 [[image sample]] ，而非原始图片。 此标签由机器人自动添加到任何被检测为样本的Pixiv投稿中。除非你能确认存在差异，否则不要添加此标签；除非哈希值匹配，否则不要移除它。 为避免上传样本图，请在上传页面粘贴图片链接，而不是先将图片下载到电脑再上传。 样本图的URL中包含"/img-master/"。原始图片的URL中包含"/img-original/"。用“在新标签页中打开图片”方式打开pixiv图片时，得到的总是图片样本URL。在登录pixiv后，可以通过按“在新标签页中打开链接”来获取原始图片URL。 示例 样本：https://i.pximg.net/img-master/img/2025/01/29/22/49/45/126697322_p0_master1200.jpg (1200x1200 1.02 MB .jpg) 原图：https://i.pximg.net/img-original/img/2025/01/29/22/49/45/126697322_p0.png (2000x2000 4.97 MB .png) 另见 [[Bad Pixiv ID]] [[MD5 Mismatch]] [[Image Sample]] [[Help:Pixiv]]

tags.name: mixed_media
tags.summary: Artwork in which more than one medium or material has been employed, such as a combination of [[traditional media]] and digital (computer-based) media. Images where the use of traditional media isn't apparent to the viewer (e.g. traditional line art existed but was mostly obliterated by digital colo
tags.wiki_zh: 使用了不止一种媒介或材料创作的作品，例如 [[traditional media]] 与数码（基于电脑）媒介的结合。 传统媒介的使用在画面上不明显的图片（例如虽然存在传统线稿，但基本被数码上色覆盖）既不算传统媒介，也不算混合媒介。 同样，如果使用了3D素材，必须能明显看出它们是3D素材。如果是手工描摹并上色覆盖，那就不是混合媒介。（例如 post #5889413） 该标签也可用于在 [[3D|]] 或 [[photo background|]] 之上绘制2D前景的圖片。 示例 传统绘画配数码上色 传统绘画配 [[masking tape (medium)|]] 施加了色调分离处理的 [[Photo bashing]] ，配上手绘2D角色 2D角色、3D载具素材 另见 [[Collage (medium)|]] [[Photo background]]

tags.name: flower_request
tags.summary: A request to tag specifically what kinds of [[flower]] s are in the image. When the flowers are tagged, please remove [[flower request]] . See [[Tag group:Flowers]] for a visual list of flowers. See also [[Tag group:Flowers]]
tags.wiki_zh: 请求具体标注图片中出现了哪种 [[flower]] 。当花卉已标注完毕后，请移除 [[flower request]] 。 参见 [[Tag group:Flowers]] 查看花卉的可视化列表。 另见 [[Tag group:Flowers]]

tags.name: check_copyright
tags.summary: The copyright(s) for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.
tags.wiki_zh: 某张投稿的版权归属已被初步确认，但仍需要第二意见来进行核实。

tags.name: english_audio
tags.summary: A post with [[audible speech]] in English, including lyrics in songs.
tags.wiki_zh: 带有英语 [[audible speech]] 的帖子，包括歌曲中的歌词。

tags.name: japanese_audio
tags.summary: A post with [[audible speech]] in Japanese, including lyrics in songs.
tags.wiki_zh: 带有日语 [[audible speech]] 的帖子，包括歌曲中的歌词。

tags.name: blender_(medium)
tags.summary: Images or animations created using Blender, a free and open-source [[3D]] software suite. For posts about or depicting the Blender software itself, see [[blender (software)]] . For the kitchen appliance, see [[blender (object)]] . See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Websi
tags.wiki_zh: 使用免费开源的 [[3D]] 软件套装 Blender 创建的图片或动画。 关于 Blender 软件本身或描绘该软件的帖子，见 [[blender (software)]] 。 厨房用搅拌机，见 [[blender (object)]] 。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 官方仓库 维基百科：Blender（软件）

tags.name: fan_request
tags.summary: A work created as a result of a request from a viewer. Distinct from [[commission]] s in that these are done for free. Examples See also [[Request inset]] [[Marshmallow (site)|]] [[Odaibako]] [[Peing (site)|]] [[Pome (site)|]] [[Spin-spin (site)|]] [[Strawpage]] [[Tumblr ask]] [[Wavebox]]
tags.wiki_zh: 因观众请求而创作的作品。与 [[commission]] 的区别在于这些是免费创作的。 示例 另见 [[Request inset]] [[Marshmallow (site)|]] [[Odaibako]] [[Peing (site)|]] [[Pome (site)|]] [[Spin-spin (site)|]] [[Strawpage]] [[Tumblr ask]] [[Wavebox]]

tags.name: card_commentary
tags.summary: Commentary found on a trading [[card (medium)|]] , either physical or from a video game. When adding card commentary, the title of the card should be added to the Title field. If the card has flavor text (usually a short description or character quote), it should be added to the Description field. D
