tags.wiki_zh: 出现在交易 [[card (medium)|]] 上的解说，无论是实体卡还是电子游戏中的卡。 添加卡牌解说时，卡牌的标题应添加到标题栏。如果卡牌有效果文本（通常是简短描述或角色台词），应将其添加到简介栏。 不要在解说中添加数字卡牌数值、能力或其他额外信息；如果你认为值得提及，请放在评论中。解说应只包括标题和效果文本。但是，如果稀有度是卡名的一部分，或有助于区分同名卡牌，则可以在标题栏中包含稀有度（如果不是标题的一部分，请用括号括起来）。 如果解说的来源与你获取图片的地方不同，请在简介中效果文本下方添加包含解说来源的翻译注释（如果没有效果文本则单独添加）。如果解说是通过数据挖掘获得的，即使图片也是 [[self-datamine]] ，你也应在翻译注释中说明（例如：来源：从游戏中提取）。 卡牌解说不应取代正常的作者解说或第二方解说。如果该卡图已存在于本站，包含作者解说，且卡图扫描/素材因质量较差而不值得上传，则该帖子可以打上 [[multi-source commentary]] 标签，并在简介栏现有解说底部添加标题和效果文本，并附上包含来源链接的翻译注释。 另请参见 [[card (medium)]] [[commentary]] [[trading card]]

tags.name: tagme
tags.summary: To be used when you know, or feel like, there are more tags to be added but don't know, or can't remember/find them. [[Tagme]] is automatically removed once the target post has reached 30 tags. More specifically, it should be kept until an image can be reasonably determined to be tagged to at least
tags.wiki_zh: 当你知道或觉得还有更多标签可以添加，但不知道、想不起来或找不到这些标签时使用。 [[Tagme]] 会在目标帖子达到30个标签后被自动移除。 更具体地说，应保留该标签，直到根据 [[howto:tag checklist]] 可以合理认定一张图已至少打到了一级标签标准。 不要将其用作偷懒的借口；请尽你所能为你的投稿打好标签。 相关标签 [[annotation request]] [[animal request]] [[artist request]] [[character request]] [[character counter request]] [[clothing request]] [[commentary request]] [[copyright request]] [[cosplay request]] [[costume request]] [[flower request]] [[food request]] [[gender request]] [[gesture request]] [[hairstyle request]] [[Hat request]] [[headwear request]] [[instrument request]] [[object request]] [[magazine request]] [[mecha request]] [[medium request]] [[meme request]] [[pose request]] [[source request]] [[translation request]] [[vehicle request]] [[weapon request]] “*_request”标签列表：/tags?commit=Search&search%5Bcategory%5D=5&sea

tags.name: alternate_language
tags.summary: An image that has been hard-translated to another language (usually English) by the artist themselves, or by someone authorized by the artist (the company officially publishing a localization, a translator with the permission of the artist, etc). In most cases the artist posts the translated version
tags.wiki_zh: 由画师本人，或经画师授权的人（负责发行本地化版本的公司、经画师许可的译者等）硬性翻译成另一种语言（通常是英语）的图片。 大多数情况下，画师会同时发布翻译版和原版。在某些情况下，即使是经过画师认可的官方翻译，质量也可能很差。 这与 [[hard-translated]] 不同，后者通常由 [[third-party_edit|third parties]] 完成。

tags.name: scan_artifacts
tags.summary: Artifacts in a [[scan]] due to poor technique or post-processing: [[binding discoloration]] : Blurriness due to the page bending [[bleed through]] : The opposite side of the page bleeding through [[color halftone]] : Visible printing dots, usually in a high definition scan [[color issue]] : Inaccura
tags.wiki_zh: 因技术不佳或后期处理不当而出现在 [[scan]] 中的伪影： [[binding discoloration]] ：因页面弯曲导致的模糊 [[bleed through]] ：纸张背面内容透印过来 [[color halftone]] ：可见的印刷网点，通常出现在高清扫描中 [[color issue]] ：色彩还原不准确 [[crease]] ：折痕 [[scan dust]] ：纸上的灰尘 另见 [[scan]] [[Tag group:Image composition]]

tags.name: merchandise_available
tags.summary: Artwork designed to be sold as merchandise such as [[figure]] s, [[charm (object)|]] s, [[sticker (medium)|]] s, [[acrylic stand (object)|]] s, prints and [[dakimakura (medium)|]] s. See also [[acrylic stand (medium)]] [[charm (medium)]] [[dakimakura (medium)]] [[figure available]]
tags.wiki_zh: 为作为周边商品贩售而设计的插画，例如 [[figure]] 、 [[charm (object)|]] 、 [[sticker (medium)|]] 、 [[acrylic stand (object)|]] 、印刷品和 [[dakimakura (medium)|]] 。 另请参见 [[acrylic stand (medium)]] [[charm (medium)]] [[dakimakura (medium)]] [[figure available]] [[doll available]] [[paid reward available]] [[sticker (medium)]] [[tapestry (medium)]] [[voice drama available]]

tags.name: fanbox_reward
tags.summary: A [[paid reward]] from Pixiv FANBOX. Uploading paid rewards is no longer allowed. Paid rewards uploaded after 2020-07-06 should be reported in topic #32324. See forum #168930 for details. See also [[paid reward]] External links pixiv FANBOX
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 Pixiv FANBOX 的 [[paid reward]] 。 不再允许上传付费特典。2020-07-06之后上传的付费特典应前往 topic #32324 举报。详情见 forum #168930。 另见 [[paid reward]] 外部链接 pixiv FANBOX

tags.name: annotated
tags.summary: An image that has been annotated with translation notes to mark the characters or items in the image. Often used on pictures containing [[absolutely everyone|a huge number of characters]] . It can also be used to mark another post being visible in the image. For characters that need to be tagged, us
tags.wiki_zh: 一张用翻译注释标注了图中角色或物品的图片。常用于包含 [[absolutely everyone|a huge number of characters]] 的图片。也可用于标记图中可见的另一篇帖子。 对于需要打上标签的角色，请改用 [[character request]] 标签。要请求加注，请使用 [[annotation request]] 标签。 要将文本翻译成英语，请改用 [[translated]] 。 对于作为图片本身一部分的注释，而非用翻译注释添加的，请参见 [[pointing out the details]] 。 示例 标注角色 标注物品

tags.name: has_censored_revision
tags.summary: When the post's [[revision]] at the source has been [[censored]] or has a larger amount of censorship compared to the post on Danbooru. See also [[has bad revision]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当帖子在来源处的 [[revision]] 已被 [[censored]] ，或与 Danbooru 上的帖子相比含有更多审查内容时使用。 另见 [[has bad revision]]

tags.name: live2d
tags.summary: A form of 2D [[animated|animation]] using layered segments, allowing for the animation to be generated procedurally rather than requiring frame-by-frame animation. Often employed by [[virtual youtuber]] s, and used for animations in gacha games such as [[Azur Lane]] and [[Fire Emblem Heroes]] . This
tags.wiki_zh: 一种使用分层部件的2D [[animated|animation]] 形式，允许以程序化方式生成动画，而无需逐帧绘制动画。常被 [[virtual youtuber]] 所采用，并用于如 [[Azur Lane]] 和 [[Fire Emblem Heroes]] 等抽卡游戏中的动画。 此标签仅用于以Live2D [[animated]] 的帖子。不应用于Live2D模型的静态图片。 在适用且可能的情况下，Live2D动态帖子应同时标注原画师和L2D绑定师。 另见 [[Live2D inc.]] [[Spine (medium)]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官网 维基百科：Live2D

tags.name: romaji_commentary
tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[romaji_text|Romaji]] ; its usage follows the same applicability rules, so add [[commentary request]] when needed.
tags.wiki_zh: 针对 [[commentary]] ，当其以 [[romaji_text|Romaji]] 书写时；其使用遵循相同的适用规则，因此在需要时添加 [[commentary request]] 。

tags.name: bad_lofter_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Lofter post or picture is no longer publicly available. See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]] [[Lofter sample]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Lofter 帖子或图片已不再公开可见的情况。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]] [[Lofter sample]]

tags.name: redrawn
tags.summary: A picture that has been completely redrawn by the artist, usually to show their improvement over time. Not to be confused with [[revision]] , which is for minor edits or corrections rather than a full recreation of the original art, or with various types of redraw [[meme]] s and challenges in which
tags.wiki_zh: 由画师将整张图完全重新绘制的图片，通常用于展示自己随时间推移的进步。 不要与 [[revision]] 混淆，后者指的是小幅修改或修正，而非对原画的完整重制；也不要与各种将照片或截图重新绘制的 [[meme]] 重绘企划和挑战混淆。 示例 重绘版（2022-08-19） 原图（2021-01-29） 另请参见 [[artist progress]] [[unfinished]] [[revision]] [[screenshot redraw]] [[album cover redraw]] [[photo-referenced]]

tags.name: stitched
tags.summary: An image made by stitching together multiple separate images posted by an artist. For example, a full body shot made by combining a lower body shot and an upper body shot posted by the artist as two separate pictures. Note that [[collage]] s don't fall under this. Stitches are generally not consider
tags.wiki_zh: 由艺术家发布的多个独立图像拼接在一起制成的图片。 例如，将艺术家作为两张独立图片发布的下半身图和上半身图组合而成的全身图。注意 [[collage]] 不属于此类。 由于拼接具有非破坏性，拼接图一般不被视为 [[third-party edit]] 。 从 jpg 等有损格式拼接图片时，请确保导出为 png，以避免最终得到 [[lossy-lossy]] 文件。 不要与 [[stitches]] 混淆。 示例 拼接图 原图（左） 原图（右） 另请参见 [[lossy-lossless]] [[poorly stitched]] [[scan]] [[social media composition]]

tags.name: key_visual
tags.summary: A piece of [[promotional art]] released by an anime studio as a concept and showcase of how an upcoming anime project will look, often a few months before its airing. These are often in the form of [[poster (medium)|]] s with the [[copyright name]] prominently on it, focusing on the appearance of th
tags.wiki_zh: 由动画工作室发布的 [[promotional art]] ，作为即将推出的动画企划外观的概念展示，通常在开播前几个月发布。 这些通常以 [[poster (medium)|]] 的形式出现，上面醒目地印有 [[copyright name]] ，重点展示主要角色的外观。与之一起发布的通常还有同一角色的 [[reference sheet]] 。 注意，这与 [[concept art]] 不同，后者是为当时仍在制作中的作品而创作的。 示例 另见 [[production art]] [[anime coloring]] [[poster (medium)]] [[cover]] 外部链接 维基百科：Key art

tags.name: check_character
tags.summary: The character(s) for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.
tags.wiki_zh: 该投稿中的角色已被辨认，但仍需要第二人复核确认。

tags.name: paint.net_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or edited with Paint.NET. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Wikipedia: Paint.NET
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 Paint.NET 创建或编辑的图像。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：Paint.NET

tags.name: thai_commentary
tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[thai_text|Thai]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 表示 [[commentary]] 以 [[thai_text|Thai]] 写成。

tags.name: multi-source_commentary
tags.summary: Artist [[commentary]] that comes from multiple sources. Use the search {{commentary:*Source:*Source:*}} to find commentaries from multiple sources.
tags.wiki_zh: 来自多个来源的作者 [[commentary]] 。 使用搜索 {{commentary:*Source:*Source:*}} 来查找来自多个来源的评论。

tags.name: bad_tumblr_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Tumblr image, rather than to the Tumblr post containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's often no way to find the original Tumblr post from the image link. If the original tumblr post has not been deleted, the original source ca
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源是Tumblr图片直链，而不是包含该图片的Tumblr帖子链接的投稿。这些被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为通常无法从图片链接找到原始的Tumblr帖子。如果原始Tumblr帖子尚未被删除，可以通过直链手动找到原始来源。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着你应该在上传页面粘贴Tumblr帖子的链接，而不是图片本身。 缺少Bad Tumblr Link标签的投稿可以通过以下搜索找到： {{source:*/media.tumblr.com* -bad_tumblr_link}} | {{source:*.media.tumblr.com* -bad_tumblr_link}} | {{source:*/data.tumblr.com* -bad_tumblr_link}} | {{source:*/static.tumblr.com* -bad_tumblr_link}} 示例 https://64.media.tumblr.com/5bb9fa5c615aa5ada16bac51863b0793/6aa9bbdbd6208b87-e7/s21000x21000/3dac2dcc9829bca7928a9ae30e4a22be70baab3e.png（错误链接） https://emwheezie.tumblr.com/post/745130134446686208/salad（正确链接） 如果原始帖子仍然有效，在此处查找原始帖子的链接 另见 [[bad link]] [[bad Tumblr id]] （已删除的Tumblr帖子）

tags.name: guest_art
tags.summary: [[Official art]] created by a guest artist. Either commissioned by a copyright holder or is [[gift art|gifted]] to the author of the work by other established artist. This is often seen in the end matter for published manga or books (e.g. alongside the work's primary artist's afterword), or featured
tags.wiki_zh: 由客座画师创作的 [[Official art]] 。由版权持有者委托，或由其他知名画师 [[gift art|gifted]] 给该作品的作者。 常见于已出版漫画或书籍的卷末附录（例如与作品主笔的后记放在一起），或动画作品中的 [[end card]] 或 [[eyecatch]] ，或是特别制作的额外内容、官方认可的 [[promotional art]] 等。 即使某位画师正式编辑出版作品并/或向其他画师约稿，只要是没有某一位画师主导画面的 [[artist collaboration|collaborative]] 作品中的图片，都不要使用此标签。 另见 [[gift art]] 画集 #1338（“Popular Artists Draw Other Copyrights”）

tags.name: check_artist
tags.summary: The artist(s) for a particular post has been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification. Can be used when the post is retrieved from a source that is not owned by the artist in question (ie. [[third-party_source]] , certain Twitter accounts, music albums, etc). Do not use this tag i
tags.wiki_zh: 某张投稿的画师已被指认，但还需要第二意见来进行核实。当投稿取自并非该画师本人所有的来源时可以使用（例如 [[third-party_source]] 、某些推特账号、音乐专辑等）。 如果来源数据中已经提供了画师的名字，请勿使用此标签。例外情况是当相关投稿属于两位或多位画师之间的 [[artist collaboration]] 。

tags.name: upscaled
tags.summary: A form of [[resized|resizing]] which makes a source image larger. [[Third-party edit|Third-party]] upscales should not be uploaded unless they're the only available version of an image, and should be flagged/deleted if the original is uploaded. You should always try to find the original picture inst
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 [[resized|resizing]] 形式，可使源图像变大。 除非是某张图片唯一可用的版本，否则不应上传 [[Third-party edit|Third-party]] 的超分图，若已上传原图，则应对其标记/删除。 应始终尝试寻找原图。如果是官方超分，则可能无法找到。有关操作方法，请参见 [[help:image source]] 。 另见 [[aliasing]] [[waifu2x]] [[downscaled]]

tags.name: acrylic_paint_(medium)
tags.summary: Works that were done using acrylic paint.
tags.wiki_zh: 使用丙烯颜料创作的作品。

tags.name: gift_art
tags.summary: When an artist draws an image to give as a gift to someone else. See also [[anniversary]] [[art trade]] [[guest art]] [[milestone celebration]] (kiriban) [[thank you]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当画师绘制一幅画作为礼物送给他人时。 另见 [[anniversary]] [[art trade]] [[guest art]] [[milestone celebration]] (切番) [[thank you]]

tags.name: production_art
tags.summary: Incomplete artwork or ancillary reference materials used in the production of a work, especially anime. This is almost always [[official art]] , with the exception of production work of individual doujin [[animated|animations]] . This includes [[unfinished]] and [[making-of]] materials such as: Work
tags.wiki_zh: 用于作品（尤其是动画）制作过程中的未完成美术稿或辅助性参考资料。这几乎总是 [[official art]] ，个别同人 [[animated|animations]] 的制作过程作品除外。 其中包括 [[unfinished]] 和 [[making-of]] 方面的素材，例如： 画在 [[animation paper]] 上以配合 [[peg bar]] 使用、或带有 [[trim marks]] 以供后期编辑的作品 [[Color trace]] [[Partially colored]] 美术（作为参考资料或前期制作美术稿时） [[Key frame]] [[Animatic]] （非常粗糙的前期制作 [[animated|animations]] ） [[Photo (medium)|]] 或 [[scan]] ，即传统动画作品中所用实物 [[cel]] 的相关记录 以及制作参考资料，例如： [[Storyboard]] [[Reference sheet]] [[Information sheet]] [[Production note]] [[Color guide]] 官方 [[height chart]] 和 [[costume chart]] 用于作品宣传的 [[Promotional art]] 示例 另见 [[concept art]] [[key visual]]

tags.name: gender_request
tags.summary: A request for the gender of one or more characters ( [[1boy]] , [[1girl]] , [[1other]] , etc.). Please remove this tag once all the correct genders are tagged. See also [[tag group:character count]] [[character counter request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 对一个或多个角色性别的请求（ [[1boy]] 、 [[1girl]] 、 [[1other]] 等）。一旦所有正确的性别都已打上标签，请移除此标签。 另请参阅 [[tag group:character count]] [[character counter request]]

tags.name: downscaled
tags.summary: A form of [[resized|resizing]] which makes a source image smaller. There are typically two cases where you will see this tag used: An image is downscaled from the source. This tag may also apply when the original image is so incredibly large that it simply cannot be uploaded. (post #12083678) An ima
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 [[resized|resizing]] 形式，会将源图片变小。 通常在以下两种情况下会看到使用此标签： 图片从源图缩小而来。 当原图过大以至于根本无法上传时，也可能适用此标签。(post #12083678) 图片由画师或其他人从另一网站上的父图片缩小而来。 另请参阅 [[aliasing]] [[upscaled]]

tags.name: archived_source
tags.summary: A post which uses an archived link as its source instead of its original source. For sourcing purposes, it is generally recommended to leave the now-defunct link as the source, rather than the archived link itself, as to avoid hotlinking complications and putting unnecessary traffic strain on the ar
tags.wiki_zh: 指将其来源填写为存档链接而非原始来源的投稿。 出于标注来源的目的，通常建议保留现已失效的原始链接作为来源，而不是使用存档链接本身，以避免盗链问题，并避免给存档网站带来不必要的流量负担。你可以在投稿的评论中提及使用了存档链接，不过这并非硬性要求，也不意味着你可以使用这个标签。 不要使用此标签来表示某个来源已被存档在存档网站上，也不要将其作为 [[Bad ID]] 的替代品；也不要以此标签为借口，将已失效的来源改为存档来源。这些都不是此标签的用途。只有当来源栏中填写的存档来源也已失效时，才将 [[Bad ID]] 与此标签搭配使用。 示例 综合性存档网站 Wayback Machine：{{source:*web.archive.org*}} / {{source:*.archive.org*}} / {{source:*/archive.org*}} / {{source:*textfiles.com*}} archive.today：{{source:*archive.today*}}（标准）/ {{source:*archive.ph/*}} / {{source:*archive.is*}} / {{source:*archive.li*}} / {{source:*archive.vn*}} / {{source:*archive.fo/*}} / {{source:*archive.md*}} Ghost Archive：{{source:*ghostarchive.org*}} 4chan存档网站 4archive：{{source:*4archive*}}（包括第一代和第二代4archive） 4plebs：{{source:*4plebs*}} / {{source:*i.4pcdn.org*}} 4scrape：{{source:*4scrape*}} /

tags.name: bad_bcy_id
tags.summary: Used for any post from bcy.net Since this site's service ended on July 12, 2023, all posts on site from there are assumed to be bad bcy id. See also [[BCY]] [[Bad ID]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于所有来自 bcy.net 的帖子。由于该网站的服务已于 2023 年 7 月 12 日终止，因此来自该网站的所有站内帖子都被视为错误的半次元 ID。 另请参阅 [[BCY]] [[Bad ID]]

tags.name: bad_drawr_id
tags.summary: Used for any post of drawr, an [[oekaki]] site. The site has been discontinued, so all posts on site from there are assumed to be bad drawr id. Founded in October 2008, the site's service ended on December 2nd, 2019, ahead of the imminent end of Adobe's support for Flash in December 2020. Existing u
tags.wiki_zh: 用于 drawr（一个 [[oekaki]] 网站）的任何帖子。该网站已停止服务，因此来自该网站的所有帖子都被假定为 bad drawr id。 该网站创立于2008年10月，服务于2019年12月2日终止，早于 Adobe 预计于2020年12月终止对 Flash 的支持。建议现有用户迁移到 [[Pixiv Sketch]] 。 另见 [[Bad ID]]

tags.name: food_request
tags.summary: Use this tag if you see a [[food]] item in the image but you don't know how to identify it. It's highly recommended to peruse the [[Tag Group:Food Tags]] list for a comprehensive list of any tags related to food first before resorting to this tag.
tags.wiki_zh: 如果在图片中看到 [[food]] 物品，但你不知道该如何辨认它，请使用此标签。 在 resort 到此标签之前，强烈建议先查阅 [[Tag Group:Food Tags]] 以获取与食物相关的所有标签的完整列表。

tags.name: wide_image
tags.summary: An image that is at least 1024px wide and that has aspect ratio of at least 4:1 (that is, at least four times wider than it is tall). This is equivalent to the tag search {{width:>=1024 ratio:>=4:1}}. Note: This tag is automatically added to all posts that meet these criteria. See also
tags.wiki_zh: 宽度至少为1024像素，且宽高比至少为4:1（即宽度至少是高度的四倍）的图片。这等同于标签搜索{{width:>=1024 ratio:>=4:1}}。 注意：此标签会自动添加到所有符合这些标准的帖子中。 另请参见 [[tall image]] [[Help:Autotags]] [[Tag group:Image composition]]

tags.name: vgen_commission
tags.summary: A work [[commission]] ed on [[VGen (site)|]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 一件 [[commission]] 于 [[VGen (site)|]] 的作品。

tags.name: millipen_(medium)
tags.summary: Written as「ミリペン」, this common abbreviation of "Millimetre Pen" refers to the instrument also known as a technical pen. It has a hard tip and is known for making solid, consistent lines. In this regard, it's easier to use than a [[nib pen (medium)|nib pen]] , but there's a trade-off in terms of how m
tags.wiki_zh: 日文写作「ミリペン」，这是“Millimetre Pen（毫米笔）”的常见缩写，指的是一种也被称为针管制图笔的工具。它笔尖坚硬，以能画出扎实、均匀的线条而闻名。在这方面，它比 [[nib pen (medium)|nib pen]] 更容易上手，但代价是对线条的控制力有所不足。

tags.name: russian_commentary
tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[russian_text|Russian]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 指 [[commentary]] ，以 [[russian_text|Russian]] 写成。

tags.name: nude_filter
tags.summary: An image that has been [[third-party edit|edited]] to remove a character's clothes, or to make them [[nude]] . Nude filters are against the [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] and should not be uploaded or approved. If the image has been redrawn (ie a trace) instead of an edit over the original, then
tags.wiki_zh: 一张经过 [[third-party edit|edited]] 以去除角色衣物，或使其 [[nude]] 的图像。 裸体滤镜违反 [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] ，不应上传或通过。 如果该图像是重新绘制的（即描图）而非在原图上直接修改，则不应使用此标签，该图像应改标为 [[derivative work]] 。 另见 [[third-party edit]] [[help:upload rules]]

tags.name: weapon_request
tags.summary: Works like [[tagme]] , except you need someone to identify the [[weapon]] used in a post. Using this for any generic-looking [[revolver]] s, [[double-barreled shotgun|double-barelled]] / [[pump action]] [[shotgun]] s or [[lever action]] [[rifle]] s is discouraged. Because most of their specific name
tags.wiki_zh: 和 [[tagme]] 的作用类似，只是你需要有人来辨认帖子中使用的 [[weapon]] 。 不鼓励将此用于任何外观普通的 [[revolver]] 、 [[double-barreled shotgun|double-barelled]] / [[pump action]] [[shotgun]] 或 [[lever action]] [[rifle]] 。因为它们大多数具体命名型号之间都极为相似。而且经常缺乏艺术细节或细节不准确，可能导致辨认几乎不可能。视角和距离因素也会妨碍辨认。 另见 [[bad gun anatomy]] [[List of Weapons]] "*_request tags":/tags?commit=Search&search[category]=5&search[hide_empty]=yes&search[name_or_alias_matches]=*_request&search[order]=date

tags.name: has_downscaled_revision
tags.summary: For when the post's revision at the source has been downscaled. See also [[has bad revision]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于帖子在来源处的修订版本已被缩小的情况。 另见 [[has bad revision]]

tags.name: unconventional_media
tags.summary: Physical art made using unconventional techniques or materials, as opposed to [[traditional media]] . Things like [[food art (medium)|]] , [[latte art (medium)|]] , [[kyaraben (medium)|]] , physical sculptures, carvings, handmade crafts, and other such things. Examples [[Food art (medium)|]] Media [
tags.wiki_zh: 使用非常规技法或材料制作的实体艺术，与 [[traditional media]] 相对。包括如 [[food art (medium)|]] 、 [[latte art (medium)|]] 、 [[kyaraben (medium)|]] 、实体雕塑、雕刻、手工工艺品以及其他此类事物。 示例 [[Food art (medium)|]] 媒介 [[3d printing (medium)]] [[amigurumi (medium)]] [[circuit board (medium)]] [[clay (medium)]] [[diorama (medium)]] [[food art (medium)]] [[kyaraben (medium)]] [[latte art (medium)]] [[garage kit (medium)]] [[laser engraving (medium)]] [[lego (medium)]] [[model kit (medium)]] [[papercraft (medium)]] [[kirigami (medium)]] [[origami (medium)]] [[paper child]] [[paper cutout (medium)]] [[perler beads (medium)]] [[plate (medium)]] [[polystrene (medium)]] [[sand (medium)]] [[snow (medium)]] [[stop motion animation]] [[wax (medium)]] [[wood carving (medium)]]

tags.name: gimp_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or edited with [[GIMP (software)]] . See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Official Repository Wikipedia: GIMP
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 [[GIMP (software)]] 创建或编辑的图像。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 官方仓库 维基百科：GIMP

tags.name: cosplay_photo
tags.summary: Photography of actual, real-world [[cosplay]] . Considered borderline [[off-topic]] ; upload sparingly. Examples See also [[Photo (medium)]] [[help:Upload Rules]]
tags.wiki_zh: 对现实世界中真实存在的 [[cosplay]] 的摄影。 被视为边缘 [[off-topic]] ；请谨慎上传。 示例 另见 [[Photo (medium)]] [[help:Upload Rules]]

tags.name: ibispaint_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or edited with ibisPaint. For when the software itself is depicted in the image, use [[ibisPaint]] instead. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website JP Wikipedia: ibisPaint
tags.wiki_zh: 使用ibisPaint创作或编辑的图片。 当图片中描绘的是该软件本身时，请改用 [[ibisPaint]] 。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 日语维基百科：ibisPaint

tags.name: alpha_transparency
tags.summary: An image that contains semi-transparent areas that aren't part of the background. These areas will look different depending on whether the image is viewed in light mode or dark mode. Typically found on [[Twitter]] , where images appear on a white background in the timeline or on post pages but have
tags.wiki_zh: 包含不属于背景的半透明区域的图片。这些区域的外观会根据图片是在浅色模式还是深色模式下查看而有所不同。 通常出现在 [[Twitter]] 上，图片在时间线或帖子页面中显示为白色背景，但点击进入照片模式查看时则显示为黑色背景。日本画师通常会用“{{commentary:タップ推奨|タップ推奨}}”（建议点开图片）来提示这一点。 如果只是背景且为完全透明，请改用 [[transparent background]] 。 {{is:PNG|PNG}}和{{is:WebP|WebP}}是最常见的支持这种透明度的图片格式。 示例 橙色区域为半透明 [[Thumbnail surprise]] ；请在深色模式下查看完整图片以看到效果 另请参见 [[transparent background]]

tags.name: vector_trace
tags.summary: Images that were traced in a vector graphics program and saved as a raster image. See also [[Rotoscoping]] [[Vector art]]
tags.wiki_zh: 在矢量图形程序中进行描摹，并保存为栅格图像的图片。 另见 [[Rotoscoping]] [[Vector art]]

tags.name: figure_(medium)
tags.summary: A [[photo (medium)|]] of a physical [[figure]] . Examples See also [[doll (medium)]] [[model kit (medium)]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一幅 [[photo (medium)|]] ，其内容为实物 [[figure]] 。 示例 另见 [[doll (medium)]] [[model kit (medium)]]

tags.name: crease
tags.summary: A visible fold in a [[scan|scanned]] image. See also [[scan artifacts]]
tags.wiki_zh: 在 [[scan|scanned]] 图像中可见的折叠痕迹。 另见 [[scan artifacts]]

tags.name: bad_imgur_id
tags.summary: Used for any post from Imgur that is no longer publicly available there, because the work was either deleted or made private. See also [[Bad ID]] topic #8453 - Tag discussion
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何在 Imgur 上不再公开可见的投稿，因为原作品已被删除或设为私密。 另请参见 [[Bad ID]] topic #8453 - 标签讨论

tags.name: lossy-lossless
tags.summary: An image that has been converted from a lossy image format to a lossless image format. Usually this is a PNG image ({{filetype:png}}) full of [[JPEG artifacts]] , because it was originally a JPEG. Lossy-lossless images should not be uploaded to Danbooru when the original is available. It is Danbooru
tags.wiki_zh: 指从有损图像格式转换而来的无损格式图像。通常这类图像是充满 [[JPEG artifacts]] 的 PNG 图像（{{文件类型:png}}），因为它原本是一张 JPEG。 当原图可用时，不应将有损转无损图像上传到 Danbooru。根据 Danbooru 的政策，当原图可用时， [[third-party edit|third-party]] 有损转无损图像会被删除。参见 [[third-party edit]] 。 另见 [[image sample]] [[lossless-lossy]] [[lossy-lossy]] [[md5 mismatch]] [[third-party edit]]

tags.name: oil_painting_(medium)
tags.summary: For when the image itself is an oil on canvas painting. Not to be confused with an oil painting in the image. Examples
tags.wiki_zh: 当图片本身就是一幅布面油画时使用。不要与画面中出现的油画相混淆。 示例

tags.name: fancy_embedded_notes
tags.summary: A post with translation / annotation notes that go beyond ordinary text. Often these almost look [[hard-translated]] . Examples See also {{embedded:true}} (posts with embedded notes) {{note:*<div*}} (posts with note formatting) [[help:notes]]
tags.wiki_zh: 带有超出普通文本的翻译／注释说明的帖子。通常这些几乎看起来像 [[hard-translated]] 。 示例 另见 {{embedded:true}}（带有嵌入注释的帖子） {{note:*<div*}}（带有注释格式的帖子） [[help:notes]]

tags.name: multilingual_commentary
tags.summary: Artist's [[commentary]] with the same text in more than two different languages. May or may not be correctly translated. See also [[bilingual commentary]] [[mixed-language commentary]] [[bilingual text]] [[multilingual text]]
tags.wiki_zh: 画师的 [[commentary]] 包含用两种以上不同语言书写的相同文本。翻译可能正确，也可能不正确。 另见 [[bilingual commentary]] [[mixed-language commentary]] [[bilingual text]] [[multilingual text]]

tags.name: commentary_typo
tags.summary: When a [[typo]] occurs in the artist [[commentary]] . Not to be confused with [[Engrish commentary]] or [[japanese ranguage commentary|ranguage commentary]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 当 [[typo]] 出现在作者 [[commentary]] 中时。 不要与 [[Engrish commentary]] 或 [[japanese ranguage commentary|ranguage commentary]] 混淆。

tags.name: art_study
tags.summary: A piece of artwork drawn for the purpose of learning, most commonly of a specific object or body part, or a [[still life]] . May include notes on the subject, and often have [[multiple views]] . Examples Types of studies [[anatomy study]] [[color study]] [[environment study]] [[lighting study]]
tags.wiki_zh: 为学习目的而绘制的作品，最常见的是针对特定物体或身体部位，或 [[still life]] 。可能包含关于对象的注释，并且常常带有 [[multiple views]] 。 示例 习作的种类 [[anatomy study]] [[color study]] [[environment study]] [[lighting study]] [[material study]] [[pose study]] [[style study]] 另见 [[photo-referenced]] [[how to]] 外部链接 Wikipedia: Study (art)

tags.name: nib_pen_(medium)
tags.summary: A work of [[traditional media]] drawn with a nib pen, a [[pen]] that requires constant dipping in an ink reservoir to function. An advanced tool, this difficult medium takes a lot of practice to get the hang of, but rewards with rich expression and superior control over one's lines. For images that
tags.wiki_zh: 用蘸水笔绘制的 [[traditional media]] 作品，蘸水笔是一种需要不断蘸取墨水池中的墨水才能使用的 [[pen]] 。 作为一种进阶工具，这种难度较高的媒介需要大量练习才能掌握，但能回报以丰富的表现力和对线条的出色控制。 对于描绘了蘸水笔本身的图，请使用 [[nib pen (object)]] 。

tags.name: third-party_watermark
tags.summary: When an image is [[watermark]] ed by a third-party website such as an image gallery, wallpaper site, or an anime or gaming website displaying [[official art]] . Third-party watermarks are disallowed on Danbooru. They are regarded as flaws that should be addressed by someone finding a watermark-free
tags.wiki_zh: 当图片被第三方网站加上 [[watermark]] 时，例如图片画廊、壁纸网站，或展示 [[official art]] 的动漫或游戏网站。 第三方水印在Danbooru上是不被允许的。它们被视为缺陷，应由他人找到无水印的图片并上传来解决。一旦上传了无水印版本，带有第三方水印的图片应被设为子帖并标记。 像微博这样会将画师用户名作为水印添加的网站，不应标注为第三方水印，除 [[third-party source]] 情况外。 示例

tags.name: decensored
tags.summary: The 'decensored' tag implies the original image was [[censored]] in its original version, but was decensored (drawn over the censorship) by a (for lack of a better word) decensorer. This is usually the case with [[third-party edit]] s of [[game asset]] s that originally contained
tags.wiki_zh: “decensored”标签意味着原图在原始版本中是 [[censored]] 的，但已由（姑且这么称呼的）去码者进行了去码处理（在审查部位上重新绘制）。这种情况通常出现在 [[third-party edit]] 中，其对应的 [[game asset]] 原版包含 [[mosaic censoring]] 。 所有去码投稿都应以原图作为父投稿。此外，“decensored”与 [[nude filter]] 和 [[uncensored]] 均不同。 另见 [[nude filter]] [[third-party edit]] [[uncensored]]

tags.name: bad_hentai_foundry_id
tags.summary: A post from Hentai Foundry that is no longer publicly available there, because the work was either deleted or made private. Direct image links to pictures.hentai-foundry.com will often still work even if the post has been deleted. See also [[hentai foundry sample]] [[MD5 mismatch]]
tags.wiki_zh: 来自Hentai Foundry的帖子在该站已不再公开可见，因为作品要么被删除，要么被设为私密。 即使帖子已被删除，直接链接到pictures.hentai-foundry.com的图片链接通常仍然有效。 另见 [[hentai foundry sample]] [[MD5 mismatch]]

tags.name: bad_discord_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Discord image, rather than to the Discord message containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's no way to find the original Discord message from the image link, and the URL hash will also expire after a period of time. If you see
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源是 Discord 图片的直链，而不是包含该图片的 Discord 消息链接的投稿。这类链接被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为无法从图片链接找到原始的 Discord 消息，而且 URL 哈希值过一段时间后也会过期。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着上传后，你应该将来源改为该图片所在的 Discord 消息。来源应该是具体的消息本身，而不仅仅是服务器或频道。 可以使用以下搜索找到缺少 Bad Discord Link 标签的投稿：{{source:*cdn.discordapp* -bad_discord_link}} 示例 https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/710192137878241372/1488914565184884796/maidpng.png?ex=69ce833f&is=69cd31bf&hm=d610eed6ac3af0db46d95c2f20860123abf9a9e416f4057236bc8050e991fb22（错误的链接） https://discord.com/channels/310432830138089472/710192137878241372/1488914565499453440（正确的链接） 另请参阅 [[bad link]] [[bad Discord id]] （已删除的 Discord 投稿）

tags.name: engrish_commentary
tags.summary: Artist [[commentary]] originally written in [[engrish_text|engrish]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 由画师 [[commentary]] 创作的、最初以 [[engrish_text|engrish]] 写成的解说。

tags.name: album_cover_redraw
tags.summary: When an artist redraws an [[album cover]] . It could also be a [[parody]] . Examples [[Bocchi the Rock!]] redraw of [[Wish You Were Here]] [[16Personalities]] redraw of [[Demon Days (Gorillaz)|]] See also [[screenshot redraw]] [[comic panel redraw]] [[video game cover redraw]] [[book cover redraw]]
tags.wiki_zh: 指画师重绘 [[album cover]] 的行为。也可能是 [[parody]] 。 示例 [[Bocchi the Rock!]] 重绘的 [[Wish You Were Here]] [[16Personalities]] 重绘的 [[Demon Days (Gorillaz)|]] 另见 [[screenshot redraw]] [[comic panel redraw]] [[video game cover redraw]] [[book cover redraw]]

tags.name: bad_patreon_id
tags.summary: Old and broken source link from <https://www.patreon.com>. Bad IDs associated with active accounts will redirect to the main page of the creator, while bad IDs associated with [[inactive account]] s will display a 404 error or a removal notice. See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad source]] [[Protected link]] [
tags.wiki_zh: 来自<https://www.patreon.com>的陈旧且失效的来源链接。 与仍在活跃的账号相关联的错误ID会重定向到创作者的主页，而与 [[inactive account]] 相关联的错误ID则会显示404错误或删除通知。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad source]] [[Protected link]] [[Patreon reward]]

tags.name: self-portrait
tags.summary: A portrait of an artist drawn by the artist themselves. This also includes an [[original]] character or [[virtual youtuber]] representing them. When an artist uses the "inference about your figure from your name" sites to draw a self-portrait, use [[shindan maker]] instead. If the image contains bot
tags.wiki_zh: 由艺术家本人绘制的艺术家肖像。这也包括代表他们本人的 [[original]] 角色或 [[virtual youtuber]] 。 当艺术家使用“从你的名字推测你的形象”类网站来绘制自画像时，请改用 [[shindan maker]] 。 如果图片中同时并排包含插画和照片，还请使用 [[art vs artist]] 。 带有此标签的投稿应同时具有画师标签和角色标签。 示例 另请参阅 [[art vs artist]] [[artist self-insert]] 外部链接 Wikipedia: Self-portrait

tags.name: completion_time
tags.summary: When the artist has included the total time spent on the artwork. The time can be indicated on the image or in the [[commentary]] . Example: 1 hr 30 min See also [[one-hour drawing challenge]] , commentaries of which often include completion "overtimes" (i.e. +30min)
tags.wiki_zh: 当画师标注了创作该作品所花费的总时间时使用。时间可以标注在图片上，也可以在 [[commentary]] 中注明。 例如：1小时30分钟 另见 [[one-hour drawing challenge]] ，其说明文经常包含完成后的“加时”（即+30分钟）

tags.name: game_screenshot
tags.summary: A [[screenshot]] from a video game. Just like their counterpart [[anime screenshot]] , these posts are usually considered [[off-topic]] and may be deleted without notice. Not to be confused with [[game screenshot inset]] or [[game screenshot background]] or [[fake screenshot]] . See also
tags.wiki_zh: 来自电子游戏的 [[screenshot]] 。就像其对应物 [[anime screenshot]] 一样，这些投稿通常被视为 [[off-topic]] ，可能会被不经通知删除。 不要与 [[game screenshot inset]] 或 [[game screenshot background]] 或 [[fake screenshot]] 混淆。 另见 [[game asset]]

tags.name: koikatsu_(medium)
tags.summary: A [[3D]] [[animated|animation]] or image made using Illusion's 2018 eroge. For images of the default characters or the game itself, see [[Koikatsu]] . See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]]
tags.wiki_zh: 使用Illusion 2018年黄油制作的 [[3D]] [[animated|animation]] 或图像。关于默认角色或游戏本身的图像，见 [[Koikatsu]] 。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]]

tags.name: detexted
tags.summary: An image, usually a [[scan]] of a [[cover]] page, that has had its text [[third-party edit|edited]] out and had the background reconstructed. This tag is for images that have had their text removed by a [[third-party edit]] . Use [[textless version]] for text-free alternate versions released by the
tags.wiki_zh: 一张图片，通常是 [[scan]] 的 [[cover]] 页面，其文字已被 [[third-party edit|edited]] 掉，且背景经过了重绘修复。 本标签用于经由 [[third-party edit]] 去除文字的图片。原作者发布的无文字差分版本请使用 [[textless version]] 。 示例 去文字版 原图 另见 [[textless version]] [[third-party edit]] [[Tag group:Text]]

tags.name: end_card
tags.summary: An illustration that appears at the end of a show and is usually done by a [[guest art]] ist for the week. Examples See also [[eyecatch]] [[anime screenshot]]
tags.wiki_zh: 在节目结尾处出现的插画，通常由当周的 [[guest art]] ist绘制。 示例 另见 [[eyecatch]] [[anime screenshot]]

tags.name: paint_chat_(medium)
tags.summary: A category of collaborative drawing sites. Tagged Sites [[Magma (medium)]] [[MagicalDraw (medium)]] [[Drawpile (medium)]] [[iScribble (medium)]] See also [[artist collaboration]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一类协作绘画网站。 收录网站 [[Magma (medium)]] [[MagicalDraw (medium)]] [[Drawpile (medium)]] [[iScribble (medium)]] 另见 [[artist collaboration]]

tags.name: aliasing
tags.summary: An image defect that results in jagged or pixelated looking lines. Aliasing artifacts are mostly caused by the artist resizing the image poorly, or by poor filtering during [[3D]] rendering. [[Bilibili]] may also produce aliasing when image was [[downscaled]] to 1080px or 1500px. When tagging, judge
tags.wiki_zh: 一种会导致线条呈现锯齿状或像素化外观的图像缺陷。 锯齿伪影大多是由于画师对图像缩放处理不当，或在 [[3D]] 渲染期间滤波不佳造成的。 [[Bilibili]] 在图像被 [[downscaled]] 到1080px或1500px时，也可能产生锯齿。 打标签时，请以全分辨率判断图像，因为浏览器自身在缩放图像时也可能产生锯齿伪影。尤其要考虑不期望出现的图案的规律性以及预期的美术风格，因为并非所有 [[jaggy lines]] 都是由技术缺陷造成的。 本标签用于作为非预期技术缺陷的锯齿伪影。作为美术风格一部分的刻意锯齿效果，请参见 [[jaggy lines]] 。 [[Pixel art]] 和刻意的 [[dithering]] 也不应归入本标签。 另见 [[jaggy lines]] [[JPEG artifacts]] 外部链接 维基百科：Aliasing

tags.name: bad_nijie_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Nijie post or picture are no longer publicly available. Other Nijie errors Nijie samples: There is no sample size on Nijie, so this is not an issue [[MD5 mismatch]] : for when an image does not match Danbooru See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Nijie 投稿或图片已不再公开可见的情况。 其他 Nijie 相关错误 Nijie samples：Nijie 上没有 sample 尺寸，所以这不是问题 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：用于图片与 Danbooru 不匹配的情况 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]

tags.name: flash
tags.summary: As of March 31, 2021, uploading flash files is no longer possible. See forum #183397 for details. This tag is for games, [[music video]] s, and [[animated|animations]] created using [[adobe animate (medium)|Adobe Flash]] , as SWF files to be played with Flash Player. While Flash enjoyed success from
tags.wiki_zh: 截至2021年3月31日，已无法再上传flash文件。详情见 forum #183397。 此标签用于游戏、 [[music video]] 和 [[animated|animations]] ，它们是使用 [[adobe animate (medium)|Adobe Flash]] 制作的、以SWF文件形式存在、需用Flash Player播放的。 Flash在1990年代末到2000年代末曾取得巨大成功（尤其是因为Java平台在网页领域的失败），但随着JavaScript以及HTML5、WebGL等与浏览器无关的平台逐渐成熟，Flash最终走向衰落。Adobe认识到Flash已逐渐失去其重要性，于2017年宣布2020年12月之后将不再支持浏览器内的Flash插件；至2021年1月底，所有主流浏览器都已永久移除了对Flash的支持。 在Flash的生命周期中，Adobe在9版本之后对Flash播放器做了一处改动，导致许多旧文件无法正常播放。目前，带有此标签的51个帖子已通过翻转文件头中的一个标志位得到修复，详见 topic #15331，但如果发现此类文件，仍建议尝试使用9版本的独立播放器进行查看。 截至2021年3月，Danbooru已设置为使用Ruffle.js自动加载所有Flash帖子，Ruffle.js作为更广泛的Ruffle计划的一部分，使用WebAssembly在现代浏览器中模拟Flash。虽然这意味着你无需回退到足够老旧、仍支持原生Flash Player的过时浏览器即可查看Flash帖子，但请注意，Ruffle对Flash的核心模拟仍处于Alpha阶段，对于较新和／或更复杂的文件，能够正常运行的可能性较低。有关已人工确认可在Danbooru当前所用版本的Ruffle.js下正常运行的帖子，请见 [[ruffle compatible]] 。 另见

tags.name: microsoft_paint_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or edited with Microsoft Paint. For when the software itself is depicted in the image, use [[Microsoft Paint (software)]] instead. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Wikipedia: Microsoft Paint
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 Microsoft画图 创建或编辑的图像。 当图像中描绘的是该软件本身时，请改用 [[Microsoft Paint (software)]] 。 另请参见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：Microsoft画图

tags.name: comic_panel_redraw
tags.summary: When an artist redraws a panel, scene or page of a manga (or doujinshi). Examples See also [[screenshot redraw]] [[album cover redraw]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当画师重绘漫画（或同人志）中的一格分镜、场景或整页时。 示例 另见 [[screenshot redraw]] [[album cover redraw]]

tags.name: headwear_request
tags.summary: A request to identify specific type of [[hat]] , [[helmet]] or such. See also [[Tag Group:Attire]] [[Tag Group:Headwear]]
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨认具体类型的 [[hat]] 、 [[helmet]] 等。 另见 [[Tag Group:Attire]] [[Tag Group:Headwear]]

tags.name: mikumikudance_(medium)
tags.summary: A post created with MikuMikuDance, a [[3D]] animation program that allows users to create [[animated]] or still 3D renders. For posts referencing the software itself, use [[MikuMikuDance]] instead. Examples See also [[Koikatsu (medium)]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 MikuMikuDance 创作的投稿，该软件是一款 [[3D]] 动画程序，允许用户制作 [[animated]] 或静态 3D 渲染图。 若投稿内容指的是该软件本身，请改用 [[MikuMikuDance]] 。 示例 另见 [[Koikatsu (medium)]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 Wikipedia: MikuMikuDance

tags.name: annotation_request
tags.summary: This tag is a request to label everyone in the image with translation notes. Once this has been done, change it to [[annotated]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 该标签是请求用翻译注记来标注图像中的所有人物。完成后，请将其改为 [[annotated]] 。

tags.name: source_mismatch
tags.summary: A post whose source may have been correct in the past but now (perhaps due to an artist "revision") points to a completely different image (or set of images that does not contain that post). Formerly included in [[bad source]] , which is now maintained automatically. See also [[md5 mismatch]]
tags.wiki_zh: 来源过去可能是正确的，但现在（可能是由于画师的“修改”）指向了完全不同的图片（或不包含该投稿的一组图片）的投稿。 以前包含在 [[bad source]] 中，该标签现在为自动维护。 另见 [[md5 mismatch]]

tags.name: ych_commission
tags.summary: A type of [[commission]] (short for "Your Character Here") where the artist uploads an art piece featuring a [[base (art)|template]] character, allowing others to commission a finished version of the piece wherein the "template" character is replaced with the commissioner's
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 [[commission]] （即 "Your Character Here" 的缩写），指画师上传一幅带有 [[base (art)|template]] 角色的作品，允许他人委托该作品的完成版本，其中“模板”角色会被替换为委托人的 [[original|original character]] 或其选择的其他角色。 它们在 [[furry]] 社群中尤其受欢迎。YCH 通常通过专门网站出售，即 YCH.Commishes 出于打标签的目的，这可以指图片的模板版本或完成版本。 示例 另请参阅 [[Commission]] [[Derivative work]]

tags.name: bad_blogspot_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Blogger or blogspot image, rather than to the post containing the image.
