tags.name: ballpoint_pen_(medium)
tags.summary: Art drawn using a ballpoint pen.
tags.wiki_zh: 使用圆珠笔绘制的画作。

tags.name: fantia_reward
tags.summary: A [[paid reward]] from Fantia. Uploading paid rewards is no longer allowed. Paid rewards uploaded after 2020-07-06 should be reported in topic #32324. See forum #168930 for details. See also [[paid reward]] External links Fantia
tags.wiki_zh: 来自Fantia的 [[paid reward]] 。 不再允许上传付费特典。在2020-07-06之后上传的付费特典应在topic #32324中举报。详情见forum #168930。 另见 [[paid reward]] 外部链接 Fantia

tags.name: psd_available
tags.summary: Indicates that a PSD (Photoshop Document) file for the post is available elsewhere. PSD files are not uploadable to Danbooru, so add this tag and leave a comment with a link to the PSD whenever one is found. If only the PSD file is available, convert it to a PNG and upload the PNG instead. See also
tags.wiki_zh: 表示该投稿的 PSD（Photoshop Document）文件可在别处获取。PSD 文件无法上传到 Danbooru，因此每当找到 PSD 时，请加上此标签，并在评论中留下 PSD 的链接。 如果只有 PSD 文件可用，请将其转换为 PNG 后上传该 PNG。 另请参见 [[merged layers]] [[PDF available]] [[Help:Image Source]]

tags.name: bad_instagram_id
tags.summary: Bad image source link from [[Instagram]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 [[Instagram]] 的无效图片来源链接。

tags.name: adoptable
tags.summary: An art adoptable is an [[original]] character design that is put up for sale or auction by the artist. The purchaser usually receives a higher resolution version of the initial illustration, alongside permission to use the character however they please.
tags.wiki_zh: 艺术领养是指由画师拿出来出售或拍卖的 [[original]] 角色设计。购买者通常会收到初版插画的更高分辨率版本，以及随意使用该角色的许可。

tags.name: bad_weibo_id
tags.summary: Used for any post from [[Weibo]] that is no longer publicly available there, because the work was either deleted, made private, or another broken source link. Image domain: *.sinaimg.cn *.photo.sina.com.cn See also [[weibo_sample]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于来自 [[Weibo]] 、在原站已无法公开访问的投稿，因为作品已被删除、设为私密，或存在其他损坏的来源链接。 图片域名：*.sinaimg.cn *.photo.sina.com.cn 另见 [[weibo_sample]]

tags.name: music_video
tags.summary: A video set to [[audible music|music]] (instrumental or [[audible speech|not]] ). See also [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]
tags.wiki_zh: 以 [[audible music|music]] （器乐或 [[audible speech|not]] ）为配乐的视频。 另见 [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: ink_(medium)
tags.summary: A medium that consists of [[ink]] which has been applied to a surface, typically paper. The ink can be applied using different tools, such as a [[nib pen (medium)|nib pen]] , [[ballpoint pen (medium)|ballpoint pen]] , [[millipen (medium)|technical pen]] , [[marker_(medium)|marker]] , or
tags.wiki_zh: 一种由涂抹在表面（通常是纸张）上的 [[ink]] 构成的媒介。墨水可以用不同的工具来涂抹，例如 [[nib pen (medium)|nib pen]] 、 [[ballpoint pen (medium)|ballpoint pen]] 、 [[millipen (medium)|technical pen]] 、 [[marker_(medium)|marker]] 或 [[calligraphy brush (medium)|brush]] ，也可以通过 [[print_(medium)|printmaking process]] 来涂抹。墨水通常为黑色，但也可以是蓝色，例如某些圆珠笔的情况，或 [[color ink (medium)|come in many colors]] 。根据使用方法的不同，墨水可以呈现为粗细均匀或粗细变化的线条，或大面积的色块。 外部链接 维基百科：墨水

tags.name: bad_poipiku_id
tags.summary: Used for when any POIPIKU post or picture is no longer publicly available. See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 POIPIKU 投稿或图片已不再公开可用的情况。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]

tags.name: check_clothing
tags.summary: The clothing for a particular post has been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.
tags.wiki_zh: 该帖子中的服装已被辨识出来，但还需要第二个意见来进行确认。

tags.name: 60+fps
tags.summary: An [[animated|animation]] with a framerate of atleast 60 fps. When in doubt, you can check the metadata of a file yourself by clicking on the » arrow next to the Size of a post under the Information header and look for the Video Frame Rate value. [thead] [th]1. Open a post[/th] [/thead] [tbody] post
tags.wiki_zh: 帧率至少为60fps的 [[animated|animation]] 。 如有疑问，你可以点击帖子Information标题下Size旁边的 » 箭头自行查看文件的元数据，并查找Video Frame Rate值。 [thead] [th]1. 打开一个帖子[/th] [/thead] [tbody] post #3838401 [/tbody] [thead] [th]2. 向下滚动到Information部分[/th] [/thead] [tbody] Information ID: 3838401 Uploader: "Etou":[/users/604696] Date: "X年多以前":[/posts?tags=date%3A2020-03-28] Size: 14.1 MB (960x720) "»":[/media_assets/3804855] Source: youtu.be/PcrhnroAHU8 » Rating: General Score: 🡅 "XX":[/post_votes?search%5Bpost_id%5D=3838401&variant=compact] 🡇 Favorites: "XXX":[/posts/3838401/favorites] Status: Active [/tbody] [thead] [th]3. 点击"Size"字段末尾的 » 箭头[/th] [/thead] [tbody] Size: 14.1 MB (960x720) "»":[/media_assets/3804855] [/tbody] [thead] [th]4. 向下滚动直到Track1部分。[/th] [/thead] [tbody] ... Track Volume "0.00%":[/media_assets?search%5Bmetada

tags.name: audible_internal_cumshot
tags.summary: An internal ejaculation that can be audibly heard in a post with [[sound]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 在带有 [[sound]] 的帖子中能够用听觉听到的体内射精。

tags.name: imageboard_first-party_source
tags.summary: A post that was originally uploaded on another imageboard by the artist themselves, and then uploaded from there to Danbooru. Posts from these sites, such as [[Gelbooru]] , [[e621]] or [[Rule34.xxx]] , are almost always reposts, so this tag is used to find the rare exceptions. Imageboards like
tags.wiki_zh: 指画师本人在其他图板上最初上传，然后再从那里转载到Danbooru的投稿。 来自这些网站的投稿，例如 [[Gelbooru]] 、 [[e621]] 或 [[Rule34.xxx]] ，几乎总是转载，因此此标签用于找出罕见的例外。像 [[Vinesauce]] 的Vinebooru这样的图板不计入此标签，因为 [[self-upload]] 对它们来说才是常态。

tags.name: object_request
tags.summary: When an object that almost certainly has a name cannot be identified, use this tag.
tags.wiki_zh: 当遇到一个几乎肯定有名字、却无法辨认的物体时，请使用此标签。

tags.name: twitter_sample
tags.summary: A image from Twitter that is an [[image sample]] , rather than the original image. Original images end with :orig. Sample images don't. To avoid uploading a sample, paste a link to the image on the upload page, rather than downloading the image to your computer then uploading it. In addition to imag
tags.wiki_zh: 来自推特的 [[image sample]] 图片，而非原图。 原图以 :orig 结尾。示例图则没有。 为避免上传示例图，请在上传页面粘贴图片链接，而不是先将图片下载到电脑上再上传。 除了打有此标签的图片外，任何符合以下任一搜索条件、且在视觉上完全相同的图片，也会被视为推特示例图： {{source:*twitter.com/ md5_mismatch -upscaled status:active}} {{source:*pbs.twimg.com/ md5_mismatch -upscaled status:active}} 不过，请确保它们与原图相当一致。有时来源可能是错误的。这不包括例如 post #2440268 这样的编辑版本。 示例 示例图：https://pbs.twimg.com/media/C2uQastUQAE5nyc.jpg (900x1200) 原图：https://pbs.twimg.com/media/C2uQastUQAE5nyc.jpg:orig (1200x1600) 另见 [[bad twitter id]] [[md5 mismatch]] [[image sample]] [[help:twitter]]

tags.name: pdf_available
tags.summary: Indicates that a PDF (Portable Document Format) file for the post is available elsewhere. PDF files are not uploadable to Danbooru, so add this tag and leave a comment with a link to the PDF whenever one is found. If only the PDF file is available, extract the images from the PDF and upload the imag
tags.wiki_zh: 表示该投稿在别处有 PDF（便携式文档格式）文件可用。PDF 文件无法上传到 Danbooru，因此每当找到 PDF 时，请添加此标签，并在评论中留下 PDF 的链接。 如果只有 PDF 文件可用，请从 PDF 中提取图片并改为上传这些图片。与 XpdfReader 一同提供的 pdfimages 程序就是可用于提取图片的工具之一。 另见 [[PSD available]] [[Help:Image Source]] 外部链接 Xpdfreader.com 维基百科：Xpdf 维基百科：Pdfimages

tags.name: bad_facebook_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Facebook image, rather than to the Facebook post containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's often no way to find the original Facebook post from the image link, and the hashes of URLs will expire after a period of time. If you
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源是 Facebook 图片直链，而非包含该图片的 Facebook 帖子链接的投稿。这些被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为通常无法从图片链接找到原始的 Facebook 帖子，而且 URL 中的哈希值会在一段时间后过期。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，请务必将来源栏中的图片直链改为你找到该图片的 Facebook 帖子。 有些图片 URL 能正确解析出帖子 ID，但很多不能，同时又不属于 [[Bad Facebook ID]] ；请务必在来源处检查图片直链，看它是错误的 ID 还是单纯的错误链接。 可能缺失无效 Facebook 链接标签的投稿可以用此搜索找到：{{source:*fbcdn.net/* -source:*instagram* -bad_facebook_link}} 示例 <https://scontent.fyto1-2.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/472080657_894586295997509_4861525475589770228_n.jpg?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=dd6889&_nc_ohc=TYlI9dgesBoQ7kNvwGN9lw2&_nc_oc=Adqvq5Asfy1Y6Kgwqgtxe2MBg5ZU9mXoB_8WtlLAVsFL9eRcWL0W5GwyIxXrl3_fFjbdUApZf-_hJWIupVTsChR8&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent.fyto1-2.fna&_nc_gid=r1fRpmK1UQEoTzd97OMZ1A&_nc_ss=7a32e&oh=00_Afx_WN4RjRbL9hYMl4EZ4vI_lgWbd1tWvU4alim0-t_Ybw&oe=69CE4EFF>（错误链接，错误地解析为 <https://www.face

tags.name: story_in_commentary
tags.summary: Whenever an artist makes a story about the picture in [[commentary]] , giving some context about how the characters ended up in that situation or what happened next. It can be a simple dialogue (e.g. post #9147039) or a more detailed story (e.g. post #9295508). See also [[English commentary]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当画师在 [[commentary]] 中为图片创作故事时，提供一些关于角色如何陷入这种处境或接下来发生了什么的背景。 可以是简单的对话（例如 post #9147039），也可以是更详细的故事（例如 post #9295508）。 另见 [[English commentary]] [[Mixed-language commentary]] [[detailed creation commentary]]

tags.name: french_commentary
tags.summary: Artist [[commentary]] that is written in [[french_text|French]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 画师 [[commentary]] ，是以 [[french_text|French]] 写成的。

tags.name: watercolor_pencil_(medium)
tags.summary: Written「水彩色鉛筆」, water-soluble pigments packaged as a pencil, delivering the advantages of both [[colored pencil (medium)|colored pencil]] and [[watercolor (medium)|watercolor]] in being able to draw fine details and also to blend them with water.
tags.wiki_zh: 写作「水彩色鉛筆」，即封装成铅笔状的水溶性颜料，同时具备 [[colored pencil (medium)|colored pencil]] 和 [[watercolor (medium)|watercolor]] 的优点，既能绘制精细细节，也能用水将其晕染融合。

tags.name: calligraphy_brush_(medium)
tags.summary: A tag used when an image has elements created through use of a calligraphy brush. For a calligraphy brush appearing in an image, use [[calligraphy brush]] . Pictures painted using a calligraphy brush may contain Asian writing (as seen in post #3218220) and a [[seal impression]] (also shown in exampl
tags.wiki_zh: 当图片中含有使用毛笔创作的元素时使用的标签。若图片中出现了毛笔本身，请使用 [[calligraphy brush]] 。 使用毛笔绘制的图片可能包含亚洲文字（如 post #3218220 所示）以及 [[seal impression]] （示例中同样有展示）。 它与 [[watercolor (medium)]] 不同。 另见： [[brush_(medium)]] [[traditional media]] [[ink wash painting]] [[sumi-e]]

tags.name: enty_reward
tags.summary: A [[paid reward]] from Enty. Uploading paid rewards is no longer allowed. Paid rewards uploaded after 2020-07-06 should be reported in topic #32324. See forum #168930 for details. See also [[paid reward]] External links Enty
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 Enty 的 [[paid reward]] 。 不再允许上传付费奖励。在 2020-07-06 之后上传的付费奖励应前往 topic #32324 举报。详情见 forum #168930。 另见 [[paid reward]] 外部链接 Enty

tags.name: bad_fanbox_id
tags.summary: Bad source link from [[Pixiv]] FANBOX. See also [[Fanbox reward]]
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 [[Pixiv]] FANBOX的错误源链接。 另请参见 [[Fanbox reward]]

tags.name: thumbnail_collage
tags.summary: A series of images in a gallery or carousel post arranged in such a way that, when put together by Twitter or other platforms, they form a separate, cohesive image in the thumbnail. Parent posts as needed. If there is a [[stitched]] version, whether done by the artist or another user, parent the col
tags.wiki_zh: 在画廊或轮播帖子中的一系图片，以这样的方式排列：当被 Twitter 或其他平台拼合在一起时，会在缩略图中形成一张独立的、完整的图片。按需要建立父子帖子关系。 如果存在 [[stitched]] 版本，无论是由画师本人还是其他用户制作的，请将拼贴帖子作为子帖关联到它，但不要使用本标签。如果拼合图上存在官方图片分割痕迹，请额外使用 [[social media composition]] 。 示例 post #8030953 post #8105537 post #6532959 post #12050033 另见 [[social media composition]] [[segmented comic]] [[Tag group:Image composition]]

tags.name: waifu2x
tags.summary: Single-Image Super-Resolution for Anime-Style Art using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks. An [[upscaled|upscaling]] and [[noise reduction]] algorithm specifically designed to work on 2D anime-style art. Like any other form of [[third-party edit|third-party]] [[upscaled|upscaling]] , third-party Wa
tags.wiki_zh: 使用深度卷积神经网络针对动漫风格插画的单图像超分辨率。 一种专门用于处理2D动漫风格插画的 [[upscaled|upscaling]] 和 [[noise reduction]] 算法。 与任何其他形式的 [[third-party edit|third-party]] [[upscaled|upscaling]] 一样，第三方Waifu2X放大的图片仅在无法获得原图时才会被接受，如果原图已上传，则应被标记/删除。 如果你想上传一张经过Waifu2X处理的图片，请先按照 [[help:image source]] 中的说明尝试寻找原图，只有在以图搜图失败后才上传放大版本。 另请参见 [[image sample]] [[resized]] 外部链接 在线演示应用：https://www.waifu2x.net/

tags.name: tumblr_sample
tags.summary: An [[image sample]] from Tumblr. Tumblr images carry one of multiple available file name suffixes: _75sq (sample; thumbnail) _100 (sample; thumbnail) _250 (sample) _400 (sample) _500 (sample; sometimes original, see forum #132817) _500h (sample; height-bounded) _540 (sample) _640 (sample) _1280 (sam
tags.wiki_zh: 一张来自 Tumblr 的 [[image sample]] 。 Tumblr 图片带有以下多种可用文件名后缀之一： _75sq（样本；缩略图） _100（样本；缩略图） _250（样本） _400（样本） _500（样本；有时是原图，见 forum #132817） _500h（样本；高度受限） _540（样本） _640（样本） _1280（样本；有时是原图） _raw（已停用） Danbooru 的政策是替换样本图或将其删除。更多信息见 [[image sample]] 。关于如何正确地从 Tumblr 上传，见 [[help:tumblr]] 。 另见 [[Bad Tumblr ID]]

tags.name: countdown_illustration
aliases: カウントダウンイラスト
tags.summary: An illustration meant to count down the number days before an event such as the release of a video game or series. May or may not include an actual [[countdown]] in the image itself.
tags.wiki_zh: 一种用于倒数距离某个事件（例如电子游戏或系列作品发售）剩余天数的插画。图片本身可能包含也可能不包含实际的 [[countdown]] 。

tags.name: ruffle_compatible
tags.summary: [[Flash]] posts that have been manually confirmed to work with the version of the Ruffle.js emulator that's currently used by Danbooru (you can right-click on any Ruffle player window to see the version number). If you happen to be running the browser extension version of Ruffle.js, which sometimes
tags.wiki_zh: 经人工确认可在 Danbooru 当前使用的 Ruffle.js 模拟器版本下正常运行的 [[Flash]] 作品（可以在任意 Ruffle 播放器窗口上右键查看版本号）。如果你正在使用浏览器扩展版的 Ruffle.js，它有时会覆盖网站自身托管的版本，请先关闭扩展，并确认作品在 Danbooru 当前托管的版本下仍可正常运行，再为该作品添加此标签。 只要能够播放且大体上可以观看（如果是 [[flash game]] ，则还需可以游玩），即使存在画面错误也符合此标签。

tags.name: indonesian_commentary
tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[indonesian_text|Indonesian]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 关于 [[commentary]] ，其以 [[indonesian_text|Indonesian]] 书写。

tags.name: origins
aliases: 全てはここから始まった
tags.summary: A work that inspired a lasting trend or [[meme]] . This isn't for the first picture of a trend posted on Danbooru, but for the original picture that started the trend. This does not include [[anime screenshot]] s or manga panels that are the origin of popular [[scene reference]] s or
tags.wiki_zh: 启发了持久潮流或 [[meme]] 的作品。此标签并非用于在Danbooru上发布的某个潮流的第一张图片，而是用于开创该潮流的原始图片。 这不包括 [[anime screenshot]] 或漫画分镜，它们是热门 [[scene reference]] 或 [[source quote]] 的起源（例如 [[people die if they are killed (meme)|]] ）。 示例 [[Yukkuri shiteitte ne]] 的起源 [[Black Rock Shooter (Character)|]] 的起源

tags.name: vehicle_request
tags.summary: Request to identify the make and model (e.g. [[toyota supra]] ) and/or type (e.g. [[hover bike]] ) of a vehicle in a post.
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨认帖子中车辆的品牌和型号（例如 [[toyota supra]] ）和/或类型（例如 [[hover bike]] ）。

tags.name: krita_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or edited with Krita. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Official Repository Wikipedia: Krita
tags.wiki_zh: 使用Krita创建或编辑的图像。 另请参阅 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 官方仓库 维基百科：Krita

tags.name: epilepsy_warning
tags.summary: A post containing visual elements that may cause epileptic seizures in susceptible people. While most commonly associated with rapid [[animated|animation]] and flashing lights, certain still patterns can also potentially trigger seizures, particularly patterns that appear to move via
tags.wiki_zh: 包含可能导致易感人群癫痫发作的视觉元素的帖子。虽然最常与快速的 [[animated|animation]] 和闪烁灯光有关，但某些静态图案也可能引发发作，特别是那些通过 [[optical illusion]] 看起来像在动的图案，以及 [[high contrast]] 重复几何图案。 关于静态图案如何引发光敏性癫痫的例子，请参见 asset #47834377（风险自负，点击需谨慎），取自这篇文章 如果您会受到影响，作为预防措施，您应该在“账号设置”:/settings 中将此标签加入您的 [[help:blacklists|blacklist]] 。 不应仅因为图片颜色鲜艳、可能造成眼睛疲劳就使用此标签。 另请参见 [[volume warning]] [[help:blacklists]] 外部链接 维基百科：癫痫发作 维基百科：光敏性癫痫 英国癫痫协会：光敏性癫痫

tags.name: hard-translated_(non-english)
tags.summary: An image that has been [[third-party_edit|edited]] by a third party to replace the original text (Japanese or otherwise) with a translation into any language that isn't English. Non-English hard translations are against the [[help:upload rules|rules]] and may only be uploaded if the original cannot
tags.wiki_zh: 一张经由第三方 [[third-party_edit|edited]] ，将原文（日语或其他语言）替换为除英语以外的任何语言译文的图片。 非英文硬字翻译违反 [[help:upload rules|rules]] ，仅在原图无处可寻时才可上传。若已上传原图，这些帖子可能会被标记并删除。 另见 [[hard-translated]]

tags.name: pastel_(medium)
tags.summary: Pastel is an art medium in the form of a stick consisting of pure powdered pigment and a binder.
tags.wiki_zh: 粉彩是一种绘画媒介，形态为棒状，由纯粉末颜料与黏合剂制成。

tags.name: bad_arca.live_id
tags.summary: An image from [Arca.Live] that is no longer accessible.
tags.wiki_zh: 来自Arca.Live的已无法访问的图片。

tags.name: bad_artstation_id
tags.summary: Used for when any ArtStation post or picture are no longer publicly available. Other ArtStation errors [[ArtStation sample]] : for when a size other than the full size is used [[MD5 mismatch]] : for when none of the sizes match Danbooru See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad CGHub ID]] [[Bad Link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 ArtStation 帖子或图片已不再公开可见的情况。 其他 ArtStation 错误 [[ArtStation sample]] ：用于使用了非完整尺寸的情况 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：用于所有尺寸都与 Danbooru 不匹配的情况 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad CGHub ID]] [[Bad Link]]

tags.name: third-party_extraction
tags.summary: An image of a character or group of characters that has been taken from another image and has had all other characters, objects, and backgrounds removed from it. When this is done by the original artist, use [[first-party extraction]] . Example Original image [[Third-party extraction]]
tags.wiki_zh: 取自另一张图片的角色或一组角色的图像，其中所有其他角色、物体和背景均已被移除。 当此操作由原作者完成时，请使用 [[first-party extraction]] 。 示例 原图 [[Third-party extraction]]

tags.name: costume_request
tags.summary: A tag used when one does not know the name of the [[official alternate costume]] shown, or whether it is just an [[alternate costume]] . Not to be confused with [[clothing request]] or [[cosplay request]] . Remove this tag once the costume in question has been identified.
tags.wiki_zh: 当不知道图中所示的 [[official alternate costume]] 的名称，或不确定它是否只是 [[alternate costume]] 时使用的标签。 不要与 [[clothing request]] 或 [[cosplay request]] 混淆。 当相关服装已被确认后，请移除此标签。

tags.name: artist-provided_artwork
tags.summary: A post with a [[non-web source]] because the file was provided directly to the uploader by the artist. See also [[commissioner upload]] [[self-upload]]
tags.wiki_zh: 因文件由画师直接提供给上传者而带有 [[non-web source]] 的帖子。 另见 [[commissioner upload]] [[self-upload]]

tags.name: eyecatch
tags.summary: In manga, the leading hero image on the first page of a chapter. In anime, the stills before and after the commercial break in the middle of the show and usually illustrated by the production studio doing the show or official illustrators of the series. Often bears the show's logo. They sometimes lo
tags.wiki_zh: 在漫画中，指章节第一页上的主打主视觉图。 在动画中，指在节目中段广告前后播放的静止画面，通常由制作该节目的制作工作室或该系列的官方画师绘制。通常会带有节目的标志。 它们有时与章节/剧集内容大致相关，但有时只是无关的粉丝服务。 另请参见 [[end card]] [[anime screenshot]] [[cover]] [[loading screen]] [[TTGL eyecatch]]

tags.name: spine_(medium)
tags.summary: 2D skeletal animation software. Primarily intended for use in games and other software, it can also be used for standalone animations. See also [[Live2D]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]]
tags.wiki_zh: 2D骨骼动画软件。主要用于游戏和其他软件，也可用于制作独立动画。 另见 [[Live2D]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]]

tags.name: source_filmmaker_(medium)
tags.summary: Source Filmmaker (often abbreviated as SFM) is a video capture and editing application developed by [[Valve Corporation]] for use within the Source game engine. Source Filmmaker was initially used as an internal tool for the development of animated shorts. Some of the earliest examples are the relea
tags.wiki_zh: Source Filmmaker（常简称为 SFM）是由 [[Valve Corporation]] 开发的一款视频捕捉与编辑应用，用于 Source 游戏引擎内。 Source Filmmaker 最初是作为开发动画短片的内部工具使用的。最早的例子包括《Day of Defeat》的发售预告片以及 [[Team Fortress 2]] 的“Meet the Heavy”短片。 Source Filmmaker 自 2012 年 7 月 11 日起进入公开测试阶段，并可通过 [[Steam (platform)|]] 免费获取，用户可以在其中导入与 Source 引擎兼容的自定义模型和地图，并将其用于自己的动画中。 另请参见 [[3d]] [[video]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 Steam 商店页面 维基百科：Source Filmmaker 维基百科：Source（游戏引擎）

tags.name: portuguese_commentary
tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[portuguese_text|Portuguese]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 关于以 [[commentary]] 形式用 [[portuguese_text|Portuguese]] 写成的内容。

tags.name: meme_request
tags.summary: Use if you're unable to identify a [[meme]] in the post, or if you don't know what the matching tag is.
tags.wiki_zh: 如果您无法辨认帖子中的 [[meme]] ，或不知道对应的标签是什么，请使用此标签。

tags.name: parody_request
tags.summary: When the presence of another parody is not tagged, and you don't know its origins. Leave a comment about it with whatever details you can spare- The posture, genre of origin, gender(s) of the source parody, anything that precedes or follows the parody depicted.
tags.wiki_zh: 当存在另一个未被打上标签的恶搞，且你不知道它的出处时使用。请留下评论，尽可能提供你所知道的细节——姿势、出处作品的类型、原恶搞中的性别，以及所描绘的恶搞之前或之后发生的任何情节。

tags.name: corrupted_metadata
tags.summary: An image that has incorrectly set or corrupted EXIF data This may cause issues like wrong rotation or stripped color profiles.
tags.wiki_zh: EXIF数据设置错误或已损坏的图片 这可能会导致旋转错误或色彩配置文件丢失等问题。

tags.name: contest_winner
tags.summary: An image that has won a prize in a contest. The image should also have a tag identifying the contest.
tags.wiki_zh: 在比赛中获奖的图片。 该图片还应带有标识该比赛的标签。

tags.name: 24-hour_relay
tags.summary: A type of fandom event / art game that lasts for a certain number of hours, traditionally 24, but sometimes longer. An artist is assigned to each hour, and must post a piece of artwork for that hour. These events are common in Chinese fandom spaces and are usually themed around a specific copyright,
tags.wiki_zh: 一种同人活动/绘画接力游戏，会持续一定的小时数，传统上为24小时，但有时会更长。每个小时会指定一位画师，必须为该小时发布一幅作品。这类活动在中国同人圈很常见，通常围绕特定的版权、角色或配对展开。 举办日期通常与某个节日或角色 [[birthday]] 相对应。 另见 [[One-hour drawing challenge]] [[Art relay]]

tags.name: bad_yandere_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Yandere post or picture are no longer publicly available. Other Yandere errors [[Yandere sample]] : for when a size other than the full size is used [[MD5 mismatch]] : for when none of the sizes match Danbooru See also [[Bad ID]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Yandere 帖子或图片不再公开可用的情况。 其它 Yandere 错误 [[Yandere sample]] ：用于使用了非完整尺寸的情况 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：用于所有尺寸都与 Danbooru 不符的情况 另见 [[Bad ID]]

tags.name: reverse_translation
tags.summary: A post that has been [[translated]] (using translation notes) from English to another language (usually Japanese), or from a dialect of English back to standard English. See also [[Tag group:Text]]
tags.wiki_zh: 指已通过 [[translated]] （使用翻译注释）从英语翻译成另一种语言（通常是日语），或从英语方言翻回标准英语的帖子。 另见 [[Tag group:Text]]

tags.name: e-hentai_sample
tags.summary: An [[image sample]] from E-hentai. If you come across one of these, mention it in the post replacement thread (topic #16765). Read [[help:ehentai]] to learn how to avoid uploading ehentai samples. See also [[exhentai]] [[nhentai]]
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 E-hentai 的 [[image sample]] 。如果你遇到其中之一，请在帖子替换串（topic #16765）中提及。阅读 [[help:ehentai]] 以了解如何避免上传 ehentai 样本。 另见 [[exhentai]] [[nhentai]]

tags.name: artstation_sample
tags.summary: An [[image sample]] from ArtStation. An ArtStation sample can either have lower image dimensions, or have the same dimensions but truncated bit-by-bit quality. ArtStation formerly had a much more complicated image sampling issue, which can be referred back to by looking at previous revisions of this
tags.wiki_zh: 来自ArtStation的 [[image sample]] 。 ArtStation示例图可能具有更低的图像尺寸，或者具有相同的尺寸但逐比特质量被截断。 ArtStation以前曾有过更为复杂的图像抽样问题，可以通过查看本文此前的修订版本或查看 [[help:artstation]] 中避免示例图的旧版流程来回溯。现在用户可能会错误地从包含“/small/”或“/medium/”而非正确的“/large/”的图片URL上传，可由版主替换，或通过上传未抽样版本并手动删除示例图来解决。以前还曾有第四种“/original/”，可手动访问以节省带宽。据称ArtStation为了节省带宽也终止了对此类文件的访问。 另请参阅 [[Bad ArtStation ID]]

tags.name: bad_piapro_id
tags.summary: An image from Piapro that is no longer accessible.
tags.wiki_zh: 来自Piapro的、现已无法访问的图片。

tags.name: figure_available
tags.summary: The artwork that a three-dimensional [[figure]] is directly based on, most likely in the form of a [[tachi-e]] or [[invisible chair]] . Or sometimes a [[promotional art]] where said figure is held by a character. Helps to indicate which figure in the comments. See also [[figure]] [[figure (medium)]]
tags.wiki_zh: 直接作为三维 [[figure]] 原型来源的画作，最常见的形式是 [[tachi-e]] 或 [[invisible chair]] 。有时则是指角色手持该手办的 [[promotional art]] 。有助于在评论中指明是哪个手办。 另请参见 [[figure]] [[figure (medium)]] [[promotional art]] [[paid reward available]]

tags.name: traditional_chinese_commentary
tags.summary: Artist [[commentary]] that is written in Traditional Chinese. See also [[traditional chinese text]]
tags.wiki_zh: 以繁体中文书写的作者 [[commentary]] 。 另见 [[traditional chinese text]]

tags.name: ko-fi_commission
tags.summary: A work [[commission]] ed via ko-fi.
tags.wiki_zh: 通过 ko-fi [[commission]] 创作的作品。

tags.name: deviantart_sample
tags.summary: An [[image sample]] from DeviantArt. DeviantArt image URLs sometimes contain either the string "200H" or "PRE". These URLs point to scaled down images, not the full size. 200H URLs point to small thumbnails, scaled down to 200 pixels. PRE URLs point to medium-sized samples, displayed on the art page
tags.wiki_zh: 来自DeviantArt的 [[image sample]] 。 DeviantArt的图片URL有时会包含字符串“200H”或“PRE”。这些URL指向的是缩小后的图片，而非完整尺寸。200H的URL指向缩小到200像素的小缩略图，PRE的URL指向中等尺寸的样本，如果完整尺寸的图片过大，画作页面默认会显示这种样本。如果从这类样本URL中去掉“200H/”或“PRE/”部分，得到的URL将指向完整尺寸版本。 当上传到Danbooru的图片是这类缩小版本之一时，应使用此标签。 Danbooru的政策是替换样本或将其删除。更多信息见 [[image sample]] 。关于如何正确地从DeviantArt上传，见 [[help:deviantart]] 。 另见 [[Bad DeviantArt ID]]

tags.name: bmp-to-png_conversion
tags.summary: Image that was converted from BMP to PNG before uploading.
tags.wiki_zh: 在上传前从BMP转换为PNG的图像。

tags.name: partially_annotated
tags.summary: This tag indicates only some of the characters or items in an image have been [[annotated]] . Related tags [[annotated]] [[annotation request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 该标签表示图像中只有部分角色或物品被 [[annotated]] 。 相关标签 [[annotated]] [[annotation request]]

tags.name: mousepad_(medium)
tags.summary: An image in the shape of a mousepad. This is usually a novelty mousepad where the wrist cushion is a character's [[breasts]] , [[pectorals]] , [[ass]] , or some other body part. See [[mousepad (object)]] for when the image contains a physical mousepad. Examples See also [[ass mousepad]]
tags.wiki_zh: 形状为鼠标垫的图像。通常是指一种新奇鼠标垫，其手腕托是角色的 [[breasts]] 、 [[pectorals]] 、 [[ass]] 或其他身体部位。 当图像中包含实体的鼠标垫时，请参见 [[mousepad (object)]] 。 示例 另请参见 [[ass mousepad]] [[breast mousepad]] [[crotch mousepad]] [[bulge mousepad]] [[foot mousepad]] [[computer]]

tags.name: bad_mihuashi_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Mihuashi post or picture is no longer publicly available. See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]] [[Mihuashi sample]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何米花师的帖子或图片不再公开可见时。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]] [[Mihuashi sample]]

tags.name: papercraft_(medium)
tags.summary: Artwork made from paper. This includes [[paper child]] art, paper [[sculpture]] , paper cutting, [[origami]] , [[kirigami]] , and so on. For artwork that is simply drawn on paper without incorporating the paper itself into the design, see [[traditional media]] . For templates made to be printed, cut
tags.wiki_zh: 由纸张制作的美术作品。包括 [[paper child]] 艺术、纸 [[sculpture]] 、剪纸、 [[origami]] 、 [[kirigami]] 等等。 对于只是画在纸上、而没有将纸张本身融入设计的作品，请参见 [[traditional media]] 。 对于用来打印、剪下并折叠成模型的模板，请参见 [[paper cutout]] 。

tags.name: video_thumbnail
tags.summary: Artworks that serve as thumbnails for actual videos (e.g. [[YouTube]] , [[NicoNico]] , [[bilibili]] ). [[Fake screenshot]] s, redrawn thumbnails, and [[parody|parodies]] are excluded. This tag should only be used in one of the following cases: The original artist themselves created a video using the
tags.wiki_zh: 用作实际视频缩略图的插画作品（例如 [[YouTube]] 、 [[NicoNico]] 、 [[bilibili]] ）。 [[Fake screenshot]] 、重绘的缩略图以及 [[parody|parodies]] 除外。 此标签仅应在以下情况之一中使用： 原作者本人使用自己的插画制作了视频（例如 post #6849506 和 post #5598651） 有人直接委托画师为其视频创作图片（即获得了将其用作缩略图的许可，例如 post #6766229） Youtube 和 bilibili 上的 [[Making-of]] 视频总是会将相应的插画用作缩略图。然而，这些不得打上此标签，因为这会稀释其效用并使其变得多余。 示例 [https://youtu.be/_NMUqAoKlpQ](youtu.be/_NMUqAoKlpQ) 另请参见 [[YouTube video thumbnail]]

tags.name: tegaki_draw_and_tweet
tags.summary: [[Tatsuya_(maboroshi)]] 's raster graphics editor. Not to be confused with pipa.jp's [[tegaki]] blog. See also Official page: http://www.kannagi.net/TEGAKI/
tags.wiki_zh: [[Tatsuya_(maboroshi)]] 的位图图形编辑器。 不要与 pipa.jp 的 [[tegaki]] 博客混淆。 另见 官方页面：http://www.kannagi.net/TEGAKI/

tags.name: exif_rotation
tags.summary: An image that has a rotation specified in its Exif metadata. JPEG files can have a flag that tells the viewer to flip or rotate the image. In some older browsers or programs, the image may appear to be sideways or upside-down if the program doesn't support EXIF rotation. For some very old images, th
tags.wiki_zh: 指在Exif元数据中指定了旋转的图片。JPEG文件可以带有一个标志，告诉查看器翻转或旋转图像。 在一些较旧的浏览器或程序中，如果程序不支持EXIF旋转，图片可能会显示为侧向或上下颠倒。对于一些非常老的图片，由于画师本人不知道图片包含EXIF旋转，图片可能也会显示为侧向或上下颠倒。 参见 issue #3692。

tags.name: rotated
tags.summary: When the whole image is rotated, usually a [[third-party edit]] to make a [[sideways]] or [[upside-down]] image right-side up. If the original image is placed at a 90 degree angle to the audience without third-party editing,please use [[sideways]] . See also [[sideways]] [[reversed]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当整张图片被旋转时，通常是将 [[third-party edit]] 旋转，以使 [[sideways]] 或 [[upside-down]] 图片摆正。 如果原始图像未经第三方编辑，就以与观众成 90 度角的方式呈现，请使用 [[sideways]] 。 另见 [[sideways]] [[reversed]] [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: official_art_redraw
aliases: 公式絵を元に自分絵で描くタグ
tags.summary: [[Official art]] that has been [[redrawn]] by another artist. Often includes the original art as a [[reference inset]] . See also [[Derivative work]] [[Sprite redraw]] [[Official art inset]]
tags.wiki_zh: [[Official art]] 被其他画师 [[redrawn]] 后的作品。常将原图作为 [[reference inset]] 一同附上。 另见 [[Derivative work]] [[Sprite redraw]] [[Official art inset]]

tags.name: german_commentary
tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[german_text|German]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 表示 [[commentary]] 以 [[german_text|German]] 写成。

tags.name: headshop
tags.summary: A headshop is a type of [[third-party edit]] in which a character's head is replaced by the head of another character. Uploading headshops is against the [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] and should not be done. Not to be confused with [[head swap]] , in which the artist intentionally draw characte
tags.wiki_zh: 换头图是一种 [[third-party edit]] ，指将一个角色的头部替换成另一个角色的头部。上传换头图违反了 [[help:upload rules|upload rules]] ，不应进行此类操作。 不要与 [[head swap]] 混淆，后者是指画师故意将角色的头部进行互换来绘制。

tags.name: cosplay_request
tags.summary: A request to identify one or more [[cosplay]] s. Remove this tag from the post once all cosplays in the picture have been identified. See also [[character request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨认一个或多个 [[cosplay]] 。 一旦图片中的所有cosplay都已被辨认，请从帖子中移除此标签。 另见 [[character request]]

tags.name: vietnamese_commentary
tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[Vietnamese_text|Vietnamese]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 指 [[commentary]] ，其以 [[Vietnamese_text|Vietnamese]] 书写。

tags.name: art_trade
tags.summary: When two artists exchange art with each other based on a request the other gave them. These trades usually have a set meet-up time, and are equal in complexity. This tag is for posts that are drawn as part of said trade. Not to be confused with [[gift art]] , where an artist draws a piece intended a
tags.wiki_zh: 两位画师根据对方提出的要求互相交换画作。这些交换通常有约定的交图时间，且复杂程度相当。此标签用于作为此类交换的一部分而绘制的投稿。 不要与 [[gift art]] 混淆，后者是指画师为他人绘制作为礼物的作品，并不期望得到任何回报。 只有在有证据证明某投稿属于绘画交换时才使用此标签（比如画师在评论中提到属于交换、有对方画师交换作品的链接等）。

tags.name: yandere_sample
tags.summary: An [[image sample]] from Yande.re. It is Danbooru policy to either replace samples or delete them. See [[image sample]] for more information. See [[help:yandere]] for how to upload images from Yandere correctly. See also [[bad yandere id]]
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 Yande.re 的 [[image sample]] 。 根据 Danbooru 的方针，此类样本图要么被替换，要么被删除。更多信息请参见 [[image sample]] 。关于如何正确地从 Yandere 上传图片，请参见 [[help:yandere]] 。 另请参见 [[bad yandere id]]

tags.name: variant_set_available
tags.summary: Use when a [[variant set]] is available in the source but not all of it has been posted.
tags.wiki_zh: 当来源中存在 [[variant set]] ，但并未将其全部投稿时使用。

tags.name: bad_weibo_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Weibo image, rather than to the Weibo post containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's no way to find the original Weibo post from the image link. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the link to th
tags.wiki_zh: 源地址是微博图片直链，而非包含该图片的微博帖子链接的投稿。这些被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为无法从图片链接找到原始的微博帖子。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着你应该在上传页面粘贴微博帖子的链接，而不是图片本身。在电脑端操作方法为，从帖子日期处复制链接，然后将其粘贴到 Danbooru 的上传页面。 缺少此标签的投稿可以通过此搜索找到：{{source:*sinaimg.cn* -bad_weibo_link}} 另请参阅 [[bad link]]

tags.name: paywall_cliffhanger
tags.summary: [[Video]] s that are cut off or obscured by an end card linking to the artist's socials where you can [[paid reward available|purchase the full video]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 被结尾卡截断或遮挡的 [[Video]] ，结尾卡链接到画师的社交账号，你可以在那里 [[paid reward available|purchase the full video]] 。

tags.name: game_model
tags.summary: Artwork depicting characters as their in-game models.
tags.wiki_zh: 将角色描绘成其游戏内模型的作品。

tags.name: hairstyle_request
tags.summary: Request to identify a hairstyle in a post. See [[tag group:hair styles]] for further reference.
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨识帖子中的发型。更多参考请见 [[tag group:hair styles]] 。

tags.name: medium_request
tags.summary: For works where the medium is unknown. {{traditional_media -*_(medium)}} will return more results.
tags.wiki_zh: 适用于媒介未知的作品。{{传统媒介 -*_(媒介)}} 将返回更多结果。

tags.name: figure-referenced
tags.summary: Artwork that was [[derivative work|referenced]] from a [[figure]] . Examples See also [[Photo-referenced]] [[Official art redraw]]
tags.wiki_zh: [[derivative work|referenced]] 自 [[figure]] 的作品。 示例 另见 [[Photo-referenced]] [[Official art redraw]]

tags.name: bad_fantia_id
tags.summary: Bad source link from Fantia.jp See also [[Fantia reward]]
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 Fantia.jp 的错误源链接 另见 [[Fantia reward]]

tags.name: animal_request
tags.summary: A request to identify animals in the post.
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨识帖子中的动物。

tags.name: corrupted_file
tags.summary: An image that appears corrupted i.e. the full size image is only partially shown, or parts of the image have corrupt pixels. If the original source of the image can be found and reuploaded, then ask for an image replacement in topic #16765. This tag is usually added by a bot and may be added for som
tags.wiki_zh: 看起来已损坏的图片，即原图只部分显示，或图片的部分区域有损坏的像素。如果能找到该图片的原始来源并重新上传，则请在 topic #16765 中请求替换图片。 该标签通常由机器人添加，也可能因某些肉眼不可见的损坏而被添加。 其他类型的损坏请使用 [[corrupted metadata]] 。 另请参见 [[corrupted twitter file]] [[missing thumbnail]] [[missing sample]] [[missing image]]

tags.name: fanfiction_available
tags.summary: Denotes a post that was made for or is based on a fan-made written work available online. Examples of sites [Archive of Our Own] [pixiv Novels] [FanFiction.Net]
tags.wiki_zh: 表示该投稿是为在线发布的同人文字作品而创作的，或改编自该同人文字作品。 相关网站示例 [Archive of Our Own] [pixiv Novels] [FanFiction.Net]

tags.name: emofuri
tags.summary: Animations created with the E-Mote Free Movie Maker software. See also [[ugoira]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]]
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 E-Mote Free Movie Maker 软件制作的动画。 另见 [[ugoira]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]]

tags.name: magazine_request
tags.summary: A request to tag specifically what magazine a [[scan]] comes from. When the magazine is tagged, please remove [[magazine_request]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 请求具体标注某个 [[scan]] 出自哪本杂志的标签。当杂志已标注后，请移除 [[magazine_request]] 。

tags.name: bad_facebook_id
tags.summary: Old and broken source link from https://www.facebook.com/ Example page link: [nodtext]https://www.facebook.com/Page_name/photos/ID_1/ID_2/[/nodtext]. Example direct image link: [nodtext]*.fbcdn.net/v/*/filename.jpg?_*[/nodtext]. It is recommended to use page links for sources, because direct image l
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 https://www.facebook.com/ 的陈旧且失效的来源链接 页面链接示例：[nodtext]https://www.facebook.com/Page_name/photos/ID_1/ID_2/[/nodtext]。 直接图片链接示例：[nodtext]*.fbcdn.net/v/*/filename.jpg?_*[/nodtext]。 建议使用页面链接作为来源，因为直接图片链接是临时的。 注意 Facebook 上的 [[protected link]] 看起来可能与错误的 ID 完全相同： 错误的 ID 要么是错误的 ID，要么是受保护的链接 要么是错误的 ID、受保护的链接，要么是年龄限制内容（需要登录） 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad source]] [[Bad Facebook Link]]

tags.name: plant_request
tags.summary: Request to identify a [[plant]] in a post. See the [[plant]] wiki for further reference. See also [[Flower request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨识帖子中的 [[plant]] 。更多参考请参见 [[plant]] wiki。 另见 [[Flower request]]

tags.name: merged_layers
tags.summary: An artwork (usually a datamined [[game asset]] or a [[psd available]] post) that was originally separate layers, and was merged into a single artwork. See also [[stitched]] [[self-datamine]]
tags.wiki_zh: 指原本由多个分离图层组成，现已合并为单张画面的作品（通常是数据挖掘得到的 [[game asset]] 或 [[psd available]] 帖子）。 另见 [[stitched]] [[self-datamine]]

tags.name: first-party_extraction
tags.summary: Like [[third-party extraction]] , an image of a character or group of characters that has been taken from another image and has had the background removed from it, leaving a [[simple background]] , but when done by the original artist.
tags.wiki_zh: 与 [[third-party extraction]] 类似，指从另一张图片中取出某个角色或一组角色并去除背景、留下 [[simple background]] 的图片，但由原作者本人制作。

tags.name: bird_request
tags.summary: A post having one or more [[bird]] s, but missing the tags for the specific kinds of birds. Please remove [[bird request]] once all the birds are correctly tagged. See also [[dog request]] [[cat request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 包含一只或多只 [[bird]] ，但缺少具体鸟种标签的帖子。 当所有鸟类都被正确标记后，请移除 [[bird request]] 。 另见 [[dog request]] [[cat request]]

tags.name: zbrush_(medium)
tags.summary: Tag for posts made or edited in the 3D modeling software ZBrush. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Wikipedia: ZBrush
tags.wiki_zh: 用于标记在 3D 建模软件 ZBrush 中制作或编辑的投稿。 另请参见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：ZBrush

tags.name: has_watermarked_revision
tags.summary: When the post's [[revision]] at the source has been [[watermark]] ed. See also [[has bad revision]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当帖子在来源处的 [[revision]] 已被 [[watermark]] 时。 另见 [[has bad revision]]

tags.name: animated_png
tags.summary: An animated image in the APNG format, an unofficial, backwards-compatible extension to the PNG format created by the group behind Mozilla/Firefox. Comparable to [[animated gif]] files, but with support for 24-bit colour and 8-bit transparency. Not fully supported by all browsers. Internet Explorer a
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 APNG 格式的动态图片，是由 Mozilla/Firefox 背后团队创建的、对 PNG 格式的非官方、向后兼容扩展。与 [[animated gif]] 文件类似，但支持 24 位色彩和 8 位透明度。 并非所有浏览器都完全支持。Internet Explorer 和基于 EdgeHTML 的 Microsoft Edge 只会显示预览图，但在 Firefox、Chrome（v.59 及之后版本）、SeaMonkey、Safari、Opera（v.15 之前版本）或基于 Chromium 的 Edge 中动画应能正常显示。另请注意，在预览或缩放图片时动画不会被保留，所以如果你想查看静态预览图以外的内容，请务必点击“查看原图”。除这些浏览器外，少数独立的图片浏览器也支持该格式。 本站会自动为新投稿添加此标签。 另请参见 [[Tag Group:Image Composition]] 外部链接 Chrome 网上应用店：APNG for Chrome（用于在 v.59 之前的 Chrome 中查看 APNG 的扩展） XnView（一款支持 APNG 的独立图片查看器） IrfanView（另一款支持 APNG 的独立图片查看器） 维基百科：APNG

tags.name: chinese_audio
tags.summary: A post with [[audible speech]] in Chinese, including lyrics in songs.
tags.wiki_zh: 带有中文 [[audible speech]] 的帖子，包括歌曲中的歌词。

tags.name: sprite_redraw
tags.summary: A [[derivative work|redraw]] of a [[sprite]] , often but not always from [[pixel art]] to a high-definition medium. Examples
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 [[derivative work|redraw]] 对象为 [[sprite]] 的创作，通常但不总是从 [[pixel art]] 重制为高清媒介。 示例

tags.name: ugoira_conversion
tags.summary: A Pixiv [[Ugoira]] that has been converted to some other [[animated|animation]] or [[video]] format prior to being uploaded. Ugoira conversions should not be uploaded to Danbooru. Ugoiras have been natively supported by Danbooru since 2014. See also [[ugoira]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一种Pixiv [[Ugoira]] ，其在上传之前已被转换为其他 [[animated|animation]] 或 [[video]] 格式。Ugoira转换文件不应上传到Danbooru。Danbooru自2014年起已原生支持Ugoira。 另见 [[ugoira]]

tags.name: bad_pinterest_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Pinterest image, rather than to the Pinterest post containing the image. These are considered bad links because Danbooru cannot automatically resolve the links to the post. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the link to the Pi
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源为 Pinterest 图片直链，而非包含该图片的 Pinterest 帖子链接的投稿。这些被视为无效链接，因为 Danbooru 无法自动将这些链接解析到原帖子。 如果你在投稿时看到此警告，意味着你应该在投稿页面粘贴 Pinterest 帖子的链接，而不是图片本身。不过如果可能的话，建议优先考虑寻找其他来源，因为 Pinterest 帖子通常是画质更低的 [[third-party source]] 。 可以使用此搜索找到缺失无效 Pinterest 链接标签的投稿：{{source:*://i.pinimg.com/ -bad_pinterest_link}} 示例 https://i.pinimg.com/736x/d9/7e/4b/d97e4b5a1b61a140d6818d17767b665a.jpg（无效链接） https://www.pinterest.com/pin/148126275230611115/（有效链接） 另请参见 [[bad link]] [[bad Pinterest id]] （已删除的 Pinterest 帖子）

tags.name: flower_stand_art
tags.summary: Art that was made for displaying on a [[flower stand]] . Example post #10888239
tags.wiki_zh: 为展示在 [[flower stand]] 上而创作的画作。 示例 post #10888239

tags.name: masking_tape_(medium)
tags.summary: Masking tape art is a type of art which makes use of strips of masking tape as an [[unconventional media|unconventional]] tool for artistic production. The type of tape most often used is a patterned tape known as washi tape (和紙テープ). The artist may construct their art entirely from masking tape or o
tags.wiki_zh: 美纹胶带艺术是一种将美纹胶带条作为 [[unconventional media|unconventional]] 艺术创作工具的艺术类型。最常使用的胶带类型是一种带有图案的胶带，被称为和纸胶带（和紙テープ）。艺术家可以完全用美纹胶带构建作品，也可以仅用其表现色彩或图案。

tags.name: maya_(medium)
tags.summary: Tag for posts made or edited in Autodesk Maya, a [[3D]] editing and animation software. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Wikipedia: Autodesk Maya
tags.wiki_zh: 用于标记在 Autodesk Maya 中制作或编辑的作品，Autodesk Maya 是一款 [[3D]] 编辑与动画软件。 另请参见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：Autodesk Maya

tags.name: volume_warning
tags.summary: A post with [[sound]] that contains a sudden change in volume or that is very loud to begin with. Common examples are [[screaming]] , [[explosion]] s, and [[audible music|music]] . Doublecheck your volume settings before proceeding, especially if you are wearing headphones. See also
tags.wiki_zh: 带有 [[sound]] 的帖子，其中包含音量的突然变化，或一开始音量就非常大。 常见的例子有 [[screaming]] 、 [[explosion]] 和 [[audible music|music]] 。 继续观看前请再次确认你的音量设置，尤其是在你佩戴着耳机的情况下。 另见 [[Epilepsy warning]] [[Jumpscare warning]]

tags.name: check_gender
tags.summary: When a character's gender has been tagged, but a second opinion is needed. See also [[gender request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当角色的性别已打标，但需要第二人复核时使用。 另见 [[gender request]]

tags.name: ai-generated_background
tags.summary: An image with a background that is [[AI-generated]] while the rest of the image is human-drawn. Examples See also [[AI-assisted]] [[AI-generated art (topic)]] [[Tag Group:Backgrounds]] [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]
tags.wiki_zh: 背景部分为 [[AI-generated]] ，而图像其余部分为人工绘制的图像。 示例 另见 [[AI-assisted]] [[AI-generated art (topic)]] [[Tag Group:Backgrounds]] [[Tag Group:Image Composition]]

tags.name: bad_ameba_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to an Ameba image, rather than to the Ameba post containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's no way to find the original Ameba post from the image link. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the link to t
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源为Ameba图片的直接链接，而非包含该图片的Ameba帖子链接的帖子。这些被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为无法从图片链接找到原始的Ameba帖子。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着你应该在上传页面粘贴Ameba帖子的链接，而不是图片本身。 缺失此标签的帖子可以通过此搜索找到：{{source:*stat.ameba.jp -bad_ameba_link}} 另请参见 [[bad link]]

tags.name: pose_request
tags.summary: Use this tag when the appropriate tag for pose or posture is unknown.
tags.wiki_zh: 当不知道合适的姿势或体态标签时，使用此标签。

tags.name: self-scan
tags.summary: A [[scan]] that has been posted by its own scanner. These posts will have a [[non-web source]] because they come from an offline source instead of a website. Do not use this tag for artwork that has been scanned and posted by the artist themselves to another website. See also [[self-upload]]
tags.wiki_zh: 由扫描者本人发布的 [[scan]] 。 这些投稿会带有 [[non-web source]] ，因为它们来自线下来源而非网站。 请勿将此标签用于画师本人扫描后发布到其他网站上的作品。 另请参见 [[self-upload]] [[self-datamine]] [[non-web source]]

tags.name: missing_commentary
tags.summary: A tag that can be temporarily added to posts with valid sources that have commentary but cannot be fetched or have not been manually applied, particularly in the case of an extractor being down. This tag is more of a reminder to the uploader to fetch the commentary at a later time and should be kept
tags.wiki_zh: 这是一个可以临时添加到帖子上的标签，适用于来源有效、有解说但无法抓取或尚未手动添加的情况，特别是在解析器宕机时。该标签更多是提醒上传者在稍后抓取解说，应尽可能让带有此标签的帖子保持接近于零。这既适用于有效来源和 [[Bad ID]] ，也适用于部分缺失解说的情况（例如缺少解说正文但有标题的帖子、只有部分解说正文的帖子等）。 不要与 [[commentary request]] 混淆，后者是用于请求翻译画师解说的。

tags.name: stable_diffusion
tags.summary: An artificial intelligence that creates [[AI-generated]] images from text-based prompts. See also [[NAI Diffusion]] External links http://beta.dreamstudio.ai https://huggingface.co/CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-4 https://huggingface.co/spaces/stabilityai/stable-diffusion https://huggingface.co/hakurei
tags.wiki_zh: 一种根据文本提示词生成 [[AI-generated]] 图像的人工智能。 另请参阅 [[NAI Diffusion]] 外部链接 http://beta.dreamstudio.ai https://huggingface.co/CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-4 https://huggingface.co/spaces/stabilityai/stable-diffusion https://huggingface.co/hakurei/waifu-diffusion

tags.name: bad_pawoo_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Pawoo post or picture are no longer publicly available. Other Pawoo errors [[Pawoo sample]] : for when a size other than original is used. None yet observed. [[MD5 mismatch]] : for when none of the sizes match Danbooru See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Pawoo link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Pawoo 帖子或图片不再公开可用的情况。 其他 Pawoo 错误 [[Pawoo sample]] ：用于使用了非原图尺寸的情况。目前尚未发现。 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：用于没有任何尺寸与 Danbooru 相符的情况 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Pawoo link]]

tags.name: app_filter
tags.summary: Filters applied to an image after it was created, using a different application. Typically applied through websites or smartphone apps. They're usually recognizable because they appear in the exact same shape and form on different pictures by different artists; for example, post #6893693 and post #6
tags.wiki_zh: 在图片创作完成后，使用另一个应用程序为其添加的滤镜。通常通过网站或智能手机应用添加。 它们通常很容易辨认，因为在不同画师的不同图片上，会以完全相同的形态和样式出现；例如 post #6893693 和 post #6893697。 请注意，只有由画师以外的人添加的，才算作 [[third-party edit]] 。 另请参见 [[Sora's Pixel Converter]] 外部链接 点阵画转换器

tags.name: bad_daum_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Daum image is no longer publicly available. See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Daum 图片已不再公开可用的情况。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]

tags.name: cameo_request
tags.summary: A tag to be used when a [[cameo]] is unknown, in place of [[copyright request]] / [[character request]] , especially on posts where the primary focus copyright is already tagged. Please remove this tag when all cameos have been identified. See also [[Meme request]] [[Parody request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当 [[cameo]] 未知时使用的标签，用于代替 [[copyright request]] / [[character request]] ，特别是在主要焦点的版权已打标的投稿上。 当所有客串均已辨识完毕时，请移除此标签。 另见 [[Meme request]] [[Parody request]] [[Reference request]]

tags.name: gouache_(medium)
tags.summary: Similar in both theory and practice to [[watercolor (medium)|watercolor]] s, gouache has the distinction of laying opaque pigment on a substrate and using the water as a binder rather than to staining the substrate directly. Long favoured by illustrators for its ability to cover large areas, many ol
tags.wiki_zh: 在理论和实践上都与 [[watercolor (medium)|watercolor]] 相似，水粉的特点在于将不透明颜料铺在基底上，并以水作为粘合剂，而不是直接染色基底。因能够覆盖大面积而长期受到插画师的青睐，许多古老的 [[movie poster (medium)|]] 都是用这种媒介绘制的。值得注意的是，它也可以通过钢笔或喷笔来施用。

tags.name: lossless-lossy
tags.summary: The opposite of [[lossy-lossless]] : an image originally in a lossless format, such as PNG, that has been converted to a lossy format, such as JPEG. It is Danbooru policy to delete [[third-party edit|third party]] lossless-lossy images when the original is available. See also [[lossy-lossless]]
tags.wiki_zh: 与 [[lossy-lossless]] 相反：指原本为无损格式（如PNG）、后来被转换为有损格式（如JPEG）的图片。 根据Danbooru的规定，当原图可用时， [[third-party edit|third party]] 的无损转有损图片将被删除。 另见 [[lossy-lossless]] [[lossy-lossy]] [[image sample]] [[md5 mismatch]]

tags.name: italian_commentary
tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[italian_text|Italian]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 指 [[commentary]] 以 [[italian_text|Italian]] 书写。

tags.name: reversed
tags.summary: When the whole image is reversed, or flipped horizontally. Usually as a [[third-party edit]] of the original image. See [[reflection]] or [[mirrored text]] for when something inside the image appears reversed. See also [[rotated]] [[rotational symmetry]] [[mirror image]] [[mirrored text]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当整张图片被反转，即水平翻转时使用。通常作为原图的 [[third-party edit]] 。 当图片内部的某样东西呈现反转状态时，请参见 [[reflection]] 或 [[mirrored text]] 。 另见 [[rotated]] [[rotational symmetry]] [[mirror image]] [[mirrored text]] [[polar opposites]] [[Tag Group:Image composition]]

tags.name: video_game_cover_redraw
tags.summary: A redraw of a [[video game cover]] , often as a [[parody]] . Examples [[Blue Archive]] redraw of [[Red Dead Redemption 2]] See also [[doom cover parody]] [[screenshot redraw]] [[album cover redraw]] [[comic panel redraw]] [[book cover redraw]]
tags.wiki_zh: 对 [[video game cover]] 的重绘，通常为 [[parody]] 。 示例 [[Blue Archive]] 对 [[Red Dead Redemption 2]] 的重绘 另见 [[doom cover parody]] [[screenshot redraw]] [[album cover redraw]] [[comic panel redraw]] [[book cover redraw]]

tags.name: medibang_paint_(medium)
tags.summary: An image created or edited with MediBang Paint. For when the software itself is depicted in the image, use [[MediBang Paint]] instead. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website JP Wikipedia: MediBang Paint
tags.wiki_zh: 使用MediBang Paint创作或编辑的图片。 当图片中描绘的是该软件本身时，请改用 [[MediBang Paint]] 。 另请参见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 日文维基百科：MediBang Paint

tags.name: youtube_video_thumbnail
tags.summary: An image that is the [[video thumbnail|thumbnail]] for a [[YouTube]] video.
tags.wiki_zh: 一张作为 [[video thumbnail|thumbnail]] ，用于 [[YouTube]] 视频的图片。

tags.name: bad_4chan_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a 4chan image, rather than to the 4chan post containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's no way to find the original 4chan post from the image link. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the link to th
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源是直接链接到4chan图片，而不是链接到包含该图片的4chan帖子的投稿。这些被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为无法从图片链接找到原始的4chan帖子。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着你应该在上传页面粘贴4chan帖子的链接，而不是图片本身。 缺失此标签的投稿可以通过以下搜索找到：{{source:*i.4cdn.org/ -bad_4chan_link}} | {{source:*is*.4c*n.org* -bad_4chan_link}} | {{source:*images.4chan.org* -bad_4chan_link}} 另请参阅 [[bad link]]

tags.name: has_cropped_revision
tags.summary: A post with a [[revision]] at the source that has been [[cropped]] . See also [[has bad revision]]
tags.wiki_zh: 在来源处带有 [[revision]] 且已被 [[cropped]] 的帖子。 另见 [[has bad revision]]

tags.name: roulette_animation
tags.summary: An [[animated|animation]] that cycles through several images quickly. The viewer is usually meant to pause or screenshot the animation to pick a random image. Examples
tags.wiki_zh: 一种快速循环播放多张图片的 [[animated|animation]] 。观看者通常需要暂停或截屏动画来随机抽选一张图片。 示例

tags.name: color_halftone
tags.summary: A [[scan artifacts|scan artifact]] seen when printed media is [[scan]] ned at very high resolution, causing solid colors to appear as dotted [[halftone]] patterns. For more information on how to remove screening from scans, see: yande.re forum #2007, yande.re forum #2290. See also [[color issue]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 [[scan artifacts|scan artifact]] ，当印刷品以非常高的分辨率被 [[scan]] 时可见，会导致纯色呈现为点状 [[halftone]] 图案。 有关如何去除扫描图中的网纹的更多信息，请参见：yande.re forum #2007, yande.re forum #2290。 另见 [[color issue]] [[scan]] [[scan artifacts]] [[halftone]] 外部链接 维基百科：彩色半调

tags.name: art_fight_attack
tags.summary: A piece of [[gift art]] that was created for the annual Art Fight event. Art Fight is an annual art gifting event that is held each July. Participants are split into two teams that "attack" each other by making gift art of [[original]] characters. At the end of the month, the team with the greater s
tags.wiki_zh: 为一年一度的 Art Fight 活动创作的一幅 [[gift art]] 。 Art Fight 是一年一度的赠画活动，于每年七月举行。参与者会被分成两队，通过为对方 [[original]] 创作赠图来互相“攻击”。月底时，得分更高的一队获胜。 外部链接 官方网站

tags.name: mecha_request
tags.summary: This tag is to be used for [[mecha|mechas]] / [[machine|machines]] that have a name but require identification. For weapon identifications, use [[weapon request]] . Not to be used as an excuse for laziness; tag your mecha uploads as best as you can. See also [[tagme]] [[character request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 此标签用于已有名称但需要辨识的 [[mecha|mechas]] ／ [[machine|machines]] 。 如需辨识武器，请使用 [[weapon request]] 。 不得将此标签用作偷懒的借口；请尽力为你上传的机甲打好标签。 另请参见 [[tagme]] [[character request]] [[source request]] [[artist request]] [[weapon request]]

tags.name: korean_audio
tags.summary: A post with [[audible speech]] in Korean, including lyrics in songs.
tags.wiki_zh: 带有韩语 [[audible speech]] 的帖子，包括歌曲中的歌词。

tags.name: character_counter_request
tags.summary: For when a number of characters are present in an image (usually more than one), but the gender or number of characters isn't known by the tagger. Replace this tag with the appropriate counter tag for gender ( [[1girl]] , [[1boy]] , [[1other]] , etc). A search for
tags.wiki_zh: 当图片中出现了若干角色（通常多于一个），但标记者不知道角色的性别或数量时使用。将此标签替换为相应的按性别计数标签（ [[1girl]] 、 [[1boy]] 、 [[1other]] 等）。 搜索{{-no_humans -1girl -multiple_girls -1boy -multiple_boys -1other -multiple_others}}可以找到需要此标签的投稿。 另见 [[tag group:character count]] [[gender request]]

tags.name: flipnote_studio_(medium)
tags.summary: Software used to create animations on the [[Nintendo DSi]] and the [[Nintendo 3DS]] . See also [[Faux flipnote]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Wikipedia: Flipnote Studio
tags.wiki_zh: 用于在 [[Nintendo DSi]] 和 [[Nintendo 3DS]] 上创作动画的软件。 另请参见 [[Faux flipnote]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 维基百科：Flipnote Studio

tags.name: gif_artifacts
tags.summary: The [[Animated GIF]] image format is made to display a maximum of 256 colors in one image. When an image containing more than 256 colors is saved as a GIF, the color limitation of the GIF format creates artifacts (defects) such as [[dithering]] (e.g. post #720057) or [[color banding]] (e.g. the back
tags.wiki_zh: [[Animated GIF]] 图像格式在单张图像中最多只能显示256种颜色。当一张包含超过256种颜色的图像被保存为GIF时，GIF格式的色彩限制会产生诸如 [[dithering]] （例如 post #720057）或 [[color banding]] （例如 post #76332的背景）之类的伪影（瑕疵）。 请注意，尽管高色彩图像会出现伪影，但GIF仍有其合理的用途，例如用于 [[pixel art]] 、低色彩的 [[Oekaki]] 图像以及动态图像。 另请参见 [[tag group:image composition]]

tags.name: collage_(medium)
tags.summary: The compositing of bits and pieces of existing material, imagery, or text in order to create a new artwork, whether assembled digitally or traditionally. This often falls into [[mixed media]] . See [[collage]] for the more general usage of the term. Examples External links Wikipedia: Collage
tags.wiki_zh: 将现有素材、图像或文字的零散片段拼合在一起，以创作新的艺术作品，无论是以数字方式还是传统方式拼贴而成。这通常属于 [[mixed media]] 。 更宽泛的用法参见 [[collage]] 。 示例 外部链接 维基百科：Collage

tags.name: custom_maid_3d_2
tags.summary: Custom Maid 3D 2 (CM3D2) is a CG adult game developed by KISS and released in July 24, 2015. Successor to [[Custom Maid 3D]] (CM3D) and predecessor to [[Custom Order Maid 3D 2|Custom Order Maid 3D2]] (COM3D2). The game featured a large character creation setup to let players create maids that they w
tags.wiki_zh: 定制女仆3D2（CM3D2）是由KISS开发的CG成人游戏，于2015年7月24日发售。是 [[Custom Maid 3D]] （CM3D）的续作，也是 [[Custom Order Maid 3D 2|Custom Order Maid 3D2]] （COM3D2）的前作。 该游戏拥有庞大的角色创建系统，玩家可以创建女仆并对其进行调教和发生性关系。设有工作室模式，可以按自己的喜好布置舞台和摆放角色姿势。这一模式加上各种Mod，使得该游戏成为人们创作各种姿势和场景的角色CG图片的平台。

tags.name: gumroad_reward
tags.summary: A [[paid reward]] from Gumroad. Uploading paid rewards is no longer allowed. Should there any paid rewards uploaded after June 06, 2020, they must be reported in topic #32324. See forum #168930 for details. See also [[paid reward]] External links Gumroad
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 Gumroad 的 [[paid reward]] 。 不再允许上传付费奖励。如有在2020年6月6日之后上传的付费奖励，必须在 topic #32324 中举报。详情见 forum #168930。 另见 [[paid reward]] 外部链接 Gumroad

tags.name: download_link
tags.summary: A post whose source supplies a download link instead of an ordinary page or direct image link. See also [[bad source]] [[bad link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源提供的是下载链接，而非常规页面或图片直链的帖子。 另见 [[bad source]] [[bad link]]

tags.name: non-repeating_animation
tags.summary: An [[animated]] GIF or PNG that stops at the end of the animation instead of looping forever. Although most animated images loop forever, this is not required. The GIF and PNG file formats allow for animations that loop only once, or that loop for a fixed number of times.
tags.wiki_zh: 在动画结束时停止，而不是永远循环播放的 [[animated]] GIF或PNG。 虽然大多数動畫图像会永远循环播放，但这并非强制要求。GIF和PNG文件格式允许只循环一次，或只循环固定次数的动画。

tags.name: gibberish_commentary
tags.summary: [[Commentary]] that contains [[gibberish text]] that is not intelligible in any language, such as a series of random letters/symbols, or a nonsensical sentence. Gibberish text cannot be translated because it has no meaning. See also [[untranslatable commentary]] [[encrypted commentary]]
tags.wiki_zh: [[Commentary]] 中含有在任何语言中都无法理解的 [[gibberish text]] ，例如一连串随机的字母/符号，或毫无意义的句子。乱码文本因为没有含义，所以无法被翻译。 另见 [[untranslatable commentary]] [[encrypted commentary]] [[mojibake commentary]] [[r'lyehian commentary]] [[zalgo commentary]] [[Help:Artist commentary]]

tags.name: thumbnail_surprise
tags.summary: A post which intentionally uses technical tricks to present a full sized image that is deceptively different from its thumbnail. This tag covers the following types of surprises: [[Non-repeating animation]] s that flip away from the first frame as soon as the full image loads or after a long delay.
tags.wiki_zh: 故意使用技术手段，使完整尺寸图片与缩略图呈现出截然不同的帖子。 该标签涵盖以下几种惊喜类型： 在完整图片加载完成时或经过长时间延迟后，会从第一帧翻转开的 [[Non-repeating animation]] 。Danbooru并不总是将第一帧用作缩略图，因此这些手法可能无效。 带有 [[alpha transparency]] 效果的图片，根据放置在浅色还是深色背景上看起来会有所不同。通常这些图片适合在深色模式下观看。 带有巧妙的 [[gamma correction]] 效果的图片，在被缩放到缩略图尺寸时看起来会有所不同。 有些手法利用了特定平台的特性，只在特定浏览器、特定网站上，或仅在深色模式或浅色模式下生效。特别是，来自Twitter的缩略图惊喜通常在某种程度上依赖于Twitter的图片处理，在Danbooru上无法正确显示。 此标签仅用于故意的、技术性的 trick。对于非技术性的 trick 或艺术上的巧合，请参见 [[misleading thumbnail]] 。 示例 [[Alpha transparency]] （在深色模式下查看） [[Non-repeating animation]] [[Gamma correction]] 另见 [[exif thumbnail surprise]] [[misleading thumbnail]]

tags.name: hatsune_miku_(voicebank)
tags.summary: Posts with [[sound]] that contains [[Hatsune Miku]] 's voicebank. These are usually samples of [[Vocaloid]] songs, though they can also be talkloids (vocal synth skits). See also [[vocal synthesizer audio]]
tags.wiki_zh: 带有 [[sound]] 并包含 [[Hatsune Miku]] 声库的投稿。这些通常是 [[Vocaloid]] 歌曲的试听样本，不过也可能是talkloid（语音合成短剧）。 另见 [[vocal synthesizer audio]]

tags.name: aseprite_(medium)
tags.summary: For images created or edited using Aseprite. For images featuring the program or its branding use [[Aseprite (software)]] , both tags can apply for example post #9966284 See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Official Repository Wikipedia: Aseprite
tags.wiki_zh: 用于使用 Aseprite 创建或编辑的图片。若图片中出现了该程序本身或其品牌元素，请使用 [[Aseprite (software)]] ，例如 post #9966284 可以同时使用这两个标签。 另请参见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 官方仓库 维基百科：Aseprite

tags.name: nai_diffusion
tags.summary: An artificial intelligence that creates [[AI-generated]] images from text-based prompts.
tags.wiki_zh: 一种根据基于文本的提示词生成 [[AI-generated]] 图像的人工智能。

tags.name: bad_bilibili_id
tags.summary: Used for when any [[BiliBili]] post or picture is no longer publicly available. Other BiliBili errors [[Corrupted EXIF Data]] : for when EXIF data is incorrectly set or corrupted See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 [[BiliBili]] 帖子或图片不再公开可见的情况。 其他哔哩哔哩错误 [[Corrupted EXIF Data]] ：EXIF数据设置错误或损坏时使用 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]

tags.name: still_animation
tags.summary: An [[animated]] post that renders as a still image when played. The animation may contain only a single frame, or multiple frames that are all identical. Popularized in use among [[Twitter]] artists in late 2025 after the site added the ability to directly edit a post with [[Grok (xai)|]] 's generat
tags.wiki_zh: 播放时显示为静态图像的 [[animated]] 投稿。该动画可能只包含单帧，也可能包含多帧但所有帧都完全相同。 该用法于2025年末在 [[Twitter]] 画师中流行起来，此前网站新增了使用 [[Grok (xai)|]] 的生成式 [[ai-generated|AI]] 直接编辑投稿的功能，该功能不包括站内.gif（其会被渲染为.mp4）。 [[animated]] 标签会自动添加到所有文件格式为动画文件格式的投稿上，因此该标签可用于查找实际为静态图像的此类投稿。 另请参见 [[Twitter's edit image button]]

tags.name: hair_ornament_request
tags.summary: A request to tag specifically what type of [[hair ornament]] a character is wearing. When the hair ornament is tagged, please remove [[hair_ornament_request]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 请求具体标注角色所佩戴的是何种类型的 [[hair ornament]] 。当发饰已得到标注后，请移除 [[hair_ornament_request]] 。

tags.name: song_request
tags.summary: This tag may refer to either of two things: Request to identify a song [[audible music|playing]] in the background of a post. Try [Shazam] or a similar service. Request to identify a vocal synth ( [[Vocaloid]] , [[UTAU]] , [[Synthesizer V]] or similar) song. Consult the [[list of vocal synth songs]]
tags.wiki_zh: 该标签可能指以下两种情况之一： 请求辨识帖子背景中的歌曲 [[audible music|playing]] 。 可以试试 [Shazam] 或类似服务。 请求辨识 vocal synth（ [[Vocaloid]] 、 [[UTAU]] 、 [[Synthesizer V]] 或类似）歌曲。 更多信息请参阅 [[list of vocal synth songs]] wiki 文章。

tags.name: bad_vkontakte_id
tags.summary: Bad image source link from VKontakte.
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 VKontakte 的错误图片来源链接。

tags.name: check_source
tags.summary: Indicates that the image source needs to be double-checked for verification. May be used if the source is suspected of being a [[third-party source]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 表示图片来源需要再次核查验证。如果怀疑来源是 [[third-party source]] ，可以使用此标签。

tags.name: blueprint_(medium)
tags.summary: Posts that stylized the subject, typically [[mecha]] or [[vehicle focus|vehicle]] in the style of a [[blueprint (object)|]] . The subject were typically displayed in [[multiple views|various angles]] and/or showing specific detail of their machinery. For posts that feature the blueprint itself as a
tags.wiki_zh: 将主体风格化，通常是将 [[mecha]] 或 [[vehicle focus|vehicle]] 以 [[blueprint (object)|]] 风格呈现的帖子。主体通常以 [[multiple views|various angles]] 显示，和/或展示其机械结构的特定细节。 对于将蓝图本身作为道具的帖子，见 [[blueprint (object)]] 。 另见 [[Character sheet]]

tags.name: color_study
tags.summary: A type of [[art study]] focused on studying how color works, exploring new color combinations, and working with limited palettes. Sometimes done before a large piece in order to explore coloring options, sometimes done purely for practice. Examples Multiple color studies used to explore options for
tags.wiki_zh: 一种专注于研究色彩原理、探索新的色彩组合以及使用有限色板作画的 [[art study]] 。有时在创作大型作品之前用于探索上色方案，有时纯粹为了练习。 示例 用于为最终作品探索方案的多张色彩研究 另见 [[lighting study]]

tags.name: autodesk_3ds_max_(medium)
tags.summary: 3D modeling and animation software from Autodesk. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official Website Wikipedia: Autodesk 3ds Max
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 Autodesk 的 3D 建模与动画软件。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：Autodesk 3ds Max

tags.name: gesture_request
tags.summary: Request to identify a gesture in a post. See [[tag group:gestures]] for further reference.
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨认帖子中的手势。参见 [[tag group:gestures]] 以获取进一步参考。

tags.name: bad_tinami_id
tags.summary: Used for when any Tinami post or picture are no longer publicly available. Other Tinami errors [[Tinami sample]] : for when a size other than the full size is used [[MD5 mismatch]] : for when none of the sizes match Danbooru See also [[Bad ID]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何Tinami投稿或图片已不再公开的情况。 其它Tinami错误 [[Tinami sample]] ：用于使用了非完整尺寸的情况 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：用于所有尺寸都与Danbooru不符的情况 另见 [[Bad ID]]

tags.name: recolored
tags.summary: Use when an image has been colored differently than its original source. See also [[Colorized]] [[Third-party edit]] [[Tag group:colors]]
tags.wiki_zh: 当图片的上色与原始来源不同时使用。 另见 [[Colorized]] [[Third-party edit]] [[Tag group:colors]]

tags.name: bad_aspect_ratio
tags.summary: An image which has been poorly-sized such that one direction is squashed or stretched. To visualize, picture a 16:9 picture squeezed full-screen into a 4:3 frame.
tags.wiki_zh: 图片尺寸调整不当，导致某个方向被压扁或拉伸。 可以想象一下，一张 16:9 的图片被硬塞进 4:3 的全屏画面中显示的样子。

tags.name: acrylic_stand_(medium)
aliases: アクリルスタンド(媒体)
tags.summary: A cutout image, typically of a character, affixed to a clear acrylic board and held up using a base. They're similar to a [[cardboard cutout]] but smaller, and commonly sold as goods similar to character [[figure]] s. Use this tag when the medium of art is an acrylic stand or the subject of the illu
tags.wiki_zh: 一种镂空图片，通常是角色形象，被固定在透明的亚克力板上，并用底座支撑立起。它们与 [[cardboard cutout]] 类似但尺寸更小，常作为周边商品售卖，类似于角色 [[figure]] 。 当画作的媒介是亚克力立牌，或插画的主题被描绘成亚克力立牌时，请使用此标签。如果亚克力立牌在插画中只是不重要的道具，请使用 [[acrylic stand (object)]] 。 示例

tags.summary: For [[Flash]] games.
tags.wiki_zh: 用于 [[Flash]] 游戏。

tags.name: sound_effect_request
tags.summary: Sound effect text appears untranslated even though the post may otherwise be [[translated]] . Sound effects are often skipped because they can be inferred from context, ambiguous, and are less critical to understanding. It's also common when a post's translation is taken from another, hard-translate
tags.wiki_zh: 即使帖子可能已经是 [[translated]] ，拟声词文字仍未被翻译。拟声词经常被跳过，因为可以从上下文推断出来、含义模糊，且对理解不那么关键。当帖子的翻译取自另一个经过硬翻译的来源（例如漫画汉化聚合站）时，这种情况也很常见。 拟声词可以通过多种方式翻译。例如，ゴゴゴゴ可以翻译为： *轰鸣* <tn>该拟声词所代表的含义（动词或形容词）</tn> gogogogo <tn>片假名的罗马音，保留了读音</tn> brbrbrbr <tn>该拟声词在英语中可能的读法</tn> 你可以提供多种译法，以帮助不同类型的读者。 请记住，日语拟声词并不总是声音，也可能表示非听觉的感觉，如“潮湿”、“悄悄地”、“傻乎乎”、“丰满”和“毛茸茸”。 翻译资源 翻译拟声词不需要很高的日语水平。请放心尝试！ 你通常只需查一下片假名，挑选最符合语境的含义即可。 The JADED Network：拟声词词典（不支持 HTTPS） Jan Mitsuko：日语拟声词数据库 英文维基词典 日文维基词典 相关标签 [[check translation]] [[hard-translated]] [[partially translated]] [[poorly translated]] [[translated]] [[translation request]]

tags.name: bad_postype_id

tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Postype 帖子或图片不再公开可用的情况。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Protected link]]

tags.name: bad_newgrounds_id
tags.summary: Old and broken source link from https://www.newgrounds.com. Note that on Newgrounds bad IDs may identical to age-restricted [[protected link]] s for logged-out users if the submission was explicit before deletion. See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad source]]
tags.wiki_zh: 来自 https://www.newgrounds.com 的陈旧且已失效的来源链接。 注意，在 Newgrounds 上，如果投稿在删除前为 explicit 内容，那么对于未登录用户，错误的 ID 可能与年龄限制的 [[protected link]] 相同。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad source]]

tags.name: magma_(medium)
tags.summary: A browser-based [[artist collaboration|collaborative drawing]] and project management tool. Formerly known as aggie.io. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] External links Official website
tags.wiki_zh: 一款基于浏览器的 [[artist collaboration|collaborative drawing]] 和项目管理工具。前身为 aggie.io。 另请参见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站

tags.name: bad_reddit_id

tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 Reddit 帖子或图片已不再公开可见的情况。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Reddit Link]]

tags.wiki_zh: 一张 [[scan]] ，其中的 [[crease]] 或 [[scan artifacts]] 已被以数字方式去除，从而得到更干净的图像。 另见 [[cleaned]] [[third-party edit]]

tags.name: zip_available
tags.summary: For when an artist has a ZIP archive available at their website, a source page. Usage The tag was used when there was a direct link in the source field. Example: post #587719. Also includes a direct link in a comment on the image page. Example: post #4501481. Ambiguous situation with other formats (
tags.wiki_zh: 用于画师在其网站、来源页提供了 ZIP 存档可供下载的情况。 用法 该标签曾在来源栏中有直接链接时使用。例如：post #587719。 也包括在图片页面的评论中有直接链接的情况。例如：post #4501481。 与其他格式（.rar、.7z）共存时情况不明。 另见 [[Download link]] [[Help:Image Source]] [[Tag Group:Metatags]]

tags.name: bad_bilibili_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Bilibili image, rather than to the Bilibili post containing the image. These are considered [[bad link]] s because there's no way to find the original Bilibili post from the image link. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the l
tags.wiki_zh: 来源是Bilibili图片直链，而不是包含该图片的Bilibili动态页面的投稿。这些被视为 [[bad link]] ，因为无法从图片链接找到原始的Bilibili投稿。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着你应该在上传页面粘贴Bilibili投稿的链接，而不是图片本身。 缺少Bad Bilibili Link标签的投稿可以通过此搜索找到：{{source:*hdslb.com* -bad_bilibili_link}} 示例 https://i2.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/d603b4bd672db3a15ddd855d2f7911531955897084.jpg（错误链接） https://www.bilibili.com/opus/999502755975397381（正确链接） 另见 [[bad link]] [[bad Bilibili id]] （已删除的Bilibili投稿）

tags.name: meme_attire_request
tags.summary: Request to identify a piece of memetic attire. Check the [[meme attire]] wiki for a list of tagged meme attire.
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨认一件模因服饰。请查看 [[meme attire]] wiki以获取已打标的模因服饰列表。

tags.name: style_request
tags.summary: Use this tag when you needed a help to identify a specific [[style parody]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 当你需要帮助来辨认某种特定的 [[style parody]] 时，请使用此标签。

tags.name: bad_dc_inside_id
tags.summary: A DcInside post that is no longer available. See also [[bad id]] [[bad dc inside link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 不再可用的 DcInside 帖子。 另见 [[bad id]] [[bad dc inside link]]

tags.name: bleed_through
tags.summary: A [[scan artifacts|scan artifact]] found when the opposite side of a page is visible in the [[scan]] . This may be caused by thin paper, especially in [[magazine scan]] s. Examples post #7767781 post #5346937 See also [[scan]] [[scan artifacts]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 [[scan artifacts|scan artifact]] ，指纸张背面或对页的内容透过纸张，在 [[scan]] 中可见。这可能是由于纸张过薄造成的，尤其是在 [[magazine scan]] 中。 示例 post #7767781 post #5346937 另见 [[scan]] [[scan artifacts]]

tags.name: neckwear_request
tags.summary: A request to identify specific type of neckwear. See also [[Tag Group:Attire]] [[Tag Group:Neck and Neckwear]]
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨认具体颈饰类型的请求。 另见 [[Tag Group:Attire]] [[Tag Group:Neck and Neckwear]]

tags.name: bad_baraag_id
tags.summary: Posts that are no longer publicly available at the source on Baraag.net. See Also [[bad id]]
tags.wiki_zh: 在来源站 Baraag.net 上已不再公开可用的帖子。 另请参阅 [[bad id]]

tags.name: color_banding
tags.summary: Color banding is a form of image artefacting found in low bit depth images, where the lack of bits cause colors to be rounded rather than blending smothly together. The result is a series of "bands" of colors, where one shade will suddenly jump to the next, rather than fading smoothly together. See
tags.wiki_zh: 色彩断层是一种出现在低位深图像中的图像伪影形式，由于位数不足，颜色会被取整而非平滑地混合在一起。其结果是出现一系列颜色的“条带”，一种色调会突然跳变到下一种色调，而不是平滑地渐变过渡。 另见 [[dithering]] [[gif artifacts]]

tags.name: animal_ear_request
tags.summary: Use this tag when the appropriate tag for [[animal ears]] is unknown.
tags.wiki_zh: 当适合 [[animal ears]] 的具体标签未知时，使用此标签。

tags.name: lego_(medium)
tags.summary: Posts for images of works made out of [[LEGO]] pieces, including custom MOC builds and [[pixel art]] . This tag encompasses all forms of LEGO pieces (including [[Bionicle]] , CCBS, and Technic pieces), as well as artwork made with non-LEGO branded blocks. Examples LEGO [[pixel art]] MOC builds using
tags.wiki_zh: 用于发布以 [[LEGO]] 零件制作的作品图片的标签，包括自创MOC搭建作品和 [[pixel art]] 。 本标签涵盖所有形式的乐高零件（包括 [[Bionicle]] 、CCBS和科技系列零件），以及使用非乐高品牌积木制作的美术作品。 示例 乐高 [[pixel art]] 使用传统零件的MOC搭建作品 使用CCBS零件的MOC搭建作品 另见 [[unconventional media]]

tags.name: paper_cutout_(medium)
tags.summary: Art made using cutouts of paper, oftentimes layered together. See also [[origami]] [[paper child]] [[traditional media]] External links Wikipedia: Papercutting
tags.wiki_zh: 使用剪下的纸制作的艺术，通常将多层纸叠加在一起。 另请参见 [[origami]] [[paper child]] [[traditional media]] 外部链接 Wikipedia: 剪纸

tags.name: food_art_(medium)
tags.summary: A [[photo (medium)|]] of real [[food art]] , including [[latte art (medium)|]] and [[kyaraben (medium)|]] . Examples [[Latte art (medium)|]] [[Kyaraben (medium)|]] See also [[Food art]] [[Tag group:Food tags]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 [[photo (medium)|]] ，使用真实的 [[food art]] 制作，包括 [[latte art (medium)|]] 和 [[kyaraben (medium)|]] 。 示例 [[Latte art (medium)|]] [[Kyaraben (medium)|]] 另见 [[Food art]] [[Tag group:Food tags]]

tags.name: metadata_reference
tags.summary: A reference, joke, or [[pun]] made using the metadata of an image. This can include an image's file size, dimensions, a video's length, or any number of meta elements that contribute to the reference. Examples {{width:390 height:390|390x390}}, [[39]] {{width:999 height:999|999x999}}, [[circled 9]]
tags.wiki_zh: 使用图片元数据制作的引用、笑话或 [[pun]] 。这可以包括图片的文件大小、尺寸、视频的长度，或任何有助于构成该引用的元元素。 示例 {{width:390 height:390|390x390}}、 [[39]] {{width:999 height:999|999x999}}、 [[circled 9]]

tags.name: drawpile_(medium)
tags.summary: Artworks made using Drawpile, a collaborative drawing tool. See also [[Tag group:Drawing Software]]
tags.wiki_zh: 使用 Drawpile（一款协作绘画工具）创作的作品。 另见 [[Tag group:Drawing Software]]

tags.name: bad_artstation_link
tags.summary: A post whose source is a direct link to a Artstation image, rather than to the Artstation post containing the image. These are considered bad links because Danbooru cannot automatically resolve the links to the post. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the link to the
tags.wiki_zh: 指来源是直接链接到 Artstation 图片，而不是链接到包含该图片的 Artstation 投稿的帖子。这些被视为坏链，因为 Danbooru 无法自动将这些链接解析到投稿。 如果你在上传时看到此警告，意味着你应该在上传页面粘贴 Artstation 投稿的链接，而不是图片本身。 缺失 Bad ArtStation Link 标签的帖子可以使用此搜索找到：{{source:*cdn*.artstation.com/*/assets/* -bad_artstation_link}} 示例 https://cdn.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/075/077/107/4k/douya-raiden2-post.jpg?1713706904（坏链） https://www.artstation.com/artwork/g0bQBG（好链） 另见 [[bad link]] [[bad Artstation id]] （一个已删除的 Artstation 投稿）

tags.name: nicoseiga_sample
tags.summary: An image sourced from nicoseiga that is sampled, and is not the original image. Nicoseiga post pages have the following characteristics: URL: http://seiga.nicovideo.jp/seiga/im<image ID> Preview: http://lohas.nicoseiga.jp/thumb/<image ID>i? Link: http://seiga.nicovideo.jp/image/source/<image ID> Ful
tags.wiki_zh: 从nicoseiga转载的经过压缩采样的图片，并非原图。 Nicoseiga投稿页面具有以下特征： URL：http://seiga.nicovideo.jp/seiga/im<image ID> 预览图：http://lohas.nicoseiga.jp/thumb/<image ID>i? 链接：http://seiga.nicovideo.jp/image/source/<image ID> 原尺寸：http://lohas.nicoseiga.jp/priv/.../.../<image ID> 根据Danbooru的规定，此类示例图要么被替换，要么被删除。更多信息请参见 [[image sample]] 。 另请参见 [[Bad Nicoseiga ID]] ：适用于任何Nicoseiga投稿或图片已不再公开的情况 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：适用于没有任何尺寸与Danbooru相符的情况

tags.name: transcoded
tags.summary: A transcoded post is a [[video]] that has been encoded into a different format, or re-encoded in the same format at a different bitrate (also known as 'transrating') before uploading it to Danbooru. This is usually done for compatibility reasons or to reduce the file size so it fits under the file s
tags.wiki_zh: 转码稿件是指在上传到 Danbooru 之前，被编码成不同格式，或以同一格式按不同码率重新编码（也称为“转码率”）的 [[video]] 。这通常是出于兼容性考虑，或为了减小文件体积，使其符合文件大小限制。 编码 Danbooru 仅支持以下文件格式和编码： [th]封装格式[/th][th]视频[/th][th]音频[/th] WebMVP8、VP9、AV1Vorbis、Opus MP4AVC (H.264)、HEVC (H.265)、VP9、AV1MP3、AAC、Opus 此外，不支持 10-bit 色深（HDR）和 4:4:4 色度抽样。 上传转码后的视频时，请留言说明你使用的参数设置以供日后参考，如有可能请附上原始文件的链接。 另请参阅 [[trimmed]] 外部链接 FFmpeg - 一个功能全面且强大的命令行程序，可以解码、编码和转码几乎任何格式。 Handbrake - 一个开源的图形界面程序，支持跨平台。 VidCoder - 为 Handbrake 引擎提供了另一种略微简化的用户界面，面向 Windows 用户。 Wikipedia: Transcoding

tags.name: background_request

tags.wiki_zh: 当 [[background]] 的合适标签未知时使用此标签。

tags.name: bad_drawcrowd_id

tags.wiki_zh: 用于 Drawcrowd 帖子或图片不再公开可用的情况。大多数情况下会重定向到[nodtext]https://drawcrowd.com/404[/nodtext]。自2018年初以来该站一直处于关闭状态。 其他 Drawcrowd 错误 [[Drawcrowd sample]] ：用于使用了非完整尺寸以外尺寸的情况 [[MD5 mismatch]] ：用于没有任何尺寸与 Danbooru 相符的情况 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad CGHub ID]]

tags.name: bad_blogspot_id
tags.summary: Used for when any [[Blogspot]] (*.blogspot.com) post or picture is no longer publicly available. See also [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]
tags.wiki_zh: 用于任何 [[Blogspot]] （*.blogspot.com）帖子或图片不再公开可见的情况。 另见 [[Bad ID]] [[Bad Link]]

tags.wiki_zh: 一个 [[image sample]] ，来自 [[Naver (website)|]] 。

tags.wiki_zh: 来自Bluesky的现已无法访问的图片。

tags.summary: A request to identify the [[tag group:fashion style|fashion style]] a character is wearing, if one is applicable. This tag should be removed if all fashion styles have been tagged or if a post doesn't feature any identifiable styles. See also [[Fashion]] [[Clothing request]] [[Hairstyle request]]
tags.wiki_zh: 请求辨认角色所穿的 [[tag group:fashion style|fashion style]] （如有适用的风格）。如果所有时尚风格均已打上标签，或作品中没有任何可辨识的风格，应移除此标签。 另见 [[Fashion]] [[Clothing request]] [[Hairstyle request]]

tags.name: latin_commentary

tags.wiki_zh: 关于以 [[commentary]] 书写的 [[Latin_text|Latin]] 。

tags.name: cleaned
tags.summary: A [[scan]] that has been modified compared to its original source by removing objects, [[detexted|text]] , or its background, to create a cleaner image. See also [[fixed]] [[decensored]] [[detexted]] [[stitched]] [[third-party edit]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一张相对于其原始来源经过修改的 [[scan]] ，通过移除物体、 [[detexted|text]] 或背景，以获得更干净的图像。 另见 [[fixed]] [[decensored]] [[detexted]] [[stitched]] [[third-party edit]]

tags.name: nurimas

tags.name: comic_cover_redraw

tags.wiki_zh: 一个 [[derivative work|redraw]] ，描绘的是漫画书的 [[cover page|cover]] 。

tags.wiki_zh: 使用 Adobe Animate 创作的作品，该软件曾名为 Adobe Flash 或 Macromedia Flash。 更具体地说，这个标签指的是并非用于 Flash Player 的实际 [[flash|SWF files]] ，而是图像或视频的帖子。 另请参见 [[Flash conversion]] [[Tag group:Drawing Software]] 外部链接 官方网站 维基百科：Adobe Animate

tags.wiki_zh: 带有 [[sound]] 且包含 [[Kasane Teto]] 声库的帖子。这些通常是 [[list of vocal synthesizers|vocal synth]] 歌曲的试听样本，不过也可以是talkloid（语音合成短剧）。 另见 [[vocal synthesizer audio]]

Note that as it's common for Japanese songs to have words borrowed from English or even other languages in their lyrics, a single borrowed word or two should
tags.wiki_zh: 一篇含有多种语言 [[audible speech]] 的帖子，包括歌曲中的歌词。请将所包含的所有语言与此标签一起标记。 请注意，由于日语歌曲的歌词中常常借用英语甚至其他语言的词汇，单个或两三个借用词不应使用此标签，除非该句子有意强调“混合语言”这一方面，相应的语言标签也不应使用。

tags.wiki_zh: 使用此标签标记使用蜡笔绘制和/或上色的图片。 另见 [[colored pencil (medium)]] [[traditional media]] [[crayon]]

These are considered [[bad link]] s because Danbooru cannot automatically resolve the links to the post. If you see this warning while uploading, it means you should paste the link to the Red

tags.summary: For [[commentary]] written in [[Ukrainian_text|Ukrainian]] .
tags.wiki_zh: 关于 [[commentary]] ，其使用 [[Ukrainian_text|Ukrainian]] 书写。

tags.name: color_issue
tags.summary: A [[scan artifacts|scan artifact]] seen when the [[scan]] has inaccurate color reproduction; the colors are oversaturated, low contrast, shifted, or otherwise wrong. Can be the result of poor or no post-processing, or deterioration of the paper. See also [[scan]] [[scan artifacts]]
tags.wiki_zh: 一种 [[scan artifacts|scan artifact]] ，出现在 [[scan]] 色彩还原不准确时；颜色过饱和、低对比、偏色或存在其他错误。可能是后期处理不佳或缺失，或纸张老化变质所致。 另见 [[scan]] [[scan artifacts]] [[color halftone]]

tags.name: voice_actor_drawing_own_character

aliases_zh: 配音演员绘制自己角色
tags.wiki_zh: 由该角色本人的 [[voice actor]] 创作的该角色的绘画。 另见 [[official artist extra]] [[voice actor connection]]

tags.name: kisekae
